options.name: Hokkaido Ramen Santouka
options.signature_dish: Toroniku Shio Ramen with tender pork jowl
options.description: Acclaimed Asahikawa-style ramen renowned for rich simmered pork-bone broth and melt-in-your-mouth simmered pork jowl cut.
options.address: 91 Dundas St E, Toronto, ON M5B 2C8
options.bullet_flavor: Rich slow-simmered tonkotsu pork broth
options.bullet_highlight: Tender pork jowl, prime solo comfort

review_notes.summary: 多伦多老牌日式拉面天花板，特选猪颈肉与醇厚白汤拉面无可挑剔。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 特选猪颈肉盐味拉面 (Tokusen Toroniku Shio Ramen)
🥚 溏心卤蛋与日式煎饺
review_notes.tips: 猪颈肉单独分碟呈上，肉质如雪花般入口即化；建议趁热将肉片浸入白汤享用。
review_notes.vibe: 传统日式拉面馆，热气腾腾

highlights: Tender pork jowl, prime solo comfort
Rich slow-simmered tonkotsu pork broth
options.description_zh: 多伦多老牌旭川拉面名店，以慢熬数十小时的浓郁猪骨白汤与入口即化的特选猪颈肉闻名。
highlights_zh: 多伦多老牌日式拉面天花板，特选猪颈肉入口即化
慢熬数十小时浓郁猪骨白汤，一人食治愈首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 特选猪颈肉盐味拉面

review_notes_en.summary: A benchmark Japanese ramen institution in Toronto, celebrated for its tender pork jowl and rich tonkotsu broth.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Tokusen Toroniku Shio Ramen (Signature tender pork jowl salt ramen)
🥚 Soft-boiled ajitama egg & crisp handmade pan-fried gyoza
review_notes_en.tips: The signature pork jowl is served on a separate side dish so it stays melt-in-your-mouth tender; dip each slice into the piping-hot broth right before eating.
review_notes_en.vibe: Classic bustling Japanese ramen shop with warm comforting steam and quick turnover

options.name: Kinka Izakaya Original
options.signature_dish: Kakuni Braised Pork Belly & Karaage
options.description: Lively Japanese drinking tavern serving authentic izakaya tapas, piping-hot karaage, and draught sapporo in a high-energy setting.
options.address: 398 Church St, Toronto, ON M5B 2A2
options.bullet_flavor: Juicy chicken karaage & sweet braised kakuni
options.bullet_highlight: High-energy Tokyo izakaya & cold draft beer

review_notes.summary: 多伦多居酒屋元祖，能量充沛、炙烤三文鱼押寿司与下酒小菜极其地道。
review_notes.must_try:
🍣 炙烤三文鱼押寿司 (Salmon Oshi Sushi)
🍗 炸鸡软骨 (Karaage) 与三得利角瓶 Highball
review_notes.tips: 店员全日语活力高呼迎客，周五晚氛围极度热闹，适合朋友喝酒聚会开怀畅聊。
review_notes.vibe: 喧闹热烈的大阪居酒屋氛围

highlights: High-energy Tokyo izakaya & cold draft beer
Juicy chicken karaage & sweet braised kakuni
options.description_zh: 多伦多活力居酒屋元祖，高声日语欢呼迎客，招牌炙烤三文鱼押寿司与下酒炸鸡地道美味。
highlights_zh: 元气满满的大阪酒馆氛围，店员全日语热情迎客
外酥里嫩日式唐扬炸鸡与招牌炙烤三文鱼押寿司
options.signature_dish_zh: 日式慢炖五花肉配角煮与唐扬炸鸡

review_notes_en.summary: The pioneer of high-energy Japanese izakayas in Toronto, famous for seared oshi sushi and craveable bar bites.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍣 Aburi Salmon Oshi Sushi (Torched pressed salmon sushi)
🍗 Karaage (Japanese fried chicken) & Suntory Kakubin Highball
review_notes_en.tips: The staff greets every guest with thunderous Japanese cheers. Weekend evenings get lively and loud, making it perfect for drinks and celebrations with friends.
review_notes_en.vibe: Electric, high-energy Osaka-style izakaya with cold draft beer and sizzling plates

options.name: Mogouyan Hand-Pulled Noodles
options.signature_dish: Lanzhou Braised Beef Hand-Pulled Noodle Soup
options.description: Traditional Lanzhou noodle bar pulling customized fresh noodles to order in fragrant clear beef bone broth.
options.address: 124 Chestnut St, Toronto, ON M5G 1R3
options.bullet_flavor: Fresh pulled noodles in clear beef broth
options.bullet_highlight: Authentic Lanzhou style with custom noodle widths

review_notes.summary: 兰州正统传统手工牛肉拉面，一清二白三红四绿面汤极其正宗。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 传统兰州清汤牛肉面 (可选二细或毛细)
🥩 秘制卤牛肉切片配香辣油泼辣子
review_notes.tips: 面条现场纯手工拉制，筋道爽滑；汤头牛骨慢熬数小时，冬天一碗下肚全身暖洋洋。
review_notes.vibe: 干净现代的面馆，看师傅现场拉面很治愈

highlights: Authentic Lanzhou style with custom noodle widths
Fresh pulled noodles in clear beef broth
options.description_zh: 传承兰州正宗传统手工拉面，一清二白三红四绿面汤，现点现拉面条筋道清甜。
highlights_zh: 传承正宗兰州传统工艺，现场拉面自选手工粗细
纯正牛骨慢熬清汤，面条爽滑筋道回味温润
options.signature_dish_zh: 正宗兰州传统清汤牛肉手工拉面

review_notes_en.summary: Heritage Lanzhou hand-pulled noodles prepared in authentic clear beef bone broth with custom dough thickness.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Traditional Clear Broth Beef Hand-Pulled Noodles (Choose your noodle width)
🥩 Sliced spiced braised beef with fragrant roasted chili oil
review_notes_en.tips: Noodles are hand-pulled to order right in front of you. The slow-simmered bone broth is soothing and warms you right up in cold weather.
review_notes_en.vibe: Clean, brightly lit noodle parlor where watching the noodle masters at work is mesmerizing

options.name: Yueh Tung Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Hakka Chili Chicken & Manchurian Fried Rice
options.description: Beloved family-run Toronto institution celebrated for legendary spicy Hakka chili chicken, crisp egg rolls, and wok specialties.
options.address: 126 Elizabeth St, Toronto, ON M5G 1P5
options.bullet_flavor: Tangy, spicy wok-tossed Hakka chili chicken
options.bullet_highlight: Downtown staple with decades of deep wok hei

review_notes.summary: Downtown 四十年客家风味老店，招牌满江红鸡锅是多伦多独家特色。
review_notes.must_try:
🥘 招牌满江红香辣鸡锅 (Manchurian Chicken)
🍲 客家炒米粉与咸鱼鸡粒豆腐煲
review_notes.tips: 酸甜香辣的满江红酱汁拌饭堪称一绝，价格亲民分量巨大，老移民与学生常客极多。
review_notes.vibe: 经典老牌唐人街家常餐馆

highlights: Downtown staple with decades of deep wok hei
Tangy, spicy wok-tossed Hakka chili chicken
options.description_zh: 多伦多市中心四十年客家风味老字号，以锅气十足的招牌满江红香辣鸡锅与炒饭闻名。
highlights_zh: 市中心四十年老店，独具锅气的地道客家风味
酸甜香辣镬气十足的招牌满江红鸡锅炒饭
options.signature_dish_zh: 客家满江红香辣鸡锅与炒饭
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周六 11:30 - 21:30 (周日休息)

review_notes_en.summary: A four-decade downtown Hakka Chinese institution famous for intense wok hei and signature spicy chili chicken.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥘 Signature Manchurian Chili Chicken (Crispy wok-tossed spicy chicken)
🍲 Hakka Fried Rice Noodles & Salted Fish Chicken Bean Curd Pot
review_notes_en.tips: The tangy, savory chili gravy poured over steamed rice is legendary. Generous portions at wallet-friendly prices make it a perpetual local favorite.
review_notes_en.vibe: Classic vintage Chinatown dining room filled with loyal regulars and students

options.name: Konjiki Ramen Downtown
options.signature_dish: Signature Clam & Black Truffle Shoyu Ramen
options.description: Tokyo Michelin Bib Gourmand recipient crafting exquisite broths infused with clam jus, porcini oil, and black truffle paste.
options.address: 41 Elm St, Toronto, ON M5G 1H1
options.bullet_flavor: Shoyu clams & aromatic black truffle oil
options.bullet_highlight: Michelin Bib Gourmand Tokyo heritage

review_notes.summary: 米其林必比登推荐，贝系真鲷高汤拉面配松露油鲜香无比。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌黑松露蛤蜊真鲷拉面 (Shoyu / Shio)
🥩 低温慢煮叉烧与竹笋
review_notes.tips: 蛤蜊与真鲷鱼熬制的高汤鲜味层次极高，松露油与牛肝菌油带来现代高级感，汤底全部喝光也不觉油腻。
review_notes.vibe: 雅致克制的日式摩登拉面馆

highlights: Michelin Bib Gourmand Tokyo heritage
Shoyu clams & aromatic black truffle oil
options.description_zh: 东京米其林必比登名店海外分店，以鲜蛤蜊高汤与浓郁黑松露油混合特调拉面著称。
highlights_zh: 东京米其林必比登推介名店，品质高汤拉面
鲜美蛤蜊高汤交织芬芳黑松露油，层次丰富
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌蛤蜊黑松露酱油拉面

review_notes_en.summary: Toronto outpost of Tokyo’s acclaimed Michelin Bib Gourmand noodle house, famed for clam-infused dashi broth.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Signature Clam & Black Truffle Shoyu Ramen
🥓 Chashu Pork Belly & Smoked Sea Salt Shio Ramen
review_notes_en.tips: The signature broth is infused with fresh clams, porcini mushroom oil, and black truffle oil, giving it incredible umami depth.
review_notes_en.vibe: Modern Japanese minimalist aesthetic with refined wood counters and focused diners

options.name: Haidilao Hot Pot Downtown
options.signature_dish: Tomato Broth & Tableside Hand-Pulled Dancing Noodles
options.description: World-famous Sichuan hot pot chain featuring split broths, customizable dipping sauces, and attentive tableside noodle performances.
options.address: 237 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5B 1N8
options.bullet_flavor: Rich umami tomato broth & savory dipping bar
options.bullet_highlight: Legendary hospitality & live noodle dance

review_notes.summary: 服务天花板与深夜火锅首选，招牌番茄牛尾锅与手切鲜牛肉极其地道。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 浓郁番茄牛尾锅底 + 招牌清油麻辣锅
🥩 捞派滑牛肉、鸭血与现甩捞面表演
review_notes.tips: 夜宵开至凌晨，免费美甲、零食茶水服务到位；调料台自配牛肉芹菜番茄牛肉汤必喝。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹欢快的大型火锅聚会胜地

highlights: Legendary hospitality & live noodle dance
Rich umami tomato broth & savory dipping bar
options.description_zh: 享誉全球的川味火锅标杆，以无微不至的细致服务、特色甩面表演与醇厚番茄锅底闻名。
highlights_zh: 天花板级别的贴心服务与现场特色捞面表演
醇厚开胃番茄浓汤与极丰富的自选调料小吃台
options.signature_dish_zh: 醇香番茄浓汤配极品牛羊肉拼盘
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周日 11:00 - 次日凌晨 3:00

review_notes_en.summary: Global hot pot powerhouse legendary for hospitality, tableside dancing noodles, and rich tomato broth.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍅 Signature Rich Tomato Soup Base & Spicy Sichuan Mala Broth
🥩 Prime Angus Beef Slices, Fresh Shrimp Paste & Tableside Kung Fu Noodles
review_notes_en.tips: Late-night hours extend until 3 AM. Take full advantage of the DIY dipping sauce and appetizer fruit bar.
review_notes_en.vibe: Spacious, high-energy dining hall with warm hospitality, perfect for group celebrations

options.name: TRE Viet Heritage Kitchen & Bar
options.signature_dish: $52 Heritage Tasting Set & Crispy Bánh Xèo
options.description: Intimate Elm Street heritage gem serving elevated Vietnamese tasting menus, crispy bánh xèo, and slow-simmered phở.
options.address: 31 Elm St, 2nd Floor, Toronto, ON M5G 1H1
options.bullet_flavor: Must-order $52 tasting set menu & crispy southern Bánh Xèo turmeric crepe
options.bullet_highlight: Charming 2nd-floor heritage gem with bamboo decor & warm traditional áo dài staff

review_notes.summary: Eaton Centre 附近宝藏越南私房小馆！藏在小洋房 2 楼，竹木绿植、钢琴点缀，充满仪式感与温暖人情味。
review_notes.must_try:
🥢 第一次来必点 $52 Set Menu（尝鲜招牌精华）
🥞 越南南部黄酱脆煎饼 (Bánh Xèo)
🥩 传统红烧肉糯米饭 & 慢熬牛骨河粉
review_notes.tips: 位于 Elm 街小洋房二楼（厨房在三楼），店面精致私密常客满，建议提前预约窗边观景座位；$52 套餐份量扎实性价比高，越南咖啡提拉米苏略逊可留肚吃主菜。
review_notes.vibe: 竹木雅致的私房菜馆情调，着传统奥黛的服务生、钢琴与窗外街景

highlights: Charming 2nd-floor heritage gem with bamboo decor & warm traditional áo dài staff
Must-order $52 tasting set menu & crispy southern Bánh Xèo turmeric crepe
options.description_zh: Elm街洋房二楼私密越南美馔，竹木清雅装潢，传统奥黛服务生，招牌黄酱脆煎饼与尝鲜套餐。
highlights_zh: 藏在洋房2楼的清雅竹木私房小馆，服务生着传统奥黛
必点$52尝鲜套餐与超酥脆越南南部黄酱脆煎饼
options.signature_dish_zh: 传统越南南部黄酱脆煎饼与牛骨慢熬河粉

review_notes_en.summary: A hidden Vietnamese culinary sanctuary near Eaton Centre tucked away on the 2nd floor of an Elm Street heritage townhouse.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥢 First-time essential: $52 Tasting Set Menu (Covers signature highlights)
🥞 Crispy Southern Bánh Xèo Turmeric Crepe
🥩 Traditional Braised Pork Belly with Sticky Rice & Slow-Simmered Beef Bone Phở
review_notes_en.tips: Located on the 2nd floor of a townhouse. Seats fill up fast, so reserve a window table in advance. The $52 tasting menu offers great value and hearty portions.
review_notes_en.vibe: Intimate heritage elegance with bamboo accents, piano melodies, and warm staff in traditional áo dài

options.name: Uncle Tetsu's Japanese Cheesecake
options.signature_dish: Freshly Baked Japanese Soufflé Cheesecake
options.description: Famed Japanese bakery drawing steady crowds for pillowy, ultra-light soufflé cheesecakes stamped fresh out of oven molds.
options.address: 598 Bay St, Toronto, ON M5G 1M5
options.bullet_flavor: Airy, cloud-light soufflé egg custard
options.bullet_highlight: Warm fresh-baked queues & signature brand stamp

review_notes.summary: 日式轻乳酪蛋糕鼻祖，出炉温热松软如云朵般轻盈晃动。
review_notes.must_try:
🧀 原味日式抖臀轻乳酪蛋糕 (Original Japanese Cheesecake)
🥧 熔岩芝士挞 (Cheese Tart)
review_notes.tips: 建议刚出炉趁热切一块品尝，入口即化毫无负担；冷藏后口感更似慕斯，风味各有千秋。
review_notes.vibe: 香气四溢的日式烘焙外带工坊

highlights: Warm fresh-baked queues & signature brand stamp
Airy, cloud-light soufflé egg custard
options.name_zh: 彻思叔叔日本芝士蛋糕
options.description_zh: 多伦多排队传奇日式烘焙坊，现烤现出炉，烙印经典叔叔标志，口感如云朵般轻盈蓬松。
highlights_zh: 出炉必排队的经典烘焙坊，烙印可爱专属标志
如舒芙蕾般轻盈细腻的云朵日式低糖芝士蛋糕
options.signature_dish_zh: 原味现烤日式轻乳酪芝士蛋糕

review_notes_en.summary: World-famous bakery that sparked Toronto’s Japanese dessert craze, baking warm soufflé cheesecakes fresh daily.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍰 Original Warm Japanese Soufflé Cheesecake
🧀 Basque Burnt Cheesecake & Uji Matcha Cheesecake
review_notes_en.tips: Buy fresh right out of the oven for that warm, jiggly cloud texture, or chill in the fridge overnight for a denser, custardy richness.
review_notes_en.vibe: Aromatic grab-and-go bakery window with a gentle aroma of fresh milk and eggs

options.name: Meet Fresh Taiwanese Desserts
options.signature_dish: Iced Taro Ball Signature #4 with Herbal Grass Jelly
options.description: Taiwanese dessert specialist crafting chewy handmade taro balls, silken tofu pudding, and cooling herbal grass jelly bowls.
options.address: 180 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M5G 1Z8
options.bullet_flavor: Chewy taro balls & cool herbal grass jelly
options.bullet_highlight: Classic Taiwanese refreshing iced bowls

review_notes.summary: 台湾传统手工甜品老字号，经典双芋芋圆仙草与手炒黑糖冰。
review_notes.must_try:
🍧 鲜芋仙招牌芋圆仙草冻 (含香芋与手工双色芋圆)
🧋 黑糖粉粿冬瓜鲜奶
review_notes.tips: 仙草冻滑嫩微苦清香，芋圆软糯回弹，夏天加碎冰消暑，冬天可选热烧仙草暖胃。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮温馨的台湾怀旧甜品站

highlights: Classic Taiwanese refreshing iced bowls
Chewy taro balls & cool herbal grass jelly
options.description_zh: 正宗台湾古早味传统甜品工坊，以Q弹手工芋圆、滑嫩仙草冻与细腻红豆刨冰闻名。
highlights_zh: 传承台湾古早味冰品甜点，手作芋圆Q弹软糯
甘醇滑嫩的纯正烧仙草冻配细腻清甜红豆沙
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌芋圆仙草冻刨冰

review_notes_en.summary: Renowned Taiwanese dessert shop specializing in chewy handmade taro balls, soothing grass jelly, and shaved ice bowls.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍧 Signature Iced Grass Jelly Bowl with Handmade Taro Balls & Boba
🍠 Hot Red Bean Soup with Taro Balls & Silky Tofu Pudding
review_notes_en.tips: Drizzle the included fresh dairy creamer over the shaved ice to create a luscious, creamy herbal flavor profile.
review_notes_en.vibe: Clean, bright, casual dessert lounge ideal for evening study sessions or late-night dessert runs

options.name: PAI Northern Thai Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Khao Soi with braised beef and crispy egg noodles
options.description: Celebrated Northern Thai destination renowned for Chef Nuit Regular's deeply fragrant golden coconut curry noodle bowls.
options.address: 18 Duncan St, Toronto, ON M5H 3G8
options.bullet_flavor: Golden coconut curry broth with crunchy noodles
options.bullet_highlight: Chef Nuit's benchmark Michelin Bib Gourmand Thai

review_notes.summary: 多伦多公认泰餐天花板，泰北金面与椰香绿咖喱让人百吃不厌。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 泰北牛肉金面 (Khao Soi with braised beef)
🥥 泰式青咖喱牛腩与香料泰式奶茶
review_notes.tips: 人气长盛不衰常需提前排队，建议错开高峰或在官方排队系统取号；Khao Soi 炸脆面吸满汤汁是神仙口感。
review_notes.vibe: 拜县嬉皮热带木质集市氛围，音乐热烈

highlights: Chef Nuit's benchmark Michelin Bib Gourmand Thai
Golden coconut curry broth with crunchy noodles
options.description_zh: 多伦多公认泰餐天花板与米其林必比登名店，以浓郁椰香金面与泰北青咖喱百吃不厌。
highlights_zh: 名厨Nuit领衔的米其林必比登天花板级泰餐
浓郁椰香泰北咖喱汤底搭配金黄酥脆油炸鸡蛋面
options.signature_dish_zh: 泰北清迈牛肉咖喱金面

review_notes_en.summary: Chef Nuit Regular’s Michelin Bib Gourmand Thai flagship, universally recognized as Toronto’s Northern Thai benchmark.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Northern Thai Khao Soi with Braised Beef & Crispy Egg Noodles
🥥 Green Curry Beef Brisket in Coconut & Sweet Iced Thai Milk Tea
review_notes_en.tips: Lines are constant throughout the day. Put your name down on the digital waitlist early or visit during mid-afternoon off-peak hours.
review_notes_en.vibe: Bustling, rustic tropical Pai market ambiance with wooden furniture and vibrant music

options.name: Ki Modern Japanese + Bar
options.signature_dish: Spicy Tuna Tartare on Crispy Rice & Black Cod
options.description: Sophisticated Financial District hotspot executing modern Japanese sushi, robata grilled skewers, and extensive premium sake pairings.
options.address: 181 Bay St, Brookfield Place, Toronto, ON M5J 2T3
options.hours_note: Mon-Fri 11:45 AM - 10:00 PM, Sat 5:00 PM - 10:30 PM (Closed Sun)
options.bullet_flavor: Silky miso black cod & crispy rice spicy tuna
options.bullet_highlight: Sleek Financial District power-dining lounge

review_notes.summary: 金融核心区现代日料标杆，商务宴请与精致和牛烧烤首选。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 极上宫崎和牛石板烧与特选刺身拼盘
🍶 侍酒师精选日本纯米大吟酿清酒
review_notes.tips: 食材严选空运，调味克制高级，靠近地铁站与地下商城，适合重要晚餐与约会。
review_notes.vibe: 昏暗高雅、现代利落的金融圈精英范

highlights: Sleek Financial District power-dining lounge
Silky miso black cod & crispy rice spicy tuna
options.description_zh: 金融核心区高端和风料理与酒廊，精湛极品黑鳕鱼与创意刺身，适合商务宴请与精致晚餐。
highlights_zh: 金融街高端和风餐饮标杆，设计现代优雅大气
香煎西京渍黑鳕鱼外焦里嫩，清酒收藏极其丰富
options.signature_dish_zh: 西京味噌渍香煎银鳕鱼
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周五 11:45 - 22:00 (周六周日休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Sophisticated Financial District dining destination offering artfully plated contemporary Japanese fare and rare sakes.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐟 Saikyo Miso-Glazed Black Cod with sweet mirin reduction
🍣 Chef’s Selection Nigiri Moriawase & Wagyu Beef Tataki
review_notes_en.tips: A prime spot for professional lunches and celebratory business dinners. Reservations are highly recommended on weekday evenings.
review_notes_en.vibe: Polished urban chic with sleek architectural wood panels, ambient lighting, and an expansive sake bar

options.name: Minami Toronto
options.signature_dish: Flame-Seared Miyazaki Wagyu & Aburi Nigiri
options.description: Gorgeous King West/Financial destination blending charcoal Aburi techniques with contemporary European aesthetic influences.
options.address: 225 King St W, Toronto, ON M5V 3M2
options.bullet_flavor: Miyazaki A5 Wagyu & char-seared nigiri
options.bullet_highlight: Design-forward cocktails & upscale aburi craft

review_notes.summary: Miku 姐妹品牌，戏剧性艺术空间里的炙烤押寿司与现代日本料理。
review_notes.must_try:
🍣 Minami Signature Oshi 拼盘
🥩 和牛生牛肉薄片与特调抹茶鸡尾酒
review_notes.tips: 室内红黑色调由日本著名壁画家手工绘制，灯光与音乐氛围极佳，适合庆祝与微醺小酌。
review_notes.vibe: 奢华前卫的剧场式日式酒廊

highlights: Design-forward cocktails & upscale aburi craft
Miyazaki A5 Wagyu & char-seared nigiri
options.description_zh: Aburi集团旗下奢华现代日式美馔，炙烤箱寿司、和牛煎饺与优雅鸡尾酒的华丽体验。
highlights_zh: King West奢华炙烧日料殿堂，设计感极强
备长炭炙烤三文鱼押寿司与多汁和牛日式煎饺
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌备长炭炙烤三文鱼箱寿司

review_notes_en.summary: King West luxury outpost of the Aburi Restaurants group, celebrated for flame-seared pressed sushi and sleek mixology.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍣 Aburi Salmon Oshi Sushi (Flame-seared pressed salmon with jalapeño)
🥩 Wagyu Beef Gyoza & Charcoal-Grilled Hamachi Kama
review_notes_en.tips: The signature flame-seared pressed sushi uses binchotan charcoal for an unforgettable smoky umami glaze.
review_notes_en.vibe: Upscale, seductive dining space draped in undulating fabric art, perfect for romantic date nights

options.name: Byblos Downtown
options.signature_dish: Fig Salad, Lamb Ribs & Turkish Manti Dumplings
options.description: Stylish two-story destination merging Eastern Mediterranean and Levant culinary influences with fragrant spices and pomegranate reduction.
options.address: 11 Duncan St, Toronto, ON M5V 3M2
options.bullet_flavor: Turkish manti dumplings & pomegranate lamb ribs
options.bullet_highlight: Opulent Eastern Mediterranean two-story retreat

review_notes.summary: 东地中海现代创意料理，黑松露皮塔饼与香料烤羊肉极具异域情调。
review_notes.must_try:
🫓 黑松露奶酪皮塔饼 (Black Truffle Pide)
🍖 慢烤羊肩肉配香料坚果香米饭
review_notes.tips: 地中海与中东香料的优雅结合，羊肉炖得软烂入味毫无膻气；二楼卡座私密性极佳，适合浪漫约会。
review_notes.vibe: 丝绸之路奢华风情，金色丝绒与暖光

highlights: Opulent Eastern Mediterranean two-story retreat
Turkish manti dumplings & pomegranate lamb ribs
options.description_zh: 浪漫精致的东地中海沿海美馔，以酥软慢烤羊排、黑松露土豆面包与香料鸡尾酒著称。
highlights_zh: 多伦多极佳约会氛围，暖色地中海优雅设计
黑松露皮塔饼配软烂慢炖羊肩肉，香料风味独特
options.signature_dish_zh: 黑松露土豆皮塔饼与慢炖羊肩肉

review_notes_en.summary: Acclaimed Eastern Mediterranean showcase serving lavish coastal dishes, wood-fired flatbreads, and aromatic cocktails.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🫓 Black Truffle Barbari Bread with za’atar butter
🥩 Roasted Lamb Shoulder with sumac, pomegranate jus & jeweled rice
review_notes_en.tips: Portions are family-style and meant to be shared across the table. Be sure to book reservations several weeks in advance.
review_notes_en.vibe: Romantic, warmly lit multi-level sanctuary with plush velvet banquettes and exotic spice aromas

options.name: Buk Chang Dong Soon Tofu
options.signature_dish: Spicy Seafood Soft Tofu Stew in bubbling hot stone pot
options.description: North York institution serving boiling cauldrons of silken tofu soup accompanied by sizzling stone bowl purple rice.
options.address: 5307 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 5R4
options.bullet_flavor: Bubbling fiery seafood chili broth & silken tofu
options.bullet_highlight: Cracking fresh egg into smoking hot stone dolsot

review_notes.summary: 北约克韩式嫩豆腐汤鼻祖，热气滚烫的石锅豆腐汤配紫米饭。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 海鲜牛肉嫩豆腐汤 (Soon Tofu Soup)
🍚 石锅紫米饭与香煎黄花鱼配菜
review_notes.tips: 端上来时汤还在剧烈沸腾，趁热打入一颗生鸡蛋搅拌；石锅底部结成的锅巴倒入热大麦茶是传统收尾吃法。
review_notes.vibe: 接地气、暖意融融的传统韩餐食堂

highlights: Cracking fresh egg into smoking hot stone dolsot
Bubbling fiery seafood chili broth & silken tofu
options.description_zh: 多伦多韩餐常青树，热气腾腾的石锅嫩豆腐汤，搭配传统石锅现蒸米饭与丰富小菜。
highlights_zh: 老牌韩式嫩豆腐汤鼻祖，滚烫石锅香气四溢
丝滑豆腐鲜美海鲜牛骨汤，趁热打入鲜鸡蛋
options.signature_dish_zh: 石锅综合海鲜牛肉嫩豆腐汤

review_notes_en.summary: The undisputed staple for piping-hot Korean soondubu soft tofu stews served with stone-pot purple rice.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Assorted Seafood & Beef Soondubu Jigae (Crack a fresh raw egg into the bubbling stew)
🍚 Sizzling Stone-Pot Rice with traditional scorched rice tea (Nurungji)
review_notes_en.tips: Crack the raw egg into the stone bowl immediately while the soup is furiously bubbling. Pour barley tea into the rice crust for comforting nurungji.
review_notes_en.vibe: No-frills, fast-paced Korean diner that always delivers pure, soothing comfort

options.name: Daldongnae Korean BBQ
options.signature_dish: Thick-Cut Fresh Pork Belly & Grilled Corn Cheese
options.description: Nostalgic retro Korean BBQ specialist grilling high-grade pork cuts surrounded by table-edge channels of egg wash and corn-cheese.
options.address: 6034 Yonge St, North York, ON M2M 3W5
options.bullet_flavor: Thick-cut charred pork belly & molten corn cheese
options.bullet_highlight: Retro Seoul street-style tabletop charcoal grill

review_notes.summary: 北约克最地道的复古韩国街头烤肉，厚切五花肉配烤盘边免费芝士蛋液。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 极品厚切五花肉 (Samgyeopsal) 与牛小排
🧀 烤盘外圈无限续加的玉米芝士与松软烤蛋液
review_notes.tips: 炭火烤盘受热均匀，店员帮烤火候绝佳，五花肉外焦里嫩，用生菜包蒜瓣青椒一口闷最过瘾。
review_notes.vibe: 还原七八十年代首尔街头巷尾的复古酒馆

highlights: Retro Seoul street-style tabletop charcoal grill
Thick-cut charred pork belly & molten corn cheese
options.description_zh: 复古韩国街头风情炭火烤肉，烤盘外围独创无限续加芝士玉米与蛋液，肉质上乘多汁。
highlights_zh: 复古韩国街头炭火烤肉，烤盘自带流心芝士玉米
厚切五花肉外焦里嫩，秘制葱丝与新鲜生菜包肉
options.signature_dish_zh: 厚切极品鲜五花肉配烤盘芝士玉米
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周日 12:00 - 次日凌晨 1:00

review_notes_en.summary: Nostalgic Korean charcoal BBQ powerhouse featuring thick cuts of pork and ring griddles filled with cheese corn and egg.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 Thick-Cut Premium Pork Belly (Samgyeopsal) & Marinated Boneless Beef Short Ribs
🌽 Free-refill griddled corn cheese and fluffy steamed egg moat
review_notes_en.tips: The circular table grill continuously bakes fresh cheese corn and egg custard around the meat. Excellent for late-night weekend feasts.
review_notes_en.vibe: Retro 1970s Seoul village nostalgia with weathered wooden facade, lively chatter, and sizzling meats

options.name: Sang-Ji Fried Bao
options.signature_dish: Signature Crispy Pork Sheng Jian Bao with soup
options.description: Authentic Shanghai street food vendor famous for pan-fried pork bao featuring golden crunchy bottoms and scalding broth bursts.
options.address: 5461 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 5S1
options.bullet_flavor: Hot ginger-pork soup trapped in golden crust
options.bullet_highlight: Crisp sesame bottom Shanghai sheng jian bao

review_notes.summary: 北约克生煎包名店，底部金黄焦脆、轻轻咬破汤汁迸发的满足感。
review_notes.must_try:
🥟 招牌经典生煎包 (Sang-Ji Signature Pork Bao)
🍜 传统上海葱油拌面与鸡汤小馄饨
review_notes.tips: 吃生煎一定要先开天窗吸汤汁，防止高温肉汁喷溅；底部芝麻焦香酥脆，肉馅紧实弹牙。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮温馨的中式快捷生煎点心铺

highlights: Crisp sesame bottom Shanghai sheng jian bao
Hot ginger-pork soup trapped in golden crust
options.description_zh: 地道江南传统手作生煎馒头，底部焦脆金黄，肉馅紧实，一口咬下浓郁汤汁瞬间爆浆。
highlights_zh: 多伦多生煎包天花板，底部酥脆金黄咔嚓响
大颗紧实鲜肉内馅，丰盈滚烫肉汁一口爆浆
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌现煎爆汁鲜肉生煎包

review_notes_en.summary: Artisanal Shanghai-style pan-fried soup dumplings famed for ultra-crispy golden bottoms and bursting hot broth.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥟 Signature Pork Shengjian Bao (Pan-fried soup dumplings topped with sesame & scallions)
🍜 Shanghai Scallion Oil Noodles & Spiced Duck Blood Vermicelli Soup
review_notes_en.tips: Nibble a tiny hole in the top dough first to sip the piping-hot savory soup before eating the entire bao, or it will splatter!
review_notes_en.vibe: Casual, bustling Shanghainese fast-casual eatery with mouthwatering aromas from giant cast-iron pans

options.name: MeNami Udon & Izakaya
options.signature_dish: Black Sesame Beef Udon & Mentaiko Cream Udon
options.description: Cozy Japanese udon bar kneading fresh sanuki noodles daily served in creative house-blended broths alongside crispy tempura.
options.address: 5460 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 6K7
options.bullet_flavor: Creamy mentaiko roe sauce & chewy Sanuki udon
options.bullet_highlight: Modern Korean-Japanese fusion tapas & sake

review_notes.summary: 手打自制日式乌冬专门店，浓稠丝滑的奶油明太子乌冬让人欲罢不能。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌奶油明太子乌冬 (Creamy Mentaiko Udon)
🍤 酥脆天妇罗拼盘与日式烤串
review_notes.tips: 乌冬面每天手工压制，弹牙爽口极其筋道；明太子与浓郁奶油酱汁包裹每一根面条，香浓过瘾。
review_notes.vibe: 木质温馨、适合深夜暖胃的日式乌冬酒馆

highlights: Modern Korean-Japanese fusion tapas & sake
Creamy mentaiko roe sauce & chewy Sanuki udon
options.description_zh: 独具创意的日韩融合乌冬居酒屋，招牌黑松露明太子奶油乌冬面，浓郁挂汁香气扑鼻。
highlights_zh: 多伦多独创手打日式乌冬居酒屋，筋道Q弹有嚼劲
浓郁丝滑黑松露明太子奶油酱，裹满每根粗面
options.signature_dish_zh: 黑松露明太子奶油手打乌冬面

review_notes_en.summary: Innovative Japanese-Korean udon bar handcrafted with house-kneaded noodles and decadent fusion sauces.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Truffle Mentaiko Cream Udon (Rich spicy cod roe with shaved black truffle)
🍤 Crispy Tiger Prawn Tempura & Smoked Duck Breast Salad
review_notes_en.tips: Their house-made udon noodles have an extraordinary chewy texture (koshi). Mix the mentaiko roe thoroughly with the hot cream.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm wooden izakaya mood with ambient hanging lanterns and quiet cozy booths

options.name: The Owl of Minerva
options.signature_dish: Gamjatang (Pork Bone Soup with wild sesame)
options.description: Legendary late-night Toronto Korean eatery celebrated for piping hot pork backbone stew simmered with potatoes and cabbage.
options.address: 5324 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 5P9
options.bullet_flavor: Spicy roasted pork neck broth with wild perilla
options.bullet_highlight: Legendary 24/7 comforting Korean gamjatang

review_notes.summary: 多伦多24小时韩餐常青树，浓郁辛香大块猪骨汤是宿醉与夜宵救星。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 招牌土豆猪骨汤 (Kamjatang with tender pork neck)
🥘 铁板韩式甜辣炒年糕与泡菜煎饼
review_notes.tips: 大块猪脊骨慢炖到脱骨软烂，骨髓吸食极其香浓，辣白菜与土豆软糯吸汁，深夜食堂首选。
review_notes.vibe: 24小时不打烊的亲切韩国家庭餐馆

highlights: Legendary 24/7 comforting Korean gamjatang
Spicy roasted pork neck broth with wild perilla
options.description_zh: 多伦多传奇24小时深夜食堂，大块带骨猪脊骨炖土豆汤，浓香微辣暖胃回味无穷。
highlights_zh: 多伦多老牌韩餐招牌，通宵深夜暖胃首选
大块酥软带骨猪脊骨肉，浓香微辣土豆浓汤
options.signature_dish_zh: 传统韩式带骨猪脊骨土豆浓汤
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周日 24小时营业

review_notes_en.summary: Iconic Toronto 24/7 Korean comfort food institution famed for hearty pork bone soup that revives late-night diners.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Gamjatang (Signature rich, peppery pork bone soup with tender potatoes)
🥢 Spicy Pork Stir-Fry & Crispy Seafood Pajeon Pancake
review_notes_en.tips: The fork-tender pork falls right off the vertebrae bones. Dip meat into the hot mustard soy sauce and pour the rich broth over steamed rice.
review_notes_en.vibe: Unpretentious, nostalgic Korean diner buzzing at 2 AM with happy late-night crowds

options.name: Katsuya North York
options.signature_dish: Carbonara Pork Loin Katsu with shredded cabbage
options.description: Japanese cutlet haven battering panko pork cutlets fried golden and smothered in rich cheese, carbonara, or curry sauces.
options.address: 6048 Yonge St, North York, ON M2M 3W5
options.bullet_flavor: Crunchy panko pork loin with creamy carbonara
options.bullet_highlight: Decadent cheese and sauce loaded pork cutlets

review_notes.summary: 多伦多日式厚切炸猪排专家，金黄酥脆肉汁满溢，特制酱汁极其惊艳。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 经典特级厚切炸猪排 (Katsuya Special with Carbonara Sauce)
🌶️ 甜辣双拼芝士炸猪排
review_notes.tips: 猪排外层面包糠轻盈酥脆毫不含油，内里肉质柔嫩多汁；附送的卷心菜丝淋焙煎芝麻酱清爽解腻。
review_notes.vibe: 年轻有活力的现代日式炸猪排专营店

highlights: Decadent cheese and sauce loaded pork cutlets
Crunchy panko pork loin with creamy carbonara
options.description_zh: 多伦多日式炸猪排天花板，厚切新鲜猪排裹生面包糠现炸，外壳酥脆，淋特调咖喱与奶酪酱。
highlights_zh: 多伦多日式炸猪排顶流，厚切鲜嫩多汁外壳金黄
独创浓香白酱蒜香排与日式咖喱拉丝奶酪炸猪排
options.signature_dish_zh: 黄金炸猪排佐特调香浓白酱与咖喱

review_notes_en.summary: Toronto’s undisputed tonkatsu specialist serving ultra-thick, golden-fried pork cutlets smothered in creative sauces.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 Carbonara Katsu & Signature White Sauce Katsu
🧀 Melted Mozzarella Cheese Katsu with Japanese Brown Curry
review_notes_en.tips: The panko crumb coating stays exceptionally crispy even beneath heavy sauces. Unlimited cabbage salad and miso soup refills are included.
review_notes_en.vibe: Modern, high-energy dining room packed with students and katsu fanatics

options.name: PAI Midtown
options.signature_dish: Green Papaya Salad & Massaman Braised Beef Curry
options.description: Midtown outpost of Chef Nuit's acclaimed Northern Thai sanctuary featuring zesty street snacks and aromatic house-curry recipes.
options.address: 2335 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4P 2E6
options.bullet_flavor: Spicy green papaya salad & tender beef curry
options.bullet_highlight: Midtown outpost of Toronto's favorite Northern Thai

review_notes.summary: PAI 的中城分店，保留全部泰北地道风味，排队体验比市区更从容。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌泰北黄咖喱金面 (Khao Soi)
🥢 街头风味冬阴功汤配泰式罗勒炒猪肉饭
review_notes.tips: 品质与 DT 总店完全一致，椰香与青柠酸香平衡绝妙，适合中城居民与不想进市区排长队的朋友。
review_notes.vibe: 中城绿植与泰式木屋相结合的舒适餐厅

highlights: Midtown outpost of Toronto's favorite Northern Thai
Spicy green papaya salad & tender beef curry
options.description_zh: PAI在Midtown的分店，延续名厨Nuit招牌泰北清迈金面与青咖喱，空间宽敞明亮，聚会极佳。
highlights_zh: 米其林推荐名厨团队打造，中城宽敞明亮泰餐空间
浓郁椰香牛肉金面搭配金黄炸脆面，百吃不厌
options.signature_dish_zh: 泰北清迈牛肉咖喱金面配泰式奶茶

review_notes_en.summary: Midtown outpost of Chef Nuit Regular’s celebrated culinary kingdom, offering beloved Northern Thai curries in a spacious room.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Chef Nuit’s Signature Beef Khao Soi with pickled mustard greens & shallots
🥥 Green Curry Braised Beef in Coconut with Jasmine Rice
review_notes_en.tips: Easier to get a table here than the downtown flagship. Great natural light from large windows makes it ideal for group lunches.
review_notes_en.vibe: Airy, colorful tropical Thai restaurant with handcrafted wicker lanterns and friendly hospitality

options.name: King's Noodle Restaurant
options.signature_dish: BBQ Roast Duck & Crispy Skin Pork on Rice
options.description: Chinatown landmark with hanging roasted ducks in windows, carving succulent char siu and bubbling wonton noodle soups.
options.address: 287 Spadina Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2E3
options.bullet_flavor: Crispy golden crackling pork belly & sweet duck
options.bullet_highlight: Hanging roast meats in Chinatown shopfront

review_notes.summary: 唐人街半世纪广式烧腊云吞面传奇，明炉烧鸭与弹牙全蛋竹升面。
review_notes.must_try:
🦆 挂炉脆皮烧鸭饭配葱姜蓉 (Roasted Duck on Rice)
🍜 鲜虾云吞汤面 (全蛋银丝细面)
review_notes.tips: 橱窗挂满油亮烧腊，烧鸭皮脆肉嫩汁水饱满，云吞每颗都有一整只弹牙鲜虾，汤头带大地鱼香气。
review_notes.vibe: 怀旧复古、充满市井烟火气的广式茶餐厅

highlights: Hanging roast meats in Chinatown shopfront
Crispy golden crackling pork belly & sweet duck
options.description_zh: 唐人街半个世纪烧腊老字号，橱窗吊挂蜜汁叉烧与脆皮烧鸭，手打全蛋银丝幼面鲜美弹牙。
highlights_zh: 唐人街老字号广式烧腊，橱窗挂满蜜汁叉烧脆皮烧鸭
手打传统全蛋银丝竹升面，大地鱼虾子大地高汤
options.signature_dish_zh: 广式明炉蜜汁叉烧拼脆皮烧鸭捞面

review_notes_en.summary: Legendary Chinatown institution famed for hanging roasted meats in the window and springy Hong Kong wonton noodles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🦆 Crispy Skin Roast Duck & Honey Barbecue Char Siu
🥟 Fresh Shrimp Wonton Noodle Soup with crunchy thin egg noodles
review_notes_en.tips: Watch the master roaster chop duck with lightning speed in the front display window. Cash or debit is preferred.
review_notes_en.vibe: Old-school bustling Hong Kong tea restaurant with retro booth seating and clattering teacups

options.name: Korean Village Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Dolsot Bibimbap & Marinated Galbi Short Ribs
options.description: Historic Koreatown landmark operating since 1978, dishing sizzling stone bowl bibimbap, homemade kimchi, and tender galbi.
options.address: 628 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6G 1K7
options.bullet_flavor: Sizzling dolsot bibimbap & sweet soy galbi
options.bullet_highlight: Historic Koreatown staple serving since 1978

review_notes.summary: 韩国城历史最悠久的老牌烤肉店，牛小排腌制入味，小菜种类极多。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 特选秘制牛仔骨 (Marinated Galbi Short Ribs)
🍲 经典海鲜葱油饼与石锅拌饭
review_notes.tips: 墙上挂满名人政要合照的老字号，肉质软嫩带着果木炭火焦香，十余种免费自制韩式小菜诚意十足。
review_notes.vibe: 洋溢传统暖意的大阪/首尔老派烤肉馆

highlights: Historic Koreatown staple serving since 1978
Sizzling dolsot bibimbap & sweet soy galbi
options.description_zh: 韩国城半世纪常青殿堂，名厨墙签名满满，经典石锅拌饭、烤牛仔骨与海鲜葱饼原汁原味。
highlights_zh: 韩国城近半个世纪老店，众多明星打卡纪念墙
热烈滋滋作响石锅拌饭配香脆焦香锅巴与铁板牛仔骨
options.signature_dish_zh: 经典传统石锅拌饭拼秘制烤牛仔骨

review_notes_en.summary: Bloor Koreatown’s oldest surviving dining landmark, operating since 1978 and filled with photos of visiting celebrities.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥘 Dolsot Bibimbap with sizzling crunchy rice crust
🥩 Marinated LA Galbi (BBQ short ribs) & Crispy Haemul Pajeon
review_notes_en.tips: The mother of the house (Ok Hee Kang) has welcomed guests for decades. The bibimbap crisps against the hot stone into perfection.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm historic time capsule adorned with autographed photos and classic Korean wood screens

options.name: Sukhothai Regent Park
options.signature_dish: Northern Thai Guay Tiew Noodle Soup & Pad Gra Prow
options.description: The founding flagship where Chef Nuit Regular introduced authentic Thai street cuisine, crispy garlic nuggets, and rich broths.
options.address: 274 Parliament St, Toronto, ON M5A 3A4
options.bullet_flavor: Rich braised beef noodle broth & holy basil stir-fry
options.bullet_highlight: Pioneer of authentic modern Thai in Toronto

review_notes.summary: 多伦多首批地道泰餐代表，酸辣通透的青木瓜沙拉与香浓椰奶咖喱。
review_notes.must_try:
🥗 现舂泰式青木瓜沙拉 (Som Tum Papaya Salad)
🍛 经典绿咖喱鸡配茉莉香米饭
review_notes.tips: 酸甜香辣平衡绝佳，青木瓜丝爽脆冰凉，咖喱浓郁带着浓郁青柠叶香气，深受附近居民喜爱。
review_notes.vibe: 色彩鲜艳温馨热烈的泰国家庭风味小馆

highlights: Pioneer of authentic modern Thai in Toronto
Rich braised beef noodle broth & holy basil stir-fry
options.description_zh: 名厨Jeff与Nuit夫妇打造的泰餐发迹之作，经典冬阴功汤酸辣开胃，古法炒泰粉镬气迷人。
highlights_zh: 多伦多正统泰式家常料理鼻祖，香料芬芳醇厚
古法酸辣开胃冬阴功海鲜汤配镬气十足传统炒泰粉
options.signature_dish_zh: 古法香炒泰粉配泰式香辣酸辣汤

review_notes_en.summary: The founding chapter of Chef Nuit and Jeff Regular’s Thai journey, serving comforting home-style curries and street noodles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥢 Classic Pad Thai Boran with tamarind glaze, tofu, and crushed peanuts
🍲 Tom Yum Kung (Spicy and sour lemongrass prawn soup)
review_notes_en.tips: Their pad thai is wrapped in a thin egg crepe upon request and cooked with genuine tamarind rather than sweet ketchup.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm, cozy Regent Park neighborhood jewel with glowing ambient lights and spice-filled air

options.name: Omusubi Bar Suzume
options.native_name: おむすびバー すずめ
options.signature_dish: Handmade Salmon & Mentaiko Omusubi
options.description: Charming Market 707 stall serving piping-hot handmade Japanese rice balls wrapped in crisp seaweed.
options.address: 707 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M5T 2W6
options.bullet_flavor: Must-order mentaiko takana & grilled salmon rice balls with soothing miso soup
options.bullet_highlight: Warm healing haven with freshly hand-molded onigiri made of plump, chewy rice

review_notes.summary: 想吃日式饭团首选！Dundas West 温暖治愈系饭团专门店。
review_notes.must_try:
🍙 手作现捏日式饭团 (明太子高菜、烤三文鱼、紫苏梅肉)
🍲 暖心豆腐白味噌汤套餐
review_notes.tips: 每日新鲜手作现捏，米粒晶莹饱满有嚼劲；份量精巧，适合一人食便饭或打包野餐，限量售完即止。
review_notes.vibe: Dundas West 极简日系小清新，温暖治愈

highlights: Warm healing haven with freshly hand-molded onigiri made of plump, chewy rice
Must-order mentaiko takana & grilled salmon rice balls with soothing miso soup
options.description_zh: Dundas West温暖治愈系日式饭团工坊，纯手工现捏，晶莹饱满米粒包裹明太子与烤三文鱼。
highlights_zh: 温暖治愈系日系小铺，手工现捏饱满有嚼劲的饭团
必点明太子高菜与烤三文鱼饭团，搭配暖心白味噌汤
options.signature_dish_zh: 手作现捏明太子高菜饭团配白味噌豆腐汤
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 11:30 - 18:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Top recommendation for authentic Japanese onigiri on Dundas West; a warm, healing minimalist specialty rice ball shop.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍙 Handmade Onigiri (Spicy Mentaiko Takana, Grilled Salmon, Shiso Umeboshi Plum)
🍲 Comforting Silken Tofu White Miso Soup Set
review_notes_en.tips: Freshly molded by hand daily with plump, shiny, chewy Japanese grains. Portions are delicate, ideal for a comforting solo lunch or park picnic. Sells out early!
review_notes_en.vibe: Minimalist Japanese aesthetic filled with gentle warmth and comforting simplicity

options.name: Gushi Japanese Street Food
options.signature_dish: Crispy Nana Karaage Fried Chicken Box
options.description: Fan-favorite street food stall dishing out craveable, ultra-crispy Japanese fried chicken over steaming rice.
options.address: 707 Dundas St W, Stall 10, Toronto, ON M5T 2W6
options.bullet_flavor: Signature karaage bento drizzled with savory garlic mayo or nanban tartar sauce
options.bullet_highlight: Market 707 shipping container favorite: crispy fried chicken bursting with juicy flavor

review_notes.summary: 想吃炸物炸鸡必去！Market 707 集装箱小街里的多伦多日式炸鸡名店。
review_notes.must_try:
🍗 招牌南蛮日式炸鸡块便当 (Karaage Bento)
🍢 秘制酱汁炸鸡肉串
review_notes.tips: 多伦多日式炸鸡天花板之一，外酥里嫩肉汁充沛，可选蒜香蛋黄酱或南蛮塔塔酱；市井集装箱摊位烟火气十足。
review_notes.vibe: Market 707 街头集装箱小吃街，浓厚街头风情

highlights: Market 707 shipping container favorite: crispy fried chicken bursting with juicy flavor
Signature karaage bento drizzled with savory garlic mayo or nanban tartar sauce
options.description_zh: Market 707集装箱小街里的日式炸鸡天花板，蒜香姜汁腌制入味，外皮咔嚓酥脆，肉汁四溢。
highlights_zh: Market 707集装箱街头美食顶流，外酥里嫩肉汁爆棚
招牌南蛮炸鸡便当，浇满香浓蒜香蛋黄酱或塔塔酱
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌南蛮日式炸鸡块便当
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周六 11:30 - 19:30 (周日休息)

review_notes_en.summary: An absolute must-visit for fried chicken lovers inside the Market 707 shipping container strip on Dundas.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍗 Signature Nanban Karaage Chicken Bento Box
🍢 House Tare Skewered Fried Chicken Skewers
review_notes_en.tips: A benchmark for Japanese fried chicken in Toronto: crispy crust with bursting juices. Choose between garlic mayo or tangy nanban tartar sauce.
review_notes_en.vibe: Vibrant street-food container stall buzzing with neighborhood charm and fragrant fryers

options.name: Okonomi House Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Classic Bacon & Shrimp Okonomiyaki
options.description: Legendary retro diner flipping griddled Kansai-style savory cabbage pancakes topped with dancing bonito flakes.
options.address: 23 Charles St W, Toronto, ON M4Y 1R4
options.bullet_flavor: Smothered in sweet tare sauce, Japanese mayo & dancing bonito flakes
options.bullet_highlight: 40-year retro teppan institution sizzling with piping-hot cabbage okonomiyaki

review_notes.summary: 想吃正宗铁板大阪烧来这里！多伦多四十年历史的铁板烧元祖老字号。
review_notes.must_try:
🥞 经典铁板大阪烧 (招牌海鲜与猪肉大阪烧 / Classic Teppan Okonomiyaki)
🥓 铁板炒面 (Yakisoba)
review_notes.tips: 现煎现吃热气腾腾，厚切卷心菜爽脆鲜甜，淋满照烧酱与日式美乃滋，木鱼花热烈跳舞；饭点常需排队10-15分钟。
review_notes.vibe: 复古日式木质小酒馆氛围，温馨接地气

highlights: 40-year retro teppan institution sizzling with piping-hot cabbage okonomiyaki
Smothered in sweet tare sauce, Japanese mayo & dancing bonito flakes
options.description_zh: 多伦多四十年历史的铁板烧元祖老字号，厚切卷心菜爽脆鲜甜，热烈跳舞木鱼花与照烧美乃滋。
highlights_zh: 四十年复古铁板烧老字号，现煎现吃热气腾腾
淋满浓厚照烧酱与日式美乃滋，撒上跳舞木鱼花
options.signature_dish_zh: 传统铁板大阪烧配日式炒面
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 11:30 - 21:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: The definitive destination for authentic Kansai-style okonomiyaki; a 40-year retro teppan institution in Toronto.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥞 Classic Teppan Okonomiyaki (Signature Seafood & Pork savory cabbage pancake)
🥓 Sizzling Yakisoba (Griddled noodles with sweet tare sauce)
review_notes_en.tips: Fried fresh to order on the griddle; crunchy sweet cabbage drenched in tare sauce, Japanese mayo, and crowned with dancing bonito flakes. Expect a 10-15 minute wait at peak hours.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cozy retro Japanese wooden tavern warmth that feels wonderfully grounded and nostalgic

options.name: Natural Japaneats
options.native_name: ナチュラル ジャパニーツ
options.signature_dish: Handcrafted Fresh Strawberry Daifuku Mochi
options.description: Beloved artisanal Japanese wagashi maker renowned for freshly pounded, silky strawberry daifuku mochi.
options.address: 601 Christie St, Toronto, ON M6G 4C7
options.bullet_flavor: Delicate low-sugar red bean paste with irresistible pillowy-soft stretch
options.bullet_highlight: All-natural artisanal hand-pulled mochi wrapped around sweet juicy strawberries

review_notes.summary: 想吃大福甜点必去！纯手作日式鲜果大福与麻薯的秘密工坊。
review_notes.must_try:
🍓 手作鲜果草莓大福 (Fresh Strawberry Daifuku)
🍵 宇治抹茶大福与季节限定蜜桃大福
review_notes.tips: 纯手工天然无添加，麻薯外皮软糯拉丝，红豆馅细腻低糖，大颗草莓多汁酸甜；保质期短建议当天新鲜食用。
review_notes.vibe: 日系手作工坊温润风，精致外带甜品

highlights: All-natural artisanal hand-pulled mochi wrapped around sweet juicy strawberries
Delicate low-sugar red bean paste with irresistible pillowy-soft stretch
options.description_zh: 纯手工天然无添加日式鲜果大福工坊，麻薯拉丝软糯，低糖细腻红豆，包裹大颗多汁新鲜草莓。
highlights_zh: 纯天然手工拉丝软糯麻薯，包裹大颗新鲜多汁草莓
细腻低糖手作红豆馅，口感软嫩丝滑无多余添加
options.signature_dish_zh: 纯手工鲜果草莓麻薯大福
options.hours_note_zh: 周三至周日 10:00 - 17:00 (售完即止)

review_notes_en.summary: The ultimate hidden atelier for artisanal Japanese fresh fruit daifuku and hand-pounded mochi.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍓 Handcrafted Fresh Strawberry Daifuku Mochi
🍵 Uji Matcha Daifuku & Seasonal White Peach Daifuku
review_notes_en.tips: 100% handmade and natural with zero additives. Stretchy, pillowy mochi skin wrapped around delicate low-sugar red bean paste and sweet juicy strawberries. Short shelf life; best enjoyed fresh!
review_notes_en.vibe: Serene Japanese artisan workshop with beautifully packaged, delicate takeout confections

options.name: Mon K Patisserie
options.signature_dish: Japanese Souffle Roll Cake & Choux a la Creme
options.description: Understated Japanese-French bakery crafting cloud-soft roll cakes, flaky croissants, and delicate cream puffs.
options.address: 1040 Coxwell Ave, Toronto, ON M4C 3G5
options.bullet_flavor: Must-order classic chestnut Mont Blanc & fluffy matcha strawberry roll cake
options.bullet_highlight: Understated East-end Japanese-French bakery with ultra-restrained sweetness

review_notes.summary: 想吃偏朴素的日法甜品来这里！东区低调高级的日法社区烘焙坊。
review_notes.must_try:
🌰 经典栗子蒙布朗 (Mont Blanc)
🍰 抹茶草莓瑞士卷与外脆内嫩可丽露
review_notes.tips: 法式传统烘焙技法结合日系低糖哲学，甜度极度克制，口感层次细腻纯正不腻；周末下午爆款容易提早售罄。
review_notes.vibe: 东区素雅温馨的法式日系烘焙小店

highlights: Understated East-end Japanese-French bakery with ultra-restrained sweetness
Must-order classic chestnut Mont Blanc & fluffy matcha strawberry roll cake
options.description_zh: 东区低调高级的日法社区烘焙坊，传统法式工艺融合日系低糖哲学，栗子蒙布朗与抹茶卷绝妙。
highlights_zh: 东区低调高级的日法烘焙坊，甜度极度克制细腻
必点经典栗子蒙布朗与轻盈蓬松抹茶草莓瑞士卷
options.signature_dish_zh: 经典法式栗子蒙布朗配抹茶草莓卷
options.hours_note_zh: 周三至周日 9:00 - 17:00 (周一周二休息)

review_notes_en.summary: An understated, high-caliber Japanese-French community bakery on the East end, perfect for modest sweet lovers.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌰 Classic Chestnut Mont Blanc
🍰 Fluffy Matcha Strawberry Roll Cake & Crisp Canelés
review_notes_en.tips: French traditional baking techniques combined with Japanese low-sugar restraint. Clean, nuanced textures that never overwhelm with sugar. Popular pastries sell out by early afternoon on weekends!
review_notes_en.vibe: Quiet, elegant French-Japanese neighborhood bakery with serene morning pastry aroma

options.name: Takoyaki6ix
options.signature_dish: Freshly Griddled Classic Osaka Takoyaki
options.description: Kensington snack bar specializing in piping-hot, freshly griddled octopus balls drizzled with authentic Japanese kewpie.
options.address: 160 Baldwin St #5, Toronto, ON M5T 1L8
options.bullet_flavor: Piping-hot spheres loaded with plump octopus chunks, dancing bonito & kewpie mayo
options.bullet_highlight: Kensington Market griddled takoyaki with crispy golden shell & molten creamy center

review_notes.summary: 想吃现做章鱼小丸子来这里！Kensington Market 现场铁板烤制烫口小丸子。
review_notes.must_try: 🐙 现摇铁板章鱼小丸子 (Classic Osaka Takoyaki 6粒/12粒)
review_notes.tips: 外壳微焦金黄酥脆，内馅熔岩流心，每颗都有饱满大粒章鱼；刚出炉极其烫口，吹一吹再吃，撒满海苔粉和木鱼花绝配。
review_notes.vibe: 肯辛顿市集充满活力的街头小吃摊

highlights: Kensington Market griddled takoyaki with crispy golden shell & molten creamy center
Piping-hot spheres loaded with plump octopus chunks, dancing bonito & kewpie mayo
options.description_zh: 肯辛顿市集现场铁板烤制烫口小丸子，外焦酥脆内馅熔岩流心，大粒厚实章鱼，趁热吃极过瘾。
highlights_zh: 肯辛顿市集现摇铁板小丸子，外酥脆内流心
每颗饱满大粒鲜章鱼，撒上海苔粉与日式美乃滋
options.signature_dish_zh: 大阪风味铁板现烤章鱼小丸子
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 12:00 - 20:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: The go-to destination for freshly griddled, piping-hot octopus balls inside vibrant Kensington Market.
review_notes_en.must_try: 🐙 Classic Osaka Takoyaki (6 or 12 griddled octopus spheres topped with kewpie mayo & sweet glaze)
review_notes_en.tips: Crispy golden shell on the outside with a molten creamy center, each containing a plump, tender octopus chunk. Very hot straight off the griddle—blow gently before taking a bite!
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, energetic street-food snack stall right in the colorful heart of Kensington Market

options.name: Tokyo Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Pork Katsu Curry Rice & Ginger Pork Teishoku
options.description: No-frills cozy spot serving deeply satisfying Japanese home cooking, crispy katsu curries, and comforting rice bowls.
options.address: 20 Charles St E, Toronto, ON M4Y 1T1
options.bullet_flavor: Comforting rich brown curry paired with hearty, crispy golden pork katsu
options.bullet_highlight: Cozy Midnight Diner warmth run by a friendly auntie on Charles Street

review_notes.summary: 想吃便宜暖心的日料便饭来这里！Charles 街温馨日式家庭料理小馆。
review_notes.must_try:
🍛 日式炸猪排咖喱饭 (Pork Katsu Curry)
🥩 生姜烧猪肉定食 (Ginger Pork Teishoku)
review_notes.tips: 老式日式家庭小店，老板娘亲切热情，浓郁日式褐咖喱搭配酥脆厚切炸猪排，份量实在，DT打工人和学生党常年食堂。
review_notes.vibe: 日剧深夜食堂既视感，一人食舒适自在

highlights: Cozy Midnight Diner warmth run by a friendly auntie on Charles Street
Comforting rich brown curry paired with hearty, crispy golden pork katsu
options.description_zh: Charles街老式日式家庭小店，老板娘亲切热情，浓郁日式褐咖喱搭配酥脆厚切炸猪排，份量实在。
highlights_zh: 老式日式家庭小馆深夜食堂氛围，老板娘亲切热情
浓郁香醇日式褐咖喱搭配现炸厚切酥脆金黄猪排
options.signature_dish_zh: 日式厚切炸猪排浓咖喱定食
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周六 11:30 - 20:30 (周日休息)

review_notes_en.summary: The prime spot for comforting, budget-friendly Japanese home cooking on Charles Street.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍛 Crispy Pork Katsu Curry (Deep-fried pork loin with hearty brown curry)
🥩 Ginger Pork Teishoku (Shogayaki sliced pork set)
review_notes_en.tips: Old-fashioned Japanese family diner run by a warm, welcoming auntie. Hearty brown curry with thick crispy cutlets and very generous portions. A beloved staple for downtown workers and students.
review_notes_en.vibe: Pure Japanese "Midnight Diner" nostalgia; cozy, intimate, and deeply comforting for solo dining

options.name: Manpuku Japanese Eatery
options.signature_dish: Niku Udon with thinly sliced beef in dashi
options.description: Beloved hidden gem inside Village by the Grange serving wallet-friendly udon bowls and classic curry sets.
options.address: 105 McCaul St, Unit 29-31, Toronto, ON M5T 2W7
options.bullet_flavor: Steaming beef niku udon in soothing dashi broth served in just minutes
options.bullet_highlight: Legendary $6–$8 student budget comfort haven inside Village by the Grange

review_notes.summary: 想吃便宜日料便饭的首选！Village by the Grange 里的大神级学生食堂。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 经典牛肉乌冬面 (Niku Udon)
🍲 日式牛肉饭与小碗咖喱套餐
review_notes.tips: DT性价比奇迹，一碗热腾腾牛肉乌冬只需 $6-$8，鲣鱼高汤清甜温润，出餐速度飞快，OCAD和多大校友的回忆之地。
review_notes.vibe: 复古室内食街日式暖心小摊

highlights: Legendary $6–$8 student budget comfort haven inside Village by the Grange
Steaming beef niku udon in soothing dashi broth served in just minutes

highlights_zh: Village by the Grange传奇$6-$8平价温暖学生食堂
鲣鱼高汤牛肉乌冬清甜温润，数分钟飞速出餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 经典牛肉乌冬面配日式小咖喱饭
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周六 11:30 - 20:00 (周日休息)

review_notes_en.summary: The top pick for fast, inexpensive Japanese home-style comfort inside Village by the Grange.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Classic Niku Udon (Sliced beef in sweet dashi broth)
🍲 Beef Gyudon & Mini Japanese Curry Rice combo sets
review_notes_en.tips: A downtown value miracle: a hot bowl of beef udon starts at just $6–$8 with soothing dashi broth. Orders come out at lightning speed. An unforgettable memory for OCAD and U of T students.
review_notes_en.vibe: Vintage indoor food-court food stall with humble wooden counter and steaming noodle pots

review_notes.summary: 想吃 Tendon 天妇罗盖饭来这里！Chef's Hall 里的日本天妇罗大师品牌。
review_notes.must_try: 🍤 Keisuke Special 豪华天丼 (炸大虾、半熟溏心蛋、海苔、鸡肉)
review_notes.tips: 东京名厨概念店，面衣极其轻盈松脆不油腻，秘制天妇罗酱汁咸甜适口；将炸半熟蛋戳破蛋黄拌米饭是灵魂吃法。
review_notes.vibe: Chef's Hall 摩登美食街吧台，出餐迅速油香四溢

highlights_zh: 东京天妇罗大师品牌，面衣极其轻盈酥脆不油腻
戳破炸半熟溏心蛋蛋黄拌米饭配秘制甜咸酱汁

review_notes_en.summary: The definitive destination for Japanese tendon bowls inside Chef's Hall, created by a Tokyo tempura champion.
review_notes_en.must_try: 🍤 Keisuke Special Tendon (Jumbo prawns, runny soft-boiled egg, nori, chicken, and seasonal vegetables)
review_notes_en.tips: Concept by a Tokyo master chef: ultra-light crispy tempura batter that never feels heavy or greasy. Secret technique: break the runny tempura egg yolk right over the sauce-glazed rice!
review_notes_en.vibe: Sleek, modern Chef's Hall food hall counter filled with tantalizing aromas and quick service

options.name: Botanic Coffee and Caphe
options.signature_dish: Lychee Rose Matcha Latte & Matcha Ice Cream
options.description: Queen West vintage botanical cafe known for floral matcha lattes, Vietnamese brews, and pet-friendly cozy vibes.
options.address: 662 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1E5
options.bullet_flavor: Must-order floral Lychee Rose Matcha Latte & rich, non-cloying matcha ice cream
options.bullet_highlight: Aesthetic vintage botanical cafe with dog-friendly cozy vibes on Queen West

review_notes.summary: Queen West 新开的复古植物系 cafe，氛围很温馨。招牌荔枝玫瑰抹茶与浓郁抹茶冰淇淋值得一试！
review_notes.must_try:
🌹 Lychee Rose Matcha Latte (系列最佳！抹茶拿铁上有玫瑰干花和淡淡荔枝清香，少糖版完全不腻)
🍨 Premium Matcha Ice Cream (很不错！抹茶味醇厚浓郁，恰到好处不齁甜)
review_notes.skip_or_neutral:
☕ Hojicha Black Sesame Cloud (平平无奇，元素融合没有想象中好)
🍵 Double Matcha (很普通，抹茶味微偏淡)
review_notes.tips: 刚开业人很多，高峰期饮品需等20分钟左右；🐶 店内宠物友好，可以偶遇很多萌萌的狗勾！
review_notes.vibe: 复古植物系美学空间，温馨治愈，拍照非常出片

highlights: Aesthetic vintage botanical cafe with dog-friendly cozy vibes on Queen West
Must-order floral Lychee Rose Matcha Latte & rich, non-cloying matcha ice cream
options.description_zh: Queen West复古植物系空间，拍照出片且宠物友好，必点招牌荔枝玫瑰抹茶与浓郁抹茶冰淇淋。
highlights_zh: Queen West复古绿植美学空间，温馨治愈宠物友好
必点花香荔枝玫瑰抹茶拿铁与浓郁醇厚抹茶冰淇淋
options.signature_dish_zh: 荔枝玫瑰特调抹茶拿铁配极品抹茶冰淇淋

review_notes_en.summary: A newly opened vintage botanical cafe on Queen West with a cozy, healing vibe. The signature lychee rose matcha and matcha ice cream are must-tries!
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌹 Lychee Rose Matcha Latte (Best in series! Rose petals on matcha latte with delicate lychee fragrance, never cloying when ordered less-sweet)
🍨 Premium Matcha Ice Cream (Rich, silky matcha flavor that is perfectly balanced and not overly sweet)
review_notes_en.skip_or_neutral:
☕ Hojicha Black Sesame Cloud (Fairly average; flavor fusion didn’t come through as expected)
🍵 Double Matcha (Quite plain, matcha flavor leans slightly thin)
review_notes_en.tips: Popular since opening; drinks may take ~20 min during peak afternoon rush. The cafe is dog-friendly, so you can often meet cute pups!
review_notes_en.vibe: Vintage botanical aesthetic space, calming and photogenic with lush potted plants and natural wood

options.name: Koh Lipe Thai Kitchen
options.native_name: เกาะหลีเป๊ะ
options.signature_dish: Southern Style Massaman Curry & Pad Thai Boran
options.description: Acclaimed Baldwin Village gem celebrated for authentic, fiery Southern Thai seafood curries and aromatic wok-fried street noodles.
options.address: 35 Baldwin St, Toronto, ON M5T 1L1
options.bullet_flavor: Fiery lemongrass, tamarind tang, and rich coconut
options.bullet_highlight: Michelin Bib Gourmand, authentic Southern Thai recipes

review_notes.summary: Michelin Bib Gourmand 必比登推介！多伦多正宗泰南料理（Southern Thai）的领军代表。
review_notes.must_try:
🍛 招牌泰南玛莎曼咖喱 (Southern Style Massaman Curry with tender beef)
🥢 传统古法炒泰粉 (Pad Thai Boran) 与泰南酸辣海鲜锅 (Gaeng Som)
review_notes.tips: 不同于常见的泰北或曼谷街头风味，Koh Lipe 主打辛辣浓烈的泰南岛屿海鲜料理；环境温馨很有泰国小村落情调，建议尝试经典微辣。
review_notes.vibe: Baldwin Village 充满市井烟火气与异域香气的小木屋餐厅

highlights: Michelin Bib Gourmand, authentic Southern Thai recipes
Fiery lemongrass, tamarind tang, and rich coconut
options.description_zh: 米其林必比登推介名店，专注浓郁辛辣的泰南岛屿海鲜料理，招牌玛莎曼牛肉咖喱极其醇厚。
highlights_zh: 米其林必比登推介，多伦多正统泰南岛屿辛辣料理代表
浓郁香料玛莎曼牛肉咖喱，酥软牛腩与古法炒泰粉

review_notes_en.summary: Michelin Bib Gourmand recognized leader in authentic Southern Thai cuisine in Baldwin Village.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍛 Signature Southern Style Massaman Curry with tender beef brisket
🥢 Traditional Pad Thai Boran & Spicy-Sour Southern Island Seafood Soup (Gaeng Som)
review_notes_en.tips: Distinct from Northern or Bangkok street profiles; Koh Lipe champions punchy, spicy island curries and fresh seafood. Cozy village shack warmth; mild spice is recommended for first-timers.
review_notes_en.vibe: Baldwin Village wooden cottage filled with vibrant street vibes and exotic spice aromas

options.name: Bar Pompette
options.signature_dish: Nitro Espresso Martini & Seasonal Clarified Cocktails
options.description: Crowned Canada's Best Bar, blending Michelin-caliber French culinary alchemy with seasonal clarified cocktails and Parisian sidewalk patio.
options.address: 607 College St, Toronto, ON M6G 1B5
options.bullet_flavor: Refined botanicals, clarified citrus, and velvet spirits
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #8, Best Bar in Canada

review_notes.summary: 北美 50 最佳酒吧高居第8名！连续多年荣膺全加拿大第一酒吧（The Best Bar in Canada）称号。
review_notes.must_try:
☕ Nitro Espresso Martini (氮气冰滴咖啡马天尼，口感丝滑细腻)
🍋 澄清牛奶潘趣 (Clarified Milk Punch) 与当季实验室风味特调
review_notes.tips: 由米其林星级调酒团队主理，每一季酒单都充满法式艺术感；后院露天 Patio 夏夜极美，周末建议提前在官网订位。
review_notes.vibe: 迷人浪漫的巴黎左岸小酒馆风格，低调奢华

highlights: North America's 50 Best #8, Best Bar in Canada
Refined botanicals, clarified citrus, and velvet spirits

清新平衡的花果调鸡尾酒，绿意盎然的惬意露台花园

review_notes_en.summary: North America’s 50 Best Bars honoree offering luminous, French-inspired mixology and a sun-dappled backyard patio.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 Clarified Milk Punch & Calvados Highball with crisp green apple
🧀 Artisanal French Charcuterie & Fromage Board with fresh baguette
review_notes_en.tips: Ranked among the premier cocktail bars on the continent. Their backyard garden patio is an absolute dream in warm weather.
review_notes_en.vibe: Airy, Parisian-chic daylight bar transforming into a candlelit romantic evening hideaway

options.name: Library Bar

review_notes.must_try:
🍸 The Birdbath Martini (招牌鸟浴马天尼，分 Quiet 与 Loud 两种风格，仪式感拉满)
🦪 生蚝拼盘与和牛牛肉塔塔小食
review_notes.tips: 极度火爆，晚间常需在酒店大堂候客名单排队；装潢如英伦私人图书馆，灯光昏暗奢华，适合约会与重要庆祝。
review_notes.vibe: 优雅奢华的古典英式图书馆，藏书与绿丝绒卡座相映成趣

Crisp dry vermouth, distilled juniper, and saline umami

review_notes_en.summary: The storied crown jewel of cocktail glamour inside the Fairmont Royal York, acclaimed for world-class tableside martinis.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 The Birdbath Martini (Served sub-zero at tableside with bespoke gin, vermouth, and custom garnishes)
🥩 Wagyu Beef Tartare & Osetra Caviar Bites
review_notes_en.tips: Dress smart-casual. Lines often form right at opening time; arrive 15 minutes before 4:30 PM to secure the coveted velvet club chairs.
review_notes_en.vibe: Opulent, mahogany-paneled literary sanctuary with amber lighting and timeless cinematic sophistication

review_notes.must_try:
🥛 Mother's Milk (招牌乳酸慢发酵朗姆酒特调，风味奇妙迷人)
🌿 Soil Gimlet & 自制康普茶鸡尾酒
review_notes.tips: 店内犹如中世纪炼金术实验室，调酒师用自制发酵菌种、开菲尔和野草本调配；灯光昏暗浪漫，约会圣地。

review_notes_en.summary: Pioneering botanical and fermentation cocktail temple on Queen West, recognized internationally for seasonal ingredient craftsmanship.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍹 Fermented Fruit Highball & Mushroom-infused Rye Cocktail
🍞 House-baked Sourdough with cultivated koji butter
review_notes_en.tips: Every cocktail incorporates complex fermented tinctures, kombuchas, or shrub bases created in their dedicated basement lab.
review_notes_en.vibe: Earthy, moody sanctuary framed by exposed brick, glowing jars of fermenting botanicals, and warm acoustic soul

options.name: Civil Works

options.description: Award-winning art deco mezzanine cocktail lounge inside Waterworks Food Hall, highlighting architectural themes and world-class water filtration mixology.

options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #29, Best Cocktail Menu 2025

💧 招牌水系特调 (Water Filtration Clarified Cocktails)

review_notes.tips: 调酒理念向古老的水务建筑致敬，采用定制水质调配极致纯净的风味；坐在二楼俯瞰整个美食大厅挑高空间非常震撼。
review_notes.vibe: 宏大挑高的工业 Art Deco 摩登美学，视野开阔时髦

多伦多顶级调酒团队操刀，水元素与清冽冰块特调

🍸 Waterworks Clarified Punch & Bespoke Ice Block Highballs
🥟 Artisanal finger food pairings from the food hall masters below
review_notes_en.tips: Features an extraordinary water filtration program and carved artisanal crystal-clear ice blocks.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cathedral-like mezzanine perched high beneath towering industrial brick archways and gilded brass railings

options.name: Civil Liberties
options.signature_dish: No-Menu Bespoke Cocktails tailored to your palate
options.description: Legendary no-menu cocktail bar marked by a brass pineapple, where master bartenders craft bespoke drinks based entirely on your conversation.
options.address: 878 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M6G 1M5
options.bullet_flavor: Personalized balance of sour, smoky, herbal, or sweet spirits
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #54, Canada's #1 Bar 3 times

review_notes.must_try: 🍍 专属无酒单定制鸡尾酒 (告诉调酒师你想喝酸甜、烟熏、草本还是热带，绝不踩雷)

review_notes.vibe: 温暖昏暗、不拘小节的街头美式邻里酒馆，人情味十足

🍸 Custom Cocktails tailored on the fly (Tell the bartender your preferred spirits, mood, and flavor profiles)
🧀 Generous bowls of warm spiced bar snacks
review_notes_en.tips: There is zero menu here. Speak candidly to your bartender about what flavors you adore (smoky, bitter, herbal, tropical, sour) and prepare to be amazed.
review_notes_en.vibe: Dimly lit, cozy neighborhood dive bar soul elevated to world-class craftsmanship

options.name: Bar Raval

🥪 经典巴塞罗那下酒菜 Pintxos (腌凤尾鱼、伊比利亚火腿)

review_notes.vibe: 令人窒息的加泰罗尼亚流线型木雕艺术殿堂，人声鼎沸
