Dry fino sherry, herbal bitter vermouth, and salty tapas
options.name_zh: Bar Raval 高迪风西班牙小酒馆
options.description_zh: 小意大利传奇高迪曲线波浪木雕殿堂，站立吧台品尝西式苦艾酒、雪莉酒与正宗西班牙开胃Tapas。
highlights_zh: 惊艳的高迪式波浪雕刻实木空间，巴塞罗那小酒馆情怀
站立吧台品尝西班牙雪莉酒、生火腿与极品章鱼Tapas
options.signature_dish_zh: 加利西亚慢炖章鱼配西班牙火腿Tapas
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周日 11:00 - 次日凌晨 1:00

review_notes_en.summary: Grant van Gameren’s breathtaking Barcelona pintxos and cocktail bar, internationally celebrated for undulating sculpted woodwork.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐙 Pulpo a la Gallega (Tender griddled octopus with smoked paprika & potato)
🥖 Jamón Ibérico Pintxos & House Raval Vermut with sparkling soda
review_notes_en.tips: Seating is primarily standing-room around the wave-carved bar. Drop in during late afternoon aperitivo hour for vermouth and anchovy pintxos.
review_notes_en.vibe: Sensuous, undulating carved mahogany cocoon humming with tapas platters, clinking glasses, and European romance

options.name: Cry Baby Gallery
options.signature_dish: Clarified Mezcal Paloma & Smoked Bourbon Penicillin
options.description: Cool speakeasy concealed behind a functioning contemporary art gallery, serving edgy craft cocktails and oysters in an intimate backyard.
options.address: 1468 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1Y6
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky artisanal mezcal, bright citrus, and honey ginger
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #69, hidden behind art gallery

review_notes.summary: 北美 Top 100 榜单第69名！穿过真实的现代艺术画廊后门，别有洞天的隐秘地下酒吧。
review_notes.must_try:
🍸 澄清龙舌兰帕洛玛 (Clarified Paloma)
🦪 现开新鲜生蚝配特制鸡尾酒雪葩
review_notes.tips: 进门是正经的艺术画廊，推开墙面暗门才能进入酒廊；后院的小 Patio 在夏夜非常舒服，鸡尾酒视觉与风味都很前卫。
review_notes.vibe: 极具街头艺术气息的西区地下秘密据点

highlights: North America's 50 Best #69, hidden behind art gallery
Smoky artisanal mezcal, bright citrus, and honey ginger
options.name_zh: Cry Baby 艺术画廊地下酒吧
options.description_zh: 藏在真实艺术画廊暗门背后的地下隐秘酒吧，昏暗迷离的烛光与极富创意的招牌调酒。
highlights_zh: 穿过真实艺术画廊暗门进入，神秘隐秘小酒馆氛围
昏暗复古烛光映衬，精巧平衡的现代创意鸡尾酒
options.signature_dish_zh: 暗门密室特调烟熏波旁鸡尾酒
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 18:00 - 次日凌晨 2:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Speakeasy tucked secretly behind a real contemporary art gallery on Dundas West, serving imaginative craft libations.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 Cry Baby Signature Mezcal Sour & Smoked Bourbon Old Fashioned
🦪 Fresh East Coast Oysters with mignonette
review_notes_en.tips: Walk straight through the working art gallery and push through the unmarked back door. Perfect spot for discreet date nights.
review_notes_en.vibe: Moody, speakeasy velvet romance with neon accents and intimate candlelit booth corners

options.name: Suite 115
options.signature_dish: Omakase Cocktail Tasting Flight with Rare Spirits
options.description: Exclusive twelve-seat speakeasy counter hidden inside Mother, offering an avant-garde cocktail tasting menu paired with artisanal bites.
options.address: 874 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1G3
options.bullet_flavor: Multi-course sensory flight of rare vintages and liquid nitrogen
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #74, ultra-intimate 12-seat counter

review_notes.summary: 北美 Top 100 榜单第74名！藏在 Mother 酒吧内部的私密 12 座高端鸡尾酒 Tasting Room。
review_notes.must_try: 🧪 专属 Cocktail Omakase 主厨调酒套餐 (多道式创意鸡尾酒配定制小食)
review_notes.tips: 全程预约制，仅设12个吧台位，调酒师一对一在面前犹如日料主厨般定制稀有酒款与前沿液氮技艺。
review_notes.vibe: 极度私密安静的顶级沉浸式鸡尾酒吧台

highlights: North America's 50 Best #74, ultra-intimate 12-seat counter
Multi-course sensory flight of rare vintages and liquid nitrogen
options.name_zh: Suite 115 隐秘日式极简酒吧
options.description_zh: Queen West隐蔽极简主义小酒廊，仅设数个吧台席位，专注于顶级日本威士忌与纯粹极简调酒。
highlights_zh: Queen West极简克制小酒廊，仅设少量珍贵吧台座
精湛刀工手凿老冰块，收藏级日本稀缺单一麦芽威士忌
options.signature_dish_zh: 手凿老冰球配日本稀缺单一麦芽威士忌
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 18:00 - 次日凌晨 1:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Microscopic, minimalist Japanese speakeasy with only a handful of seats, highlighting rare Japanese whiskies.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥃 Hand-Carved Ice Sphere with Rare Japanese Single Malt
🍸 Highball Elegante (Craft tonic, sparkling water, and yuzu essence)
review_notes_en.tips: With fewer than 15 total seats, arrive early right at doors open to secure an intimate barstool spot.
review_notes_en.vibe: Tranquil Tokyo omakase bar atmosphere with natural hinoki wood and hushed reverence

options.name: No Vacancy
options.signature_dish: Motel Room Key Signature Martini & Disco Punch Bowl
options.description: Electric 1970s roadside motel-themed cocktail hideaway on Richmond, serving inventive libations alongside retro disco grooves and vinyl.
options.address: 438 Richmond St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Y1
options.bullet_flavor: Retro gin twist, disco passionfruit, and savory olive brine
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #82, 1970s roadside motel vibes

review_notes.summary: 北美 Top 100 榜单第82名！以 70 年代美式复古汽车旅馆为主题的时髦鸡尾酒秘境。
review_notes.must_try:
🔑 Motel Room Key Martini (复古钥匙牌造型马天尼)
🪩 迪斯科黑胶特调 Punch
review_notes.tips: 隐藏在 Richmond 街区，霓虹灯光搭配复古黑胶音乐，酒单幽默好玩但调酒功底扎实，周末夜晚气氛极度欢快。
review_notes.vibe: 70 年代霓虹复古汽车旅馆风，黑胶与迪斯科节拍流动

highlights: North America's 50 Best #82, 1970s roadside motel vibes
Retro gin twist, disco passionfruit, and savory olive brine
options.name_zh: No Vacancy 汽车旅馆风复古酒吧
options.description_zh: Downtown隐藏在复古汽车旅馆霓虹深处的时髦鸡尾酒吧，充满电影感布景与玩趣特调。
highlights_zh: 复古复古汽车旅馆霓虹装潢，电影胶片既视感出片率极高
充满趣味与创意的特色鸡尾酒，松弛愉悦的聚会氛围
options.signature_dish_zh: 汽车旅馆霓虹特调龙舌兰鸡尾酒
options.hours_note_zh: 周三至周六 18:00 - 次日凌晨 2:00 (周日至周二休息)

review_notes_en.summary: A cinematic retro motel lounge hidden in the downtown alleyways, serving cheeky cocktails under warm neon light.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍹 Vacancy Punch with tropical spiced rum
🍸 Velvet Glove Tequila Sour with charred rosemary
review_notes_en.tips: Spot the neon "No Vacancy" sign to locate the door. Terrific late-night soundtrack and photogenic backdrops everywhere.
review_notes_en.vibe: 1970s California road-trip motel lounge fantasy complete with vintage rotary phones and velvet banquettes

options.name: Bar Mordecai
options.signature_dish: The Grand Budapest Hotel Inspired Gin & Tonic Flights
options.description: Whimsical multi-level cocktail palace inspired by the films of Wes Anderson, featuring creative aperitivos and retro private karaoke rooms.
options.address: 1272 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1X7
options.bullet_flavor: Floral botanical gin, bitter aperol, and retro party punch
options.bullet_highlight: North America's 50 Best #40, Wes Anderson aesthetic

review_notes.summary: 北美 50 最佳酒吧常客！灵感源自韦斯·安德森（Wes Anderson）电影美学的复古奇幻鸡尾酒宫殿。
review_notes.must_try:
🏩 The Grand Budapest 特调金汤力组合
🎤 地下室私密复古 KTV 包厢特供调酒
review_notes.tips: 对称构图、粉绿暖黄的梦幻配色超级出片，楼下还藏着需提前预订的私密复古 KTV 包间，聚会庆祝绝佳。
review_notes.vibe: 韦斯·安德森电影实景重现，充满复古怀旧与戏剧感

highlights: North America's 50 Best #40, Wes Anderson aesthetic
Floral botanical gin, bitter aperol, and retro party punch
options.name_zh: Bar Mordecai 韦斯安德森风小酒馆
options.description_zh: 韦斯·安德森电影美学梦幻酒馆，复古列车包厢设计与地下私人KTV包房，拍照打卡与聚会极佳。
highlights_zh: 韦斯·安德森对称复古列车美学，梦幻复古怀旧色调
创意主题鸡尾酒配炸奶酪小食，地下配有私密KTV包房
options.signature_dish_zh: 复古列车特调琴酒配西红柿布拉塔奶酪
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 17:00 - 次日凌晨 2:00 (周一休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Wes Anderson-inspired cinematic wonderland on Dundas West, complete with train car banquettes and underground karaoke rooms.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 The Grand Budapest Spritz & Clarified Espresso Martini
🧀 Warm Burrata Flatbread & Truffle Fried Potatoes
review_notes_en.tips: The dining room evokes the vintage carriages of the Orient Express. You can book private themed karaoke rooms downstairs for group bashes.
review_notes_en.vibe: Playfully opulent retro film set with pastel color palettes, velvet curtains, and exuberant energy

options.name: Yakiniku Legend
options.signature_dish: All-You-Can-Eat Premium Wagyu & Japanese BBQ Skewers
options.description: High-energy downtown Japanese tabletop BBQ specialist featuring all-you-can-eat premium wagyu, marinated short ribs, and lively group atmosphere.
options.address: 35 McCaul St, Toronto, ON M5T 1V7
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky sizzling wagyu kalbi, tender beef tongue, and sweet tare glaze
options.bullet_highlight: All-You-Can-Eat premium Japanese tabletop BBQ & skewers

review_notes.summary: DT 超火爆的日式自助烧烤（AYCE Japanese BBQ），肉质上乘、选择极丰富，聚会社恐治愈系大口吃肉圣地。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 特选牛舌 (Gyutan) & 安格斯牛小排 (Kalbi Short Ribs)
🥓 秘制厚切五花肉 & 招牌日式烤串组合
review_notes.tips: 采用无烟桌面烤炉，吃完身上没有重油烟味；肉质在多伦多同价位 AYCE 烤肉中表现亮眼，周末强烈建议早去或错峰。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹现代的和风烤肉居酒屋氛围，排烟良好，肉香四溢

highlights: All-You-Can-Eat premium Japanese tabletop BBQ & skewers
Smoky sizzling wagyu kalbi, tender beef tongue, and sweet tare glaze
options.description_zh: 市中心超火爆日式自助烧烤（AYCE），特选牛舌、安格斯牛小排肉质上乘，无烟烤炉吃肉圣地。
highlights_zh: 市中心火爆日式无烟自助烧烤，无油烟惬意大口吃肉
特选脆弹牛舌配安格斯安格斯牛小排，秘制厚切五花肉
options.signature_dish_zh: 特选上等日式烤牛舌与安格斯牛小排

review_notes_en.summary: Extremely popular downtown all-you-can-eat (AYCE) Japanese BBQ with top-tier meats and a festive feast atmosphere.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 Prime Gyutan (Thin-sliced beef tongue with sea salt & lemon) & Angus Kalbi Short Ribs
🥓 Thick-cut Seasoned Pork Belly & Signature Skewer Sampler
review_notes_en.tips: Uses advanced smokeless tabletop grills so clothes never smell of grease. Meats outclass typical AYCE standards; arrive early on weekends to dodge waitlists.
review_notes_en.vibe: Bustling modern Japanese yakiniku izakaya full of lively sizzling sounds and mouthwatering aromas

options.name: Dim Sum King Seafood Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Traditional Pushcart Har Gow, Siu Mai & Crispy Taro Puffs
options.description: Bustling third-floor Chinatown institution preserving classic weekend morning dim sum pushcarts, plump har gow, and family-style Cantonese roasts.
options.address: 421 Dundas St W, 3rd Floor, Toronto, ON M5T 2W4
options.hours_note: Mon-Sun 9:00 AM - 9:00 PM (Dim Sum 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM)
options.bullet_flavor: Steamy translucent shrimp dumplings, savory pork siu mai, and hot tea
options.bullet_highlight: Classic Chinatown pushcart Cantonese dim sum brunch

review_notes.summary: 多伦多唐人街经典手推车早茶老字号，叹茶吃点心的怀旧广式早午餐（Brunch）不二之选。
review_notes.must_try:
🥟 经典手推车晶莹水晶虾饺 (Har Gow) & 蟹籽烧卖皇 (Siu Mai)
🥢 豉汁蒸排骨、蜂巢香芋角 & 现拉鲜虾肠粉
review_notes.tips: 位于 3 楼大宴会厅，依然保留传统点心推车阿姨沿桌叫卖的烟火气；周末早午餐时段极度热闹，想感受推车氛围建议上午 11 点左右到达。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹喧腾的传统广式大茶楼，推车穿梭，茶香四溢

highlights: Classic Chinatown pushcart Cantonese dim sum brunch
Steamy translucent shrimp dumplings, savory pork siu mai, and hot tea
options.description_zh: 唐人街经典手推车早茶老字号，阿姨沿桌叫卖，晶莹水晶虾饺、蟹籽烧卖皇与现拉肠粉怀旧地道。
highlights_zh: 唐人街经典推车传统早茶，阿姨沿桌推车叫卖点心
晶莹手作水晶虾饺配蟹籽烧卖皇，现拉嫩滑鲜虾肠粉
options.signature_dish_zh: 手推车传统鲜虾水晶虾饺与蟹籽烧卖

review_notes_en.summary: Classic Chinatown banquet hall preserving the nostalgic tradition of rolling dim sum pushcarts.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥟 Steaming Crystal Har Gow (Shrimp dumplings) & Pork Siu Mai topped with crab roe
🥢 Steamed Spare Ribs in black bean sauce, Honeycomb Taro Puffs & Fresh Shrimp Rice Noodle Rolls
review_notes_en.tips: Located in a grand 3rd-floor ballroom. The carts roll by continuously—just point to what looks hot and appetizing. Arrive around 11:00 AM on weekends for the liveliest vibe.
review_notes_en.vibe: Raucous, joyful traditional Cantonese tea parlor brimming with pushcarts, teapot clatter, and multigenerational families

options.name: Sunny's Chinese
options.signature_dish: Silver Needle Noodles & Charcoal Grilled Skewers
options.description: Vibrant Michelin Bib Gourmand hideaway tucked inside Kensington Market, serving smoky regional Chinese charcoal skewers and wok noodles.
options.address: 60 Kensington Ave, Unit 6-9, Toronto, ON M5T 2K1
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky charcoal cumin skewers, fiery Sichuan peppercorn, and chewy wok noodles
options.bullet_highlight: Michelin Bib Gourmand, intimate Kensington hideaway (Reservations required)

review_notes.summary: Michelin Bib Gourmand 必比登推介！隐藏在肯辛顿市场深处的时髦中式炭火小酒馆，订位极为抢手。
review_notes.must_try:
🍢 炭火烤串 (炭烤羊肉串、五花肉串)
🍜 招牌银针粉 (Silver Needle Noodles) & 火药辣子鸡 (Gunpowder Chicken)
review_notes.tips: 极具隐蔽感，入口在 Kensington Mall 小走廊内；座位有限极其火爆，必须提前在 OpenTable 抢预约，现场 walk-in 极难排到。
review_notes.vibe: 港风霓虹与复古工业结合的隐秘小酒馆，炭火烟气与动感节奏交织

highlights: Michelin Bib Gourmand, intimate Kensington hideaway (Reservations required)
Smoky charcoal cumin skewers, fiery Sichuan peppercorn, and chewy wok noodles
options.name_zh: Sunny's Chinese 肯辛顿炭火中餐
options.description_zh: 米其林必比登推介名店，隐藏在肯辛顿商场深处的时髦中式炭火小酒馆，招牌炭火烤串与手工银针粉。
highlights_zh: 米其林必比登推介，隐藏在商场走廊深处的港风酒馆
炭火果木烤羊肉串配镬气十足招牌自制银针粉
options.signature_dish_zh: 炭火果木烤羊肉串配招牌香炒银针粉
options.hours_note_zh: 周三至周日 17:00 - 22:30 (周一周二休息)

review_notes_en.summary: Michelin Bib Gourmand darling hidden deeply inside Kensington Mall, serving elevated regional Chinese over live charcoal.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍢 Charcoal-Grilled Lamb & Pork Belly Skewers with cumin
🍜 Signature Silver Needle Noodles & Fiery Gunpowder Chicken
review_notes_en.tips: Very discreet entrance tucked down an interior hallway in Kensington Market. Reservations drop weeks in advance and disappear in minutes; walk-ins are nearly impossible.
review_notes_en.vibe: Moody Hong Kong retro neon meets industrial speakeasy, pulsing with hip-hop beats and charcoal smoke

options.name: Queens Harbour
options.signature_dish: MediterrAsian Feast Platter & Spicy Rigatoni
options.description: Massive 23,000-sq-ft waterfront MediterrAsian palace with retractable glass roof, CN Tower lake views, live DJs, and shareable platters.
options.address: 245 Queens Quay W, Toronto, ON M5J 2K9
options.bullet_flavor: Must-order $160 sushi-and-steak feast platter, Spicy Vodka Rigatoni & Poison Ivy drink
options.bullet_highlight: 23,000 sq ft lakeside glasshouse with retractable roof, CN Tower view & nightly DJ

review_notes.summary: 多伦多绝美安大略湖景天花板！23000尺奢华玻璃房餐厅，抬头直面CN Tower，每晚7点DJ打歌，氛围与性价比拉满。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 招牌海陆盛宴拼盘 (含4款寿司卷、14oz肋眼牛排、6oz翼板牛排与松露薯条)
🍝 经典伏特加香辣粗管面 (Spicy Rigatoni Alla Vodka)
🍸 特调小甜酒 Poison Ivy (青苹果清香配Gin) & 土耳其咖啡浓缩马天尼
review_notes.tips: 傍晚日落时段来风景绝美，透过天窗仰望CN塔夜景非常震撼；鸡尾酒价格亲民（$13-17），甜点推荐开心果提拉米苏；周末建议提前在官网预订湖景佳座。
review_notes.vibe: 度假感十足的湖畔玻璃花房花园，夜晚DJ节拍与摩登都市霓虹

highlights: 23,000 sq ft lakeside glasshouse with retractable roof, CN Tower view & nightly DJ
Must-order $160 sushi-and-steak feast platter, Spicy Vodka Rigatoni & Poison Ivy drink
options.name_zh: Queens Harbour 湖景玻璃花房
options.description_zh: 23000尺奢华湖景玻璃房餐厅，抬头直面CN Tower，每晚7点DJ打歌，海陆盛宴拼盘与小甜酒性价比极高。
highlights_zh: 23000尺奢华湖畔玻璃房，仰望CN塔夜景，每晚7点现场DJ
必点$160超值海陆盛宴大拼盘、伏特加辣管面与Poison Ivy小甜酒
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌海陆盛宴大拼盘配伏特加辣通心粉
options.hours_note_zh: 周一至周日 12:00 - 次日凌晨 1:00 (周五周六至凌晨2:00)

review_notes_en.summary: Breathtaking 23,000 sq ft lakeside glasshouse restaurant facing the CN Tower, featuring live nightly DJs at 7 PM and stunning vacation energy.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 Signature Surf & Turf Feast Platter (4 sushi rolls, 14oz ribeye steak, 6oz flank steak, and truffle parmesan fries for $160)
🍝 Spicy Rigatoni Alla Vodka with house tomato chili cream
🍸 Poison Ivy Cocktail (Green apple and gin) & Turkish Coffee Espresso Martini
review_notes_en.tips: Arrive around sunset for panoramic Ontario lake views through the retractable glass ceiling. Cocktails are well-priced ($13–$17). Order pistachio tiramisu for dessert. Reserve waterfront seats online in advance.
review_notes_en.vibe: Resort-style lakefront botanical garden by day, turning into a high-energy urban lounge with DJ beats and neon by night

options.name: Kajiken
options.signature_dish: Homura Spicy Minced Pork Abura Soba with Onsen Tamago
options.description: Nagoya's famous soupless dry ramen specialist tossing springy thick noodles in aromatic chili oil, vinegar, and savory minced pork.
options.address: 214 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1Z2
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:30 AM - 10:30 PM, Fri-Sat 11:30 AM - 11:30 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Swirl chili oil & vinegar to emulsify the runny egg; free extra noodles or rice
options.bullet_highlight: Nagoya dry abura soba icon with springy noodles clinging to rich umami tare

review_notes.summary: 名古屋油拉面元祖歌志轩（Kajiken）DT分店！无汤干拌油面界的顶流，面条筋道Q弹挂汁无敌。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌焰油拉面 (Homura Abura Soba with spicy minced pork & onsen egg)
🥩 慢烤牛肉油拉面 (Roast Beef Abura Soba) & 炙烤叉烧油拉面
review_notes.tips: 上桌趁热根据教程沿碗淋 2 圈辣油与白醋，快速搅拌让半熟温泉蛋与浓郁酱汁完全乳化包裹每根面条；支持免费加面或加米饭拌剩余肉酱。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮温馨的日系拉面专门店，适合一人食快餐或好友结伴嗦面

highlights: Nagoya dry abura soba icon with springy noodles clinging to rich umami tare
Swirl chili oil & vinegar to emulsify the runny egg; free extra noodles or rice
options.description_zh: 名古屋油拉面元祖歌志轩DT店！无汤干拌油面界的顶流，面条筋道Q弹挂汁无敌，淋辣油与白醋快速乳化。
highlights_zh: 名古屋油拉面元祖品牌，面条筋道Q弹牢牢吸附秘制浓郁酱汁
趁热淋2圈辣油与白醋乳化半熟温泉蛋，免费续面或米饭拌肉酱
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌焰油拉面佐温泉蛋与秘制肉酱

review_notes_en.summary: The downtown Toronto outpost of Kajiken, the original pioneer of Nagoya-style dry abura soba noodles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Signature Homura Abura Soba (Spicy minced pork, fragrant fish powder, nori, scallions, and runny onsen egg)
🥩 Slow-Roasted Wagyu Beef Abura Soba with butter onion sauce & Torch-seared Chashu
review_notes_en.tips: Follow the house ritual upon serving: swirl 2 rounds of chili oil and rice vinegar around the piping-hot bowl, then toss vigorously so the runny onsen egg emulsifies into a creamy sauce coating every springy noodle strand. Free noodle or rice refills to mix with remaining pork sauce!
review_notes_en.vibe: Bright, cheerful modern Japanese ramen bar ideal for quick solo dining or casual noodle slurping with friends

options.name: Zakkushi on Queen
options.signature_dish: Binchotan Charcoal Yakitori & Kurobuta Don
options.description: Classic Queen West Japanese izakaya renowned for fragrant binchotan charcoal-grilled yakitori skewers and comforting savory rice bowls.
options.address: 620 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1E4
options.hours_note: Mon-Fri 5:30 PM - 12:00 AM, Sat-Sun 12:00 PM - 12:00 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky binchotan charcoal aroma on succulent chicken skewers and tender chashu don
options.bullet_highlight: Longstanding Queen West izakaya institution with authentic tavern energy and approachable pricing

review_notes.summary: Queen街超级老牌的日式炭火居酒屋，多年来价格亲民稳定，水族馆或逛街后绝佳聚餐据点。
review_notes.must_try:
🍢 备长炭烤串组合 (鸡肉丸子、烤鸡翅、牛舌、紫苏五花肉)
🍚 温泉蛋黑豚丼 / 烧肉丼 & 明太子乌冬
review_notes.tips: 串烧现点现烤镬气十足，外焦里嫩炭香浓郁；人均40刀左右性价比极高，建议提前定位或开门时前往。
review_notes.vibe: 烟火气十足的传统日式木质居酒屋，氛围热闹治愈

highlights: Classic Queen West charcoal-grilled yakitori tavern with authentic tavern bustle and steady pricing
Fragrant binchotan skewers alongside rich onsen egg chashu rice bowls for satisfying evening comfort
options.name_zh: ざっ串 炭火居酒屋 (Queen West)
options.description_zh: Queen街超级老牌正宗日式炭火居酒屋，以备长炭香气四溢的烧鸟串烧与浓郁温泉蛋烧肉丼饭闻名，性价比极佳。
highlights_zh: Queen街多年老牌日料居酒屋，人均40刀价格亲民且水准稳定
现烤备长炭烧鸟串焦香四溢，搭配温泉蛋黑豚丼治愈感满满
options.signature_dish_zh: 备长炭烤鸡肉串烧组合与温泉蛋黑豚丼

review_notes_en.summary: A beloved long-standing Queen West yakitori tavern celebrated for fragrant binchotan skewers, comforting donburi, and steady value.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍢 Charcoal Yakitori Platter (Tsukune chicken meatballs, chicken wings, beef tongue, shiso pork belly)
🍚 Kurobuta Pork Don with onsen egg & Mentai Carbonara Udon
review_notes_en.tips: Skewers are grilled to order over real binchotan charcoal for irresistible smoky char. At around $40/person, it's one of downtown's best izakaya values. Reserve ahead for weekend evenings.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm, bustling Japanese tavern filled with smoky charcoal aromas and cheerful izakaya chatter

options.name: Grandma Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Authentic Sichuan Spicy Chicken Pot & Dry Pot Cauliflower
options.description: Beloved Spadina Chinatown Sichuan kitchen serving hearty, authentic homestyle spicy chicken pots and generous stir-fries near UTSG.
options.address: 416 Spadina Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2G7
options.bullet_flavor: Fiery chili oil and bold Sichuan peppercorn heat with ultra-generous homestyle portions
options.bullet_highlight: UTSG student favorite along Spadina for authentic, heavily portioned Sichuan comfort

review_notes.summary: 唐人街靠近多大UTSG的正宗川菜小馆，分量极大、麻辣过瘾，是留学生课后聚餐与打包首选。
review_notes.must_try:
🥘 川味香辣柴火鸡煲 / 辣子鸡
🥦 干锅花菜 & 风味茄子 (下饭神器)
review_notes.tips: 菜量非常大且下饭，辣味地道浓烈，建议多叫几碗白米饭；稍微偏油润，重度嗜辣星人狂喜。
review_notes.vibe: 烟火气十足的亲切川味家常小馆，经济实惠分量足

highlights: UTSG student staple on Spadina serving intensely authentic, highly portioned Sichuan comfort
Sizzling spicy chicken pot and wok-tossed dry pot cauliflower delivering fiery chili-oil satisfaction
options.name_zh: 阿婆私房菜 (外婆私房菜)
options.description_zh: 唐人街靠近UTSG的正宗川菜私房馆，以超大分量的地道香辣鸡煲、干锅花菜与浓郁家常镬气闻名。
highlights_zh: UTSG留学生私藏DT川菜馆，菜量极其豪爽、性价比突出
正宗川式香辣鸡煲与干锅系列镬气十足，嗜辣星人下饭必吃
options.signature_dish_zh: 正宗川味香辣鸡煲与干锅花菜

review_notes_en.summary: A go-to Chinatown homestyle Sichuan eatery near UTSG campus, famous for enormous portions and fiery, authentic wok heat.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥘 Authentic Sichuan Spicy Chicken Pot / Chongqing Chili Chicken
🥦 Griddle Dry-Pot Cauliflower & Crispy Sweet-Savory Eggplant
review_notes_en.tips: Portions are impressively large with genuine Sichuan oil and numbing spice. Order extra steamed rice to mop up the rich sauces.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, casual neighborhood dining hall packed with students and spicy food enthusiasts

options.name: Sang's Great Seafood Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Nourishing Herbal Chicken Hot Pot & Fresh Hand-Cut Beef
options.description: Iconic Chinatown late-night destination celebrated for rich herbal chicken hot pots, fresh hand-cut beef, and soothing winter comfort.
options.address: 343 Spadina Ave, Toronto, ON M5T 2G3
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 4:00 PM - 2:00 AM, Fri-Sat 4:00 PM - 4:00 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Deep comforting herbal broth simmered with tender bone-in chicken and premium sliced meats
options.bullet_highlight: Toronto's legendary late-night chicken hot pot landmark, open until 4 AM for snowy night gatherings

review_notes.summary: 多伦多唐人街老字号深夜鸡锅天花板！冬天下雪或肝due夜聚首选，一碗热气腾腾的走地鸡汤暖心暖胃。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 招牌药膳走地鸡煲 / 胡椒猪肚鸡锅
🥩 手切新鲜牛小排、响铃卷与鲜打虾滑
review_notes.tips: 开锅先连喝两碗鲜美浓郁的鸡汤，鸡肉肉质紧实滑嫩毫不干柴；营业至凌晨2点到4点，宵夜神店。
review_notes.vibe: 热气氤氲、充满人情味的经典粤式宵夜打边炉氛围

highlights: Legendary Toronto late-night chicken pot institution open until 4 AM for winter night warmth
Simmered herbal bone-in chicken broth paired with tender chicken pieces and fresh hand-cut beef
options.description_zh: 多伦多唐人街老字号深夜暖胃鸡煲名店，以浓郁药膳走地鸡煲、鲜嫩鸡肉与深夜营业至凌晨闻名。
highlights_zh: 多伦多最火老字号鸡煲打边炉，冬天下雪天与朋友聚餐的暖胃顶流
药膳老鸡白汤浓郁鲜甜，走地鸡肉质紧实弹嫩，通宵营业至凌晨4点
options.signature_dish_zh: 多伦多经典药膳滋补走地鸡煲与手切肥牛

review_notes_en.summary: Toronto Chinatown's iconic late-night chicken hot pot staple, perfect for post-study sessions and freezing winter nights.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Signature Herbal Free-Range Chicken Pot / Pepper Pork Tripe Chicken Broth
🥩 Fresh Hand-Cut Beef, Ring Rolls & Handmade Shrimp Paste
review_notes_en.tips: Begin by ladling two comforting bowls of the rich aromatic broth before dipping fresh meats. Open until 2-4 AM for legendary midnight cravings.
review_notes_en.vibe: Steam-filled, bustling Cantonese late-night hot pot joint that instantly warms you up

options.name: Green Tea Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Bread Temptation & Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs
options.description: Famous Hangzhou Jiangnan chain featuring iconic Bread Temptation ice cream toast, caramelized sweet-and-sour ribs, and refined homestyle flavors.
options.address: 3235 Hwy 7 Unit 18, Markham, ON L3R 3P3
options.bullet_flavor: Delicate Jiangnan sweet-savory balance with buttery toasted bread and melting vanilla ice cream
options.bullet_highlight: Renowned Hangzhou casual dining chain famous for its signature Bread Temptation dessert and pleasant booth seating

review_notes.summary: 国内爆火的江浙菜绿茶餐厅万锦店！招牌面包诱惑无人能拒，甜口浓郁、菜品精致，极适合朋友聚餐。
review_notes.must_try:
🍞 招牌面包诱惑 (外脆内软黄油烤吐司堆香草冰淇淋)
🍖 绿茶糖醋小排 & 风味茄子 & 蒜蓉粉丝虾
review_notes.tips: 原DT店关闭后现迁至万锦Hwy 7；面包诱惑务必趁热吃，冰火交融的奶香极其惊艳；菜式偏江浙温润甜口。
review_notes.vibe: 雅致江南水乡中式卡座风格，安静舒适适宜聚餐交谈

highlights: Celebrated Hangzhou Jiangnan chain boasting cozy booth seating and approachable crowd-pleasing classics
Irresistible Bread Temptation hot buttered toast with melting ice cream alongside glossy sweet ribs
options.description_zh: 著名江浙菜连锁名店，以甜润适口的本帮糖醋小排、风味茄子与标志性甜品面包诱惑征服江南胃。
highlights_zh: 国内知名江浙菜品牌，卡座环境清幽雅致，适合朋友聚餐畅聊
无人能拒绝的招牌面包诱惑冰火交融，糖醋小排与茄子甜鲜浓郁
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌面包诱惑佐冰淇淋与本帮糖醋小排

review_notes_en.summary: The popular Hangzhou Jiangnan brand's Markham outpost, celebrated for sweet-savory classics and the legendary Bread Temptation dessert.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍞 Signature Bread Temptation (Golden toasted honey brioche topped with melting vanilla ice cream)
🍖 Sweet and Sour Pork Ribs & Flavorful Braised Eggplant & Garlic Vermicelli Shrimp
review_notes_en.tips: Formerly in downtown, now settled in Markham along Hwy 7. Eat the Bread Temptation immediately while the warm buttery toast contrasts with the ice cream.
review_notes_en.vibe: Graceful, contemporary Jiangnan garden-inspired interior with quiet, comfortable booth seating

options.name: Trattoria Nervosa
options.signature_dish: Mafalde ai Funghi & Grilled Octopus
options.description: Charming yellow-cottage Yorkville Italian institution famous for decadent truffle mushroom mafalde pasta, grilled octopus, and romantic date-night charm.
options.address: 75 Yorkville Ave, Toronto, ON M5R 1B8
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:30 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri-Sat 11:30 AM - 11:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Earthy white truffle cream sauce clinging to wavy mafalde pasta and tender charred octopus
options.bullet_highlight: Iconic two-storey yellow house in Yorkville boasting chic multi-level patios for romantic evenings

review_notes.summary: Yorkville奢侈品街旁的老牌地标级意餐！标志性黄色小洋楼与露台，约会、闺蜜小酌出片首选。
review_notes.must_try:
🍝 招牌黑松露菌菇波浪意面 (Mafalde ai Funghi)
🐙 香烤嫩章鱼 (Polpo) & 意式提拉米苏
review_notes.tips: 逛完Yorkville名店街后步行即达；Mafalde波浪意面挂满浓郁松露白酱，口感惊艳；夏秋露台与室内黄色小楼氛围感极佳。
review_notes.vibe: 浪漫时髦的约会胜地，黄昏时分华灯初上，微醺氛围感拉满

highlights: Iconic Yorkville yellow-house Italian landmark featuring romantic multi-tier patio seating
Rich truffle-cream mushroom mafalde pasta and tender grilled octopus for memorable date nights
options.name_zh: Trattoria Nervosa 意式约会餐厅
options.description_zh: Yorkville老牌地标级意式浪漫餐厅，坐落于标志性黄色小洋楼中，以浓郁黑松露菌菇意面与微醺约会氛围闻名。
highlights_zh: Yorkville奢侈品街老牌地标意餐，黄色小洋房与露台拍照超好看
招牌黑松露菌菇波浪面浓郁挂汁，香烤章鱼火候完美，约会微醺首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌黑松露牛肝菌波浪意面与香烤章鱼

review_notes_en.summary: An enduring Yorkville Italian landmark housed in a signature yellow cottage, legendary for romantic patio vibes and rich handmade pasta.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍝 Mafalde ai Funghi (Wavy pasta ribbon in decadent portobello, cremini, and white truffle cream)
🐙 Polpo (Char-grilled tender octopus) & Classic Tiramisu
review_notes_en.tips: Conveniently located right off the Bloor-Yorkville luxury shopping strip. The signature truffle mafalde is an absolute must-order for rich pasta lovers.
review_notes_en.vibe: Chic, intimate Yorkville institution with ambient lamp-lit evenings and fashionable buzz

options.name: Marugame Udon
options.signature_dish: Nikutama Udon with Sweet Beef & Onsen Egg
options.description: Famous open-kitchen Japanese cafeteria serving chewy freshly-kneaded Sanuki udon bowls and crispy hot tempura at affordable prices.
options.address: 494 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1X9
options.hours_note: Sun-Thu 11:00 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri-Sat 11:00 AM - 11:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Savory sweet-simmered beef, silky onsen tamago, and golden crispy shrimp or chicken tempura
options.bullet_highlight: Renowned Sanuki udon open kitchen with fast self-serve tempura bar and accessible prices

review_notes.summary: 全球知名赞岐乌冬专门店丸龟制面（Marugame Udon）多伦多DT首店！明档现做手打乌冬，出餐飞快且性价比极高。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 招牌牛肉温玉乌冬 (Nikutama Udon) / 浓郁咖喱乌冬 / 经典清汤乌冬 (Kake Udon)
🍤 现炸大虾天妇罗 & 炸鸡块 (Karaage) & 温泉蛋
review_notes.tips: 采用经典日式自选动线：先选面条碗型，再沿托盘自选刚出锅的酥脆天妇罗和小食，最后结账；设有免费天妇罗花（面衣碎渣）、葱花和生姜自取台。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮宽敞的热闹日式快餐食堂，出餐高效，一人食或快节奏便餐首选

highlights: Theatrical open kitchen crafting chewy made-from-scratch Sanuki udon with rich dashi broth
Fast self-serve cafeteria line with piping-hot golden tempura, sweet nikutama beef, and accessible pricing
options.description_zh: 享誉全球的赞岐乌冬面专门店DT首店！开放式厨房现揉现煮Q弹劲道乌冬，自选金黄现炸天妇罗，平价快捷一人食神店。
highlights_zh: 全球连锁赞岐乌冬名店DT首店，开放式明档现揉现煮，乌冬面条Q弹爽滑劲道
自助式点餐动线出餐极快，招牌牛肉温玉汤底浓郁，搭配酥脆现炸天妇罗性价比绝佳
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌牛肉温玉乌冬面佐现炸天妇罗

review_notes_en.summary: The celebrated global Sanuki udon specialist's downtown Toronto debut on Yonge, delivering handmade chewy noodles and quick self-serve tempura.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Signature Nikutama Udon (Sweet-simmered beef & soft-poached onsen egg) / Rich Curry Udon / Classic Kake Udon
🍤 Freshly Fried Shrimp Tempura, Crispy Chicken Karaage & Zucchini Tempura
review_notes_en.tips: Follow the theater-style cafeteria line: choose your freshly made udon bowl at the open kitchen counter, grab crispy tempura from the heated racks, then pay. Stop by the condiment bar for complimentary green onions, grated ginger, and crispy tempura flakes.
review_notes_en.vibe: Bright, energetic Japanese open-kitchen canteen ideal for speedy solo dining and budget-friendly comfort eats

options.name: Kōst
options.signature_dish: Signature Sunset Cocktails & Tuna Tataki
options.description: Chic 44th-floor Bisha Hotel rooftop bar offering Baja-inspired cocktails, light coastal bites, and jaw-dropping CN Tower skyline panoramas.
options.address: 80 Blue Jays Way, 44th Floor, Toronto, ON M5V 2G3
options.hours_note: Mon-Sun 8:00 AM - 11:00 PM (Bar & Dinner from 5:00 PM)
options.bullet_flavor: Vibrant coastal citrus, agave spirits, refreshing tropical notes, and fresh seafood bites
options.bullet_highlight: Bisha Hotel 44th-floor rooftop oasis with infinity pool and unmatched CN Tower skyline vistas

review_notes.summary: 坐落于多伦多市中心Bisha精品酒店44层的顶级高空屋顶酒吧！紧邻CN塔与天际线无边泳池，俯瞰全城景致极其震撼。
review_notes.must_try:
🍸 招牌日落特调鸡尾酒 (Signature Sun-Drenched Cocktails) & 龙舌兰/梅斯卡尔特调
🍣 香煎金枪鱼塔塔 (Tuna Tataki) & 龙虾卷 / 松露薯条
review_notes.tips: 极力推荐在黄昏日落前半小时入座，能同时欣赏金色余晖洒在安大略湖和入夜后CN塔璀璨亮灯；露台高空风大，秋冬建议携带外套；强烈建议提前在官网OpenTable预订室内或露台靠窗座位。
review_notes.vibe: 时髦奢华的高空度假风屋顶酒吧，全景观落地窗与无边泳池景致，约会拍照绝佳

highlights: Glamorous 44th-floor rooftop lounge boasting panoramic CN Tower views, infinity pool, and vibrant coastal vibes
Baja-inspired craft cocktails paired with light seafood bites, perfect for golden hour and late-night drinks
options.name_zh: Kōst 屋顶高空全景酒吧餐厅
options.description_zh: 坐落于Bisha酒店44层的标志性高空屋顶酒吧，坐拥无边泳池与近在咫尺的CN塔天际线绝美日落全景，氛围感拉满。
highlights_zh: Bisha酒店44层标志性高空天台，正对CN塔与城市天际线，黄昏日落与无边泳池景观绝美
主打加州海岸风情特调鸡尾酒与精致轻食小点，约会、闺蜜聚会与夜景观光微醺首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 特调高空日落鸡尾酒与香煎金枪鱼塔塔

review_notes_en.summary: Perched on the 44th floor of Bisha Hotel, Kōst is one of downtown Toronto's premier rooftop lounges, offering sweeping skyline and CN Tower views.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍸 Signature Coastal Agave Cocktails & Refreshing Sunset Spritzes
🍣 Ahi Tuna Tataki, Fresh Guacamole with Taro Chips & Crispy Calamari
review_notes_en.tips: Book a reservation for golden hour (30-45 minutes before sunset) to catch breathtaking colors reflecting off Lake Ontario and the CN Tower illuminations. Tables fill up quickly on weekends; reservations via OpenTable are strongly recommended.
review_notes_en.vibe: Upscale, breezy Californian coastal retreat in the sky with floor-to-ceiling glass and lively music

options.name: Xi Noodle House
options.signature_dish: Shanxi Oil-Splashed Noodles (You Po Mian)
options.description: Trendy Shanxi knife-cut noodle spot on Yonge St with sizzling oil-splashed noodles, wandza noodles and lunch queues.
options.address: 510 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4Y 1X9
options.bullet_flavor: Fiery oil-splashed noodles with rich, savory wandza broth
options.bullet_highlight: UT student noodle canteen with hand-cut Shanxi noodles

review_notes.summary: DTYonge街新开的山西刀削面馆，明厨现制，油泼面与豌杂面都是热门，午饭与下课排号等位要耐心。
review_notes.must_try:
🍅 特色油泼面（牛肉/猪肉，柿子鸡蛋卤中和微辣）
🌶️ 特色豌杂面（麻酱浓汤底，半个卤蛋）
review_notes.tips: 人多时油泼面出餐较慢，急的话可电话takeout；现金付款有折扣，记得带现金。
review_notes.vibe: 小店面明厨亮灶， UT学生食堂级热闹，适合一人食快吃

highlights: New Shanxi knife-cut noodle spot on Yonge with banging oil-splashed noodles
Hand-cut noodles with rich wandza broth, cash discount and steady lunch queues
options.description_zh: DT Yonge街新开的山西刀削面馆，主打手工刀削面，特色油泼面与豌杂面口碑火，学生午饭常常要排号。
highlights_zh: DT Yonge街山西刀削面新店，油泼面与豌杂面深受好评
明厨亮灶现制手削面，现金优惠，UT学生食堂首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 特色油泼面与豌杂面

review_notes_en.summary: Newly opened Shanxi knife-cut noodle house at 510 Yonge serving hot oil-splashed and wandza noodles, very popular with UT students.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍅 Signature You Po Noodles (beef or pork, mildly spicy with tomato-egg sauce)
🌶️ Signature Wandza Noodles (rich sesame paste broth, half braised egg)
review_notes_en.tips: Peak lunch lines can mean long waits; call ahead for takeout. Cash payments get a discount.
review_notes_en.vibe: Compact open-kitchen noodle canteen, fast-casual and student-heavy

options.name: Los Gyros
options.signature_dish: Molcajete Los Gyros (sizzling volcanic stone platter)
options.description: Generous North York Mexican taqueria known for meat-loaded taco platters, sizzling molcajete platters and fast casual energy.
options.address: 816 Sheppard Ave W, Toronto, ON M3H 2T1
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky grilled meats, al pastor pork and fiery molcajete skillet
options.bullet_highlight: Loaded taco platters and a sizzling volcanic-stone molcajete built for sharing

review_notes.summary: 北约克市头地道墨西哥馆子，偏街头风而非精致摆盘，肉给得实在，适合多人多点几种taco和molcajete一起分享。
review_notes.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter（Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero 混搭）
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros（火山石锅杂烩，pork chop/chorizo/牛排/虾一锅）
review_notes.tips: 4点左右去不用排太久；牛舌taco炖得软嫩，喜欢牛舌的可以点；一定要挤 lime。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹的墨西哥街头风小馆，conceptual for group sharing

highlights: Authentic North York Mexican spot with generous, street-style portions
Sizzling molcajete stone platters and loaded taco platters built for sharing
options.description_zh: 北约克高人气墨西哥馆，主打街头风Taco拼盘与滋滋作响的Molcajete火山石锅，够朋友聚餐点一桌。
highlights_zh: 北约克地道墨西哥菜馆，肉给得很大方，街头风
招牌火山石锅Molcajete与Taco拼盘，适合多人分享
options.signature_dish_zh: Molcajete 火山石锅杂烩

review_notes_en.summary: Popular North York taqueria with street-style vibes, meat-heavy taco platters and a showpiece sizzling molcajete.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌮 Taco Platter (Al Pastor / Carne Asada / Suadero mix)
🔥 Molcajete Los Gyros (volcanic stone platter with pork chop, chorizo, steak and shrimp)
review_notes_en.tips: Go around 4pm to dodge the line; the lengua (beef tongue) taco is tender and worth trying; finish with lime.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively, street-style Mexican taqueria perfect for group meals

options.name: Good Luck HK Cafe
options.signature_dish: Char-Grilled Mixed Meat Rice (Oily Rush over Rice)
options.description: North York Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro-red plates, Michelin-designed dinner set and smoky grilled meat rice bowls.
options.address: 5533 Yonge St, North York, ON M2N 7L3
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky char-grilled meats with hearty HK-style rice and claypot dishes
options.bullet_highlight: Retro cha chaan teng vibe with a Michelin-inspired dinner set menu

review_notes.summary: 北约克的茶餐厅，号称晚餐菜单请米其林厨师设计，红色复古餐具氛围感满分，烧腊饭与海鲜炖饭都惊喜。
review_notes.must_try:
🍚 黯然销魂烧腊饭（各式烧腊肉铺满，锅巴米饭绝了）
🦐 潮式海鲜炖饭（海鲜香奶香的潮式 risotto）
review_notes.tips: 晚餐有茶餐厅常规菜单加特别套餐，选择多；烟熏烤串、生腌泰式扇贝也不错；人均约35刀。
review_notes.vibe: 复古红色餐盘茶餐厅，晚餐氛围感十足，适合漂亮饭

highlights: Hong Kong-style cha chaan teng with retro red plates and Michelin-designed dinner set
Char-grilled meat rice bowls and smoky skewers are the signature comfort hits
options.description_zh: 北约克人气港式茶餐厅，主打复古红盘氛围与请米其林厨师设计的晚餐特别菜单，黯然销魂烧腊饭与潮式海鲜炖饭是招牌。
highlights_zh: 港式茶餐厅，红盘复古美学，晚餐菜单据说请米其林厨师设计
招牌黯然销魂烧腊饭与烟熏烤串，是北约克的漂亮饭晚餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 黯然销魂烧腊饭

review_notes_en.summary: Trendy North York cha chaan teng with retro-red dishware, a Michelin-designed dinner set and crowd-pleasing char-grilled rice bowls.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍚 Signature Char-Grilled Mixed-Meat Rice (layers of roast meats with crispy rice crust)
🦐 Chaoshan-Style Seafood Risotto (savory seafood-scented rice casserole)
review_notes_en.tips: Dinner offers both a standard cha chaan teng menu and a special set menu; smoky skewers and Thai-style marinated scallops are also great. Expect roughly $35 per person with tax and tip.
review_notes_en.vibe: Retro HK diner atmosphere with red plates, ideal for a cozy date-night dinner

options.name: Pears Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Taro & Mochi Pie with coconut cream
options.description: Stylish Markham Asian brasserie by chef Keith Pears serving inventive fusion plates, moody cocktails and buzzy date-night energy.
options.address: 8130 Birchmount Rd, Markham, ON L6G 0E4
options.bullet_flavor: Inventive Asian-fusion plates, mala cream udon and taro mochi dessert
options.bullet_highlight: Chef Keith Pears' buzzy brasserie with moody cocktails and plant-filled space

review_notes.summary: 万锦人气融合菜馆，简约高级感+绿植，适合约会；韩式炸鸡slider、花生酱鸡沙爹、麻辣奶油乌冬与芋泥麻薯派都值得点。
review_notes.must_try:
🍔 Sliders（甜辣韩式炸鸡迷你堡）
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara（乌冬+麻辣奶油+温泉蛋）
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie（千层酥皮芋泥麻薯派）
review_notes.tips: 人很多但不吵不挤，动静好；热门cocktail如Zavatar（烟熏泡泡）、Plum Seika点燃火焰出品很有仪式感。
review_notes.vibe: 简约高级感的绿植餐厅，夜晚灯光氛围适合date night

highlights: Buzzy Markham brasserie by Chef Keith Pears with inventive Asian-fusion plates
Mala cream udon, taro mochi pie and theatrical cocktails set the mood
options.description_zh: 万锦人气融合餐厅，主厨Keith Pears 打造，绿植空间氛围感好，招牌菜包括麻辣奶油乌冬、芋泥麻薯派与主题鸡尾酒。
highlights_zh: 万锦约会首选融合菜馆，简约高级感绿植空间
麻辣奶油乌冬、韩式炸鸡slider与芋泥麻薯派人气出圈
options.signature_dish_zh: 麻辣奶油乌冬与芋泥麻薯派

review_notes_en.summary: Locally beloved Markham fusion restaurant with sleek plant-filled interiors, inventive small plates and showy cocktails.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍔 Sliders (sweet-spicy Korean fried chicken sliders)
🍝 Mala Cream Carbonara (udon, spicy cream sauce, onsen egg)
🥧 Taro & Mochi Pie (taro-mochi filled mille-feuille pastry)
review_notes_en.tips: Busy but never cramped; order one of the signature cocktails like Zavatar (smoky bubble) or Plum Seika (flamed) for full theatre.
review_notes_en.vibe: Slick, green-accented date-night dining room with buzzy but relaxed energy

options.name: Wanaag Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Lamb Rice (Luqmaister-style Somali lamb platter)
options.description: Authentic halal Somali grill spot on Parliament St with generous lamb rice platters, aromatic spice rice and cozy dining.
options.address: 224 Parliament St, Toronto, ON M5A 3A4
options.bullet_flavor: Aromatic Somali-style spice rice piled with fall-off-the-bone lamb
options.bullet_highlight: Halal Somali grill serving famous, generous lamb rice platters

review_notes.summary: Parliament街的索马里餐馆，清真，羊排饭是明星，分量大、香料饭入味，一口秒变dt人。
review_notes.must_try:
🐑 羊排饭 / Lamb Rice
🍚 香料米饭 / Biskut-spiced rice
review_notes.tips: 人均20刀出头能吃很好；羊排入味，推荐直接点lamb rice试水。
review_notes.vibe: 温馨平价的索马里馆子，适合一两个人慢慢吃

highlights: Parliament St halal Somali grill with fragrant spice rice and generous lamb
Signature lamb rice platter draws queues from across downtown Toronto
options.description_zh: Parliament街地道清真索马里馆，主打香料米饭与大份羊排饭，性价比高，是dt人心里的小众宝藏。
highlights_zh: dt Parliament街的清真索马里馆，人气很高
招牌羊排饭分量足、香料香浓，人均约20刀
options.signature_dish_zh: 羊排饭

review_notes_en.summary: Cozy Parliament St halal Somali eatery famous for aromatic spice rice and hearty lamb platters.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐑 Lamb Rice platter
🍚 Fragrant Somali spice rice
review_notes_en.tips: Around $20 per person gets you a very satisfying meal; the lamb is tender and flavorful.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm, budget-friendly Somali spot, great for a relaxed lunch

options.name: Hanson Mandu
options.signature_dish: Handmade Dumplings (Mandu) & Beef Kalguksu
options.description: Scarborough Korean comfort spot popular for handmade jumbo mandu, fiery jjamppong and slow-simmered gamjatang hot pot.
options.address: 3330 Pharmacy Ave, Scarborough, ON M1W 3V8
options.bullet_flavor: Handmade dumplings, rich beef kalguksu and fiery seafood jjamppong
options.bullet_highlight: Scarborough Korean comfort food with daily fresh handmade mandu

review_notes.summary: 士嘉堡人气韩餐馆，手工饺子、刀削面、泡菜汤锅一条龙，午市特价很划算，排队也值。
review_notes.must_try:
🥟 手包大王饺 / Handmade Jumbo Mandu
🍜 牛肉刀削面 / Beef Kalguksu
🍲 辣海鲜炸酱面 / Jjamppong
review_notes.tips: 午市特价lunch special划算；店里可堂食可打包，可刷​​银联；停车场充足。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹的士嘉堡韩餐，朋友来多人聚餐都合适

highlights: Scarborough Korean comfort spot with daily handmade jumbo mandu
Beef kalguksu, fiery jjamppong and gamjatang hot pot anchor the menu
options.description_zh: 士嘉堡人气韩餐馆，主打每日手工大颗饺子、牛肉刀削面与辣海鲜炸酱面子，午市特价性价比高。
highlights_zh: 士嘉堡人气韩餐馆，午市特价实惠
招牌每日手工大颗饺子，刀削面与炸酱面都值得点
options.signature_dish_zh: 手工大颗饺子与牛肉刀削面

review_notes_en.summary: Popular Scarborough Korean eatery known for daily handmade dumplings, rich noodle soups and steamy hot pots.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥟 Handmade Jumbo Mandu
🍜 Beef Kalguksu
🍲 Fiery Seafood Jjamppong
review_notes_en.tips: Look out for the lunch special deals; ample parking in the plaza; dine-in and takeout both easy.
review_notes_en.vibe: Buzzy, casual Korean comfort-food crowd, good for small groups

options.name: Trio Pastry Cafe
options.signature_dish: French-style Pastry & Signature Croissant
options.description: Cute Unionville patisserie cafe serving fresh French-style pastries, specialty coffee and Instagram-worthy sweet treats.
options.address: 147A Main Street Unionville, ON
options.bullet_flavor: Buttery fresh French-style pastries and flaky croissants
options.bullet_highlight: New Unionville patisserie cafe with photogenic French-style sweets

review_notes.summary: Unionville新开的法式甜品cafe，地中海风装潢超出片，甜品爆表，适合朋友聚会逛完来歇歇。
review_notes.must_try:
🥐 经典牛角包
🍰 当日法甜拼盘
review_notes.tips: 只营业周四至周日，中午9:30开到晚上7点；人开始多了，周末来早点。
review_notes.vibe: 明亮的地中海风cafe，氛围感很好

highlights: New Unionville cafe-patisserie with Mediterranean-style decor worth an Nth visit
Fresh French-style pastries and flaky croissants baked for dessert runs
options.description_zh: Unionville新开的法式甜品咖啡馆，地中海风装潢出片，招牌是法式可颂与当日现做甜品。
highlights_zh: Unionville值得反复去的法甜cafe
现做可颂与现做法式甜品，装潢风格很出片
options.signature_dish_zh: 法式可颂与当日现做甜品

review_notes_en.summary: Trendy new patisserie cafe in Unionville with Mediterranean-style decor and consistently good French pastries.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥐 Classic croissant
🍰 Daily assorted French pastries
review_notes_en.tips: Open Thu-Sun only, 9:30am-7pm; arrive early on weekends as lines are forming.
review_notes_en.vibe: Bright, photogenic cafe with a relaxed sweet-treat atmosphere

options.name: La Salumeria
options.signature_dish: Italian Submarine Sandwich (Prosciutto & Veal)
options.description: Heritage Yonge & Eglinton Italian deli and sandwich counter, slicing prosciutto and stacking sublime Italian subs since 1984.
options.address: 2021 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M4S 2A2
options.bullet_flavor: Slow-piled Italian cold cuts, veal and prosciutto on crusty sub rolls
options.bullet_highlight: Beloved Yonge & Eglinton Italian deli sandwich institution since 1984

review_notes.summary: Yonge & Eglinton老牌意大利三明治店，1984年开业，一口就镇住，午饭选它不会后悔。
review_notes.must_try:
🥪 意大利三明治 / Italian Submarine Sandwich
🥩 小牛肉三明治 / Veal Sandwich
review_notes.tips: 主要是外带/快餐式吃法，午饭前来排队人多；三明治夹料足，适合两人一起分享一份大包。
review_notes.vibe: 老字号意大利deli，简单快捷但味道极扎实

highlights: Loved Yonge & Eglinton Italian deli sandwiches since 1984
Flavor-packed prosciutto and veal subs on crusty, carb-loaded rolls
options.name_zh: La Salumeria 意大利三明治
options.description_zh: Yonge & Eglinton开业40多年的老牌意大利deli，以prosciutto、veal与意式三明治别具一格，午饭外带圣地。
highlights_zh: Yonge & Eglinton老字号意大利deli，自1984年开业
一口即封神的意式三明治，肉夹得足，午饭外带首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 意式三明治（Prosciutto / Veal）

review_notes_en.summary: Long-standing midtown Italian deli-sandwich counter beloved for crusty, overstuffed Italian subs.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥪 Italian submarine sandwich
🥩 Veal sandwich
review_notes_en.tips: Primarily takeout; lines build around lunch. Sandwiches are hearty enough to share.
review_notes_en.vibe: No-frills heritage deli counter, quick and satisfying

options.name: Lost in Tokyo
options.native_name: ロスト・イン・トーキョー
options.signature_dish: Japanese Parfait & Matcha Dessert
options.description: Retro Showa-era Japanese cafe on Queen West, famous for Japanese parfaits, matcha gelato and a nostalgic Tokyo back-alley vibe.
options.address: 636 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1E4
options.hours_note: Mon-Wed 1:00 PM - 7:00 PM, Thu-Fri 1:00 PM - 6:00 PM, Sat-Sun 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Layered Japanese parfaits, matcha gelato and nostalgic melon soda
options.bullet_highlight: Toronto's first specialty Japanese parfait cafe with a Showa-era Tokyo vibe

review_notes.summary: Queen West的昭和风日式小店，主打日式可尔比特/刨冰，适合小酌或甜品下午茶，打卡效果很好。
review_notes.must_try:
🍓 日式甜品拼盘 Parfait
🍵 抹茶甜品 / Matcha dessert
review_notes.tips: Mon-Wed 1-7pm, Thu-Fri 1-6pm, Sat-Sun 11am-6pm；旺时要排队，可预约。
review_notes.vibe: 昭和复古日式小店，出片的甜品下午茶据点

highlights: Queen West retro Japanese cafe with nostalgic Showa-era Tokyo atmosphere
Specialty Japanese parfaits, matcha gelato and melon soda for the perfect dessert stop
options.name_zh: Lost in Tokyo 刨冰日式甜品
options.description_zh: Queen West昭和風日式甜品咖啡廳，主打日式可爾必斯/刨冰、抹茶甜品，是多伦多打卡日式下午茶的排队小店。
highlights_zh: Queen West昭和复古风日式小店，打卡感直接拉满
招牌可尔比特/刨冰与抹茶甜品，约会下午茶首选
options.signature_dish_zh: 经典刨冰与抹茶甜品

review_notes_en.summary: Showa-style Japanese dessert cafe on Queen West with a nostalgic back-alley atmosphere and photogenic plating.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍓 Japanese parfait / shaved ice
🍵 Matcha dessert
review_notes_en.tips: Mon-Wed 1-7pm, Thu-Fri 1-6pm, Sat-Sun 11am-6pm. Expect short waits at peak times; reservations helpful.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cozy retro Japanese cafe with strong aesthetic, ideal for dessert and cocktails

options.name: Qing Bistro
options.signature_dish: Yunnan-Style Black Pepper Beef Ribs with Purple Sweet-Potato Rice Cake
options.description: Markham's viral Yunnan-Guizhou-Sichuan fusion bistro, tiny dining room, viral Black-Pepper Beef Ribs and signature rice dessert.
options.address: Unit 18, 11 Fairburn Dr, Markham, ON L6G 0A4
options.bullet_flavor: Bold Yunnan spice and truffle rice bowls with bright, aromatic Guizhou accents
options.bullet_highlight: RedNote-famous Yunnan bistro with viral Black-Pepper Beef Ribs and taro dessert

review_notes.summary: 万锦爆款云贵川Bistro，排号要等，菜品基本不踩雷，人均含税加小费约80刀。
review_notes.must_try:
🐂 年糕烧牛肋
🐸 佛手瓜酸辣木姜子牛蛙
🍄 黑松露山菌炊香饭
🍨 招牌山野包谷粑
review_notes.tips: 店小等位久，建议5点开门就去或提前取号；酸汤酱菜口味偏淡，需要蘸辣粉；蘸酱不辣可微辣。
review_notes.vibe: 13桌小馆子，晚去等翻台，环境小但菜品出片

highlights: Viral Markham Yunnan fusion bistro with a tiny dining room and long lines
Black-pepper beef ribs, truffle forest rice and signature sweet rice dessert
options.description_zh: 万锦人气爆棚云贵川Bistro，小馆子排队等到心跳都要停，黑椒牛肋、黑松露炊饭和招牌包谷粑各一。
highlights_zh: 万锦RedNote爆款云贵川Bistro，人均约80刀
招牌黑椒牛肋+黑松露炊饭+山野包谷粑，晚茶氛围好
options.signature_dish_zh: 年糕烧牛肋与黑松露炊香饭

review_notes_en.summary: RedNote-viral Yunnan-Guizhou-Sichuan fusion bistro in Markham with a tiny 13-table dining room and unforgettable signature dishes.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐂 Braised Beef Short Ribs with Purple Sweet-Potato Rice Cake
🐸 Golden Squash & Beef Frog in Sour-Spicy Broth
🍄 Truffle Forest-Mushroom Rice
🍨 Signature Mountain Corn-Pudding Dessert
review_notes_en.tips: Arrive at 5pm opening to avoid long waits; char-grilled pork neck leans mild, dip in chili powder.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cozy, photogenic tiny bistro for group sharing and late-night bites

options.name: Tis Two Cities
options.signature_dish: Bamboo-Shoot & Sausage Clay Pot (Sichuan Hooneng Braised Duck)
options.description: Hidden精致Sichuan creative-fusion restaurant on the Etobicoke waterfront, scenic dining room and one-meal-perfection sets.
options.address: 122 Marine Parade Dr, Toronto, ON M8V 0E7
options.bullet_flavor: Signature bamboo-shoot sausage clay pot and fragrant wild turkey soup
options.bullet_highlight: Lake-side精致Sichuan creative fusion worth a dedicated trip

review_notes.summary: Etobicoke湖畔的精致融合川菜馆，环境绝美，菜品从前菜川味香肠到主菜白虾啫啫煲都经得起一试。
review_notes.must_try:
🥓 前菜川味香肠
🦐 白虾啫啫煲
🦆 川味油封鸭腿
review_notes.tips: 两人set约$165较划算；内部装修美适合约会；如果带狗，patio区可以就座。
review_notes.vibe: 湖边view美术馆级装潢，约会必去川菜漂亮饭

highlights: Etobicoke湖畔的精致融合川菜馆，环境超美
川味香肠、白虾啫啫煲、酥和普洱茶打完一顿完美闭合
options.description_zh: Etobicoke湖畔的精致融合川菜馆，建筑和菜品都很出片，主打前菜川味香肠与白虾啫啫煲。
highlights_zh: Etobicoke湖畔超美环境的精致川菜漂亮饭
白虾啫啫煲+川味香肠+酥和普洱茶，适合约会
options.signature_dish_zh: 白虾啫啫煲

review_notes_en.summary: Scenic Etobicoke waterfront restaurant with refined川菜fusion menus, recommended for date nights and pretty dinner sets.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥓 Sichuan sausage starter
🦐 Shrimp in sizzling clay pot
🦆 Sichuan confit duck leg
review_notes_en.tips: Two-person set around $165 is a good deal; the interior is highly photogenic and dog-friendly spaces exist on patio.
review_notes_en.vibe: Beautiful, arty waterfront Chinese restaurant built for Instagram and date nights

options.name: Good Brothers BBQ
options.signature_dish: Northeastern Chinese BBQ Skewers (Instant grilled skewers)
options.description: Dundas St W late-night Northeastern Chinese skewer grill, famous for 王繁星拌面 and 奶皮子酸奶, open till 2am.
options.address: 472 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M5T 1G9
options.bullet_flavor: Northeastern-style charcoal skewers with signature王繁星拌面 sauce drizzle
options.bullet_highlight: Late-night Chatham-sweet-skewer canteen open until 2am on Dundas

review_notes.summary: Spadina/Dundas的东北烤串店，营业到凌晨两点，番茄流沙蛋拌面是招牌，一哆嗦停不下来。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 番茄流沙蛋拌面
🍜 猪肝肥肠拌面
🥛 奶皮子酸奶
review_notes.tips: 周末晚上去要早点，容易排队；拌面流沙蛋拌一拌再吃；茉莉绝弦茶搭配很清爽。
review_notes.vibe: 夜市烧烤style摊点，适合朋友夜聚串串

highlights: Spadina-Dundas东北烤串店，营业到凌晨2点是深夜人气王
番茄流沙蛋拌面+奶皮子酸奶，拌面爱好者别错过
options.description_zh: Dundas & Spadina夜宵东北烤串店，宵夜营业到凌晨2点，番茄流沙蛋拌面和奶皮子酸奶是种草爆款。
highlights_zh: 夜间人气王街边烤串，营业到凌晨两点
招牌拌面番茄流沙蛋+奶皮子酸奶，深夜冲动必点
options.signature_dish_zh: 番茄流沙蛋拌面与奶皮子酸奶

review_notes_en.summary: Big Northeastern-Chinese late-night BBQ skewer shop near Spadina, full of life in the evenings with addictive tomato-lava-egg noodles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Tomato-Lava-Egg Noodles
🍜 Pork Liver & Intestine Noodles
🥛 Milk-Skin Yogurt
review_notes_en.tips: Weekend evenings need early arrivals or a beat; finish your noodles with the creamy lava sauce mixed in.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lively late-night skewer canteen, go with a group

options.name: Muay Thai Bar & Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Pad Kra Pao & Thai Beef Steak (Crying Tiger Picanha)
options.description: Muay Thai-themed Thai restaurant on Queen West with big-screen fights, papaya salads, cocktails and crying-tiger steak.
options.address: 325 Queen St W, Toronto, ON
options.bullet_flavor: Spicy Thai wok dishes, papaya salads and a Thai-cocktail bar
options.bullet_highlight: Muay Thai-themed dinner spot with live fight broadcasts on big screens

review_notes.summary: Queen West的泰拳主题餐厅，整个店围绕Muay Thai文化设计，大屏幕放泰拳比赛，还有Thai cocktail bar，朋友聚餐或夜晚约会都合适。
review_notes.must_try:
🥗 海鲜木瓜沙拉
🍳 泰打抛饭
🥩 Crying Tiger Picanha
review_notes.tips: 打抛饭一定要戳开流心蛋黄拌米饭；海鲜青木瓜沙拉鱼露味偏重，不吃鱼露的要谨慎；天气好可以逛完Queen West再来。
review_notes.vibe: 泰拳氛围感做得完整的小馆子，边吃边看电视上的泰拳比赛

highlights: Muay Thai-themed Thai restaurant with fight broadcasts on big screens
Pad kra pao with runny egg, papaya salads and Thai cocktails head the menu
options.name_zh: Muay Thai Bar & Restaurant 泰拳馆
options.description_zh: Queen West一家围绕Muay Thai泰拳文化设计的泰餐厅，大屏幕放比赛，还有泰式cocktail bar，菜本身也靠谱。
highlights_zh: Queen West泰拳主题餐厅，装修完整度很高
打抛饭、海鲜青木瓜沙拉和Crying Tiger牛排都值得点
options.signature_dish_zh: 泰式打抛饭与Crying Tiger牛排
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A complete Muay Thai-themed Thai restaurant on Queen W with fight broadcasts, Thai cocktails, and solid, non- gimmicky food.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥗 Seafood Papaya Salad
🍳 Pad Kra Pao
🥩 Crying Tiger Picanha
review_notes_en.tips: Pop the runny egg yolk on the pad kra pao and mix it through the pork and rice. If you dislike fish sauce, go easy on the papaya salad.
review_notes_en.vibe: Themed but delicious, great for groups or a fun date night

options.name: Tiger Blues
options.signature_dish: Kanpung Shrimp & Kimchi Tom Yum
options.description: Cute little Korean bar near Trinity Bellwoods park with supersized kanpung shrimp, galbi, and playful cocktails, happy hour deals.
options.address: 811 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1G1
options.bullet_flavor: Korean small plates, galbi and yuzu-soy Kanpung shrimp in a playful bar setting
options.bullet_highlight: Trendy Korean pojangmacha-style spot near Trinity Bellwoods with happy hours

review_notes.summary: Queen West 邻 Trinity Bellwoods的韩式小酒馆，装修可爱甜美，小份菜越出越厚实，性价比不错。
review_notes.must_try:
🍤 Kanpung Shrimp
🥩 Galbi
🍜 Kimchi Tom Yum
review_notes.tips: Happy Hour 不要错过；Yuzu Sour mocktail 和 Pere Colada 是好喝的果蔬特饮；点菜看着小但其实很实在。
review_notes.vibe: 韩剧氛围的小酒馆，适合Friends小酌和深夜吃夜宵

highlights: Playful Korean pojangmacha-style bar near Trinity Bellwoods with happy hour
Kanpung shrimp, yuzu-soy galbi and kimchi tom yum noodles are the standouts
options.description_zh: Trinity Bellwoods附近一家甜美韩式小酒馆，主打Kanpung虾、galbi和Kimchi冬阴功汤面，装修可爱、份量扎实。
highlights_zh: Queen West韩式小酒馆，Happy Hour性价比高
Kanpung虾和Kimchi Tom Yum是网红爆款，Yuzu Sour mocktail好喝
options.signature_dish_zh: Kanpung Shrimp 味噌虾与金芝泡面
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Playful Korean bar near Trinity Bellwoods with cute decor, happy hour, and packaged-full small plates.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍤 Kanpung Shrimp
🥩 Galbi
🍜 Kimchi Tom Yum
review_notes_en.tips: Don't miss happy hour. Dishes look small but are packed. Kanpung shrimp is the must-order.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cozy Korean-style tavern for small-group drinks and snacks

options.name: Karahi Boys
options.signature_dish: Potohari Chicken Karahi & Family Garlic Naan
options.description: Halal Pakistani karahi specialist on Queen W with a 4.8-star reputation, known for chicken karahi and buttery garlic naan.
options.address: 741 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1G1
options.hours_note: Mon-Thu 4:00 PM - 11:00 PM, Fri-Sat 1:00 PM - 12:00 AM, Sun 1:00 PM - 11:00 PM
options.bullet_flavor: Aromatic Pakistani-style chicken karahi with garlic naans
options.bullet_highlight: Queen West halal Pakistani spot with a 4.8-star local following

review_notes.summary: Queen West 上的巴基斯坦karahi专门店，google 4.8 star，chicken karahi和garlic naan是必点，羊肉也好吃。
review_notes.must_try:
⭐️ Potohari Boneless Chicken Karahi
⭐️ Family Naan (Garlic)
review_notes.tips: 咖喱味道香，菜偏咸——可点Pina Colada中和；能做两人份的family size naan适合分享；羊肉也值得试试。
review_notes.vibe: 热闹的巴基斯坦 karahi 小馆子，适合几个人一起share

highlights: Queen West Pakistani karahi joint with a 4.8-star local reputation
Chicken karahi and garlic naan are the signature, perfect komotions for sharing
options.description_zh: Queen West的巴基斯坦karahi馆子，鸡肉karahi和蒜香naan是店内爆款，清真halal，很适合朋友share。
highlights_zh: Queen West评分很高的清真巴基斯坦菜馆
鸡肉karahi和garlic naan是招牌，咖喱香浓
options.signature_dish_zh: Potohari 鸡肉 Karahi 与 蒜香 Naan

review_notes_en.summary: Popular halal Pakistani karahi restaurant on Queen W with a strong 4.8-star local reputation.
review_notes_en.must_try:
⭐️ Potohari Boneless Chicken Karahi
⭐️ Family Naan (Garlic)
review_notes_en.tips: Dishes can be seasoned fairly salty—order a Pina Colada to soften the heat; the goat karahi is also highly recommended by reviewers.
review_notes_en.vibe: Casual, lively Pakistani karahi spot for sharing a meal

options.name: Garden Express
options.signature_dish: Chicken Hot Pot Set (Chicken & Pork-Belly Soup Base)
options.description: Counter-service chicken hot pot and dumpling spot on Queen W near Bathurst, self-service, no-tipping, chicken sets for $58 sharing.
options.address: 604 Queen St W, Toronto, ON
options.bullet_flavor: Hearty self-service chicken hot pot with peppery pork-肚 broths
options.bullet_highlight: Bathurst & Queen W self-service chicken hot pot set, $58 serves three

review_notes.summary: Bathurst & Queen W自助鸡锅套餐馆，$58套餐含一整只鸡+虾+猪肚鸡汤底+药膳鸡汤底，三人合吃也就¥30/人，无需小费。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 鸡锅套餐（猪肚鸡+药膳鸡汤底）
🥟 蒸云吞（$4.99加料必点）
review_notes.tips: 两人基本吃扶墙走，建议三人一份更从容；蒸云吞是手工包的，辣味拌酱很好；套餐涨辣要谨慎。
review_notes.vibe: 公交自助style，快捷实惠的鸡锅店

highlights: Self-service chicken hot pot set on Queen W that feeds three for around $30 each
Steaming dumplings and peppery pork-belly broth are the fresh, handmade standouts
options.description_zh: Queen W & Bathurst街头的自助鸡锅套餐馆，$58套餐能供三人份量很足，蒸云吞和姜汁猪肚鸡都是亮点。
highlights_zh: Queen West平价鸡锅套餐馆，自助点单无需小费
蒸云吞、猪肚鸡和药膳鸡汤底是必点爆款
options.signature_dish_zh: 鸡锅套餐（猪肚鸡+药膳鸡汤底）
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Casual counter-service chicken hot pot by Bathurst & Queen W—$58 set feeds three and asks no tips.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Chicken hot pot set (pork-肚 & herbal base)
🥟 Steamed dumplings ($4.99 add-on)
review_notes_en.tips: $58 set can honestly feed three; add dumplings and a soup for the best comfort. No tipping needed.
review_notes_en.vibe: Street-side self-service hot pot spot with daytime comfort food

options.name: and/ore
options.signature_dish: Below-Ground Six-Course Tasting Menu ($175/pp)
options.description: Modern-Canadian Queen West cave: eclectic garden-party above, intimate underground六-course tasting menu with seasonal local ingredients.
options.address: 1040 Queen St W, Toronto, ON
options.bullet_flavor: Seasonal modern-Canadian tasting with playful small plates and creative plating
options.bullet_highlight: Underground cave tasting menu by Chef Missy Hui, a Toronto bucket-list dinner

review_notes.summary: Queen West安道尔洞穴餐厅，一层是花园party氛围bar，地下是洞穴风六道tasting menu，精致好看味道在线。
review_notes.must_try: 🌟 Below-Ground Tasting Menu ($175/pp, 8道+甜点)
review_notes.tips: 建议提前预约；一层偏bar，适合先来一杯再下地下用餐体验
review_notes.vibe: 地下洞穴风情，像穿越到另一个世界的氛围感漂亮饭

highlights: Queen West cave restaurant with garden-party dining above and cave-like tasting menu below
Seasonal modern-Canadian six-course tasting curated by Chef Missy Hui
options.description_zh: Queen West安道尔风情餐厅，一楼是Eclectic花园bar，地下层是洞穴风六道Tasting Menu，Chef Missy Hui 主理现代加拿大菜。
highlights_zh: Queen West洞穴风漂亮饭，地下层氛围感极强
六道tasting menu $175/pp，含额外甜点，适合约会生日
options.signature_dish_zh: 地下层六道Tasting Menu
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Modern-Canadian restaurant on Queen W with an eclectic garden party upstairs and an intimate cave-like underground tasting menu.
review_notes_en.must_try: 🌟 Below-Ground Tasting Menu ($175/pp, 8 courses + extra dessert)
review_notes_en.tips: Reservations recommended. Start with a drink at the above-ground bar before heading downstairs.
review_notes_en.vibe: Cave-chic dining room with a whimsical, immersive atmosphere

options.name: Mercado Restaurant

options.description: Leafy jungle-style Portuguese restaurant near Yorkdale with seafood rice, grilled dourada and duck rice, great for date-night拍照.

options.bullet_flavor: Portuguese seafood rice and duck rice in a lush jungle-themed room
options.bullet_highlight: Photogenic Portuguese date-night spot near Yorkdale with seafood platters

review_notes.summary: 离Yorkdale不远的丛林风葡萄牙餐厅，适合约会拍照，海鲜烩饭和海鲜拼盘是招牌，价格偏高。
review_notes.must_try:
🥘 海鲜烩饭
🦆 油封鸭腿饭 Arroz de Pato
🐠 烤海鲷鱼 Dourada
review_notes.tips: 有包间和大厂桌，适合生日约会；菜品价格偏高，建议提前预约。
review_notes.vibe: 丛林风装潢的精品葡萄牙菜馆，约会拍照胜地

highlights: Jungle-themed Portuguese restaurant near Yorkdale with beautiful decor
Seafood rice, seafood platter and duck rice are the celebrated dishes
options.description_zh: 离Yorkdale不远的葡萄牙丛林风餐厅，招牌海鲜烩饭、油封鸭腿饭和烤海鲷鱼，适合约会生日。
highlights_zh: 丛林风葡萄牙漂亮饭，约会拍照必选
招牌海鲜烩饭+油封鸭腿饭，味道浓重适合聚餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 海鲜烩饭与油封鸭腿饭
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Jungle-decorated Portuguese restaurant near Yorkdale, ideal for date nights with seafood rice and grilled sea bream.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥘 Seafood Rice
🦆 Duck Rice (Arroz de Pato)
🐠 Grilled Sea Bream (Dourada)
review_notes_en.tips: Book ahead for weekends; private rooms and large tables available for birthdays.
review_notes_en.vibe: Lush, photogenic Portuguese dining room with upbeat date-night energy

options.name: Pho Bun Bun

options.address: 7750 Kennedy Rd, Unit 7b, Markham, ON L3R 0A7
options.bullet_flavor: Tender deboned chicken thigh with turmeric rice and ginger-chili sauces
options.bullet_highlight: Threads-viral Hainan chicken rice and higher-grade Vietnamese noodles in Markham

review_notes.summary: Kennedy路上Vietnamese档，越南粉和顺化粉水准偏上，最近Threads爆红海南鸡饭$15.95大份划算。
review_notes.must_try:
🐔 海南鸡饭
🥩 炭烧薄切猪柳
🍢 串烧牛
review_notes.tips: 菜单上没有直接写海南鸡饭，看门口Happy Hour海报或直接问；姜黄饭略干可拌鸡汤；炭烧猪柳很入味。
review_notes.vibe: Markham平价Vietnamese，适合日常小聚

highlights: Kennedy Rd Vietnamese spot whose Hainan chicken rice went viral on Threads
Deboned chicken thigh, turmeric rice and ginger-chili dipping sauces, fresh mango salad
options.name_zh: Pho Bun Bun 越南餐厅
options.description_zh: Kennedy路上越南菜馆，海南鸡饭$15.95在Threads刷屏，去骨鸡腿肉+姜黄饭+酸芒果沙拉，性价比高。
highlights_zh: Threads爆款海南鸡饭，越南粉品质也越级
一份$15.95，划算到不行，适合两人份拼餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 海南鸡饭
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Higher-than-average Vietnamese restaurant on Kennedy Rd in Markham, recently viral on Threads for its value Hainan chicken rice.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐔 Hainan Chicken Rice
🥩 Charcoal-Grilled Thin-Sliced Pork
🍢 Beef Skewers
review_notes_en.tips: Hainan chicken rice isn't printed on the menu—check the door Happy Hour poster or ask. The turmeric rice can run dry; mix in chicken soup.
review_notes_en.vibe: Casual, budget-friendly Vietnamese joint in Markham

options.name: MISS QU CLAYPOT
options.signature_dish: Signature Clay Pot with Rice
options.description: Miss Qu Claypot's new Unionville branch on Hwy 7, known for signature clay-pot dishes and brand BBQ.
options.address: 3828 Hwy 7, Unit 2, Unionville, ON L3R 0B5
options.bullet_flavor: Sizzling signature clay pots and the BBQ that made Miss Qu famous
options.bullet_highlight: Miss Qu Claypot's new Unionville spot, HK-style clay-pot classics

options.description_zh: 曲小姐在Markham Town Square新开的砂锅店，特色砂锅下饭到位，烧烤延续老店水准，装修也上新。
highlights_zh: 曲小姐砂锅Markham新店，特色砂锅和烧烤都值得打卡
装修和口味都到夯，适合朋友聚餐下饭
options.signature_dish_zh: 特色砂锅与招牌烧烤
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Miss Qu Claypot's new Unionville branch delivers the brand's signature clay pots and famed BBQ in a fresh shop.

🍲 Signature clay pots
🍢 Miss Qu BBQ
review_notes_en.tips: Pair the clay pots with rice; the BBQ is even better than before.

options.bullet_highlight: Chef Alvin Leung's new chophouse in Downtown Markham, right by the carousel

Australian striploin, wagyu XO fried rice and scallop ceviche head the menu

highlights_zh: 梁经伦新开Pan-Asian chophouse，DT Markham旋转木马旁
招牌澳洲牛排16oz配双酱，和牛XO炒饭是绝配

review_notes_en.summary: Chef Alvin Leung's new Pan-Asian chophouse in Downtown Markham, functioning brilliantly as a steakhouse.

🥩 Australian Striploin 16oz
🍚 Wagyu XO Fried Rice
🦪 Scallop Ceviche

review_notes.summary: 北约克Yonge街新开居酒屋，接手指张亮麻辣烫旧址，牛舌、鸡肉串、鳗鱼饭和鮟鱇鱼肝都不踩雷，Google 4.5分。
review_notes.must_try:
🐟 Ankimo 鮟鱇鱼肝
🍢 鸡肉串 / 牛舌
🍱 鳗鱼饭
review_notes.tips: 柚子胡椒猪颈肉几乎不辣但香气足；开业期有9折；不用现金；小店建议错峰
review_notes.vibe: 安静温暖的新居酒屋，一个人吃或三五好友喝一杯都合适

highlights: New Willowdale izakaya at 5437 Yonge St, rated 4.5 on Google
Ankimo, charcoal skewers and a fresh-tasting unagi don are the draws
options.description_zh: 北约克Yonge街新开居酒屋，鮟鱇鱼肝、炭火串和鳗鱼饭都不踩雷，Google 4.5分，适合约会小聚。
highlights_zh: 北约克新开居酒屋，Google 4.5分
鮟鱇鱼肝+炭火串+鳗鱼饭，出品稳
options.signature_dish_zh: 鮟鱇鱼肝与鳗鱼饭
options.hours_note_zh: 周二至周日 16:30 起（请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A new North York izakaya that took over a Yonge Street storefront and earned 4.5 stars quickly.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐟 Ankimo
🍢 Charcoal chicken skewers
🍱 Unagi don
review_notes_en.tips: The citrus-pepper pork neck reads mild but fragrant; opening discounts were 10% off, no cash needed.
review_notes_en.vibe: Calm, warm new izakaya for solo dinners or a small group with drinks

options.name: Pizzeria Badiali
options.signature_dish: New York-Style Pepperoni & Burrata Slices
options.description: Mirvish Village slice shop from Toronto's cult pizzeria, baking crisp New York-style pizza.
options.address: 581 Markham St, Toronto, ON M6G 2L8
options.bullet_flavor: Crisp thin crust carrying house-made cheese, pepperoni and creamy burrata
options.bullet_highlight: Second slice shop for Toronto's most-hyped pizzeria, on a quiet Mirvish Village street

review_notes.summary: 多伦多最🔥的披萨终于开分店了，新店在Mirvish Village一条很宁静的小街上。艳阳高照的下午三点店里坐满了人，但基本上不用排队。
review_notes.must_try:
🍕 Pepperoni 经典切片
🧀 Burrata 切片
review_notes.tips: 原店（181 Dovercourt）高峰排队半小时起；这间分店错峰去轻松很多，店外就是安静的小社区。
review_notes.vibe: 宁静社区里的街边切片店，站着吃或打包带走都合适

highlights: Second slice shop for Toronto's most-hyped pizzeria
Crisp New York-style slices; a 3pm weekday visit means no line
options.name_zh: Pizzeria Badiali 披萨（Mirvish Village 分店）
options.description_zh: 多伦多最火披萨店开的第二家分店，藏在Mirvish Village的安静小街，纽约风味薄脆切片披萨。
highlights_zh: 多伦多最火披萨店的第二家分店
纽约风味薄脆切片，工作日下午三点来基本不用排队
options.signature_dish_zh: 纽约风味辣肠与布拉塔芝士切片披萨
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Toronto's most-hyped pizzeria finally opened a second slice shop on a quiet Mirvish Village street; the room was full at 3pm yet there was still no lineup.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍕 Pepperoni classic slice
🧀 Burrata slice
review_notes_en.tips: The Dovercourt original can queue over half an hour at peak; mid-afternoon here is calm.
review_notes_en.vibe: A neighbourhood slice counter on a residential block

options.name: Gryfe's Bagels
options.signature_dish: Goldie-lox Smoked Salmon Bagel Sandwich
options.description: A 1915 Hamilton bagel legend on Bathurst, known for impossibly soft, airy bagels.
options.address: 3421 Bathurst St, North York, ON M6A 2C2
options.bullet_flavor: Warm Everything bagel stacked with smoked salmon and a soft folded egg
options.bullet_highlight: A century-old Hamilton bakery with a bright, artisan workshop feel

review_notes.summary: 在多伦多住了十年才知道的传奇贝果店，曾有美国情侣博主一次买100多颗带回LA。1915年诞生于Hamilton，不是纽约也不是蒙特利尔风格。
review_notes.must_try:
🥯 Goldie-lox 贝果三明治（$11.99，选Everything bagel）
🍩 Cinnamon Sugar 肉桂糖贝果（卖得最好）
review_notes.tips: 店里明亮干净像匠人工坊，常客进门直接钦点；三明治整颗烤得热乎乎，非常扎实。
review_notes.vibe: 百年贝果工坊的气质，客人络绎不绝，多是不说二话的老主顾

highlights: Founded in Hamilton in 1915 and still baking on Bathurst Street
Soft, airy bagels; the $11.99 Goldie-lox sandwich is the order
options.description_zh: 1915年始于Hamilton的百年贝果老店，贝果松软有空气感，招牌Goldie-lox三明治值得一试。
highlights_zh: 1915年创立于Hamilton，至今仍在Bathurst街出炉
贝果松软不干噎，推荐11.99加元的Goldie-lox三明治
options.signature_dish_zh: Goldie-lox 烟熏三文鱼滑蛋贝果三明治
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A 111-year-old Hamilton bagel bakery that Toronto only recently discovered; a visiting US couple once bought more than a hundred to take back to Los Angeles.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥯 Goldie-lox smoked salmon and egg sandwich ($11.99)
🍩 Cinnamon sugar bagel, the top seller
review_notes_en.tips: Get the Everything bagel toasted warm with the soft egg; the sandwich is a solid, full meal.
review_notes_en.vibe: A bright, spotless bakery workshop full of regulars

options.name: Beijing Hot Pot Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Copper-Pot Lamb Rolls with House Sesame Dip
options.description: Ten-year-old North York copper-pot hotpot with all-you-can-eat lamb and beef rolls.
options.address: 107 Parkway Forest Dr Unit 1, North York, ON M2J 1L8
options.bullet_flavor: Thin-sliced lamb and beef swirled through a bubbling copper pot, dipped in sesame paste
options.bullet_highlight: Old Beijing charcoal copper-pot hotpot running all-you-can-eat for a decade

review_notes.summary: 多伦多少见的老北京铜锅，而且还是AYCE。以前在国内出差时就爱一个人躲起来麻酱涮牛羊肉，来多伦多后一直想念这口。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 手切羊肉
🥣 自制麻酱蘸料
review_notes.tips: AYCE比单点划算；麻酱是灵魂，怕腻可以让店员帮忙调一份广东式蘸料。
review_notes.vibe: 铜锅炭火的老北京氛围，适合多人围炉慢涮

highlights: Old Beijing charcoal copper-pot hotpot, all-you-can-eat for ten years
Rolls of lamb and beef finished in a house-made sesame dip
options.description_zh: 开了十年的老北京铜锅涮肉，AYCE自助手切牛羊肉配自制麻酱，冬天约饭首选。
highlights_zh: 经营十年的老北京炭火铜锅涮肉，AYCE自助
手切牛羊肉涮好后裹上自制麻酱，肉香浓郁
options.signature_dish_zh: 铜锅手切羊肉配自制麻酱
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: One of Toronto's few genuine Beijing charcoal copper-pot hotpots, and unusually it is all-you-can-eat.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Hand-sliced lamb
🥣 House sesame dipping sauce
review_notes_en.tips: Go for the AYCE option rather than ordering individually; the house sesame sauce is the point of the meal.
review_notes_en.vibe: Charcoal-fired copper pots and a long, unhurried communal dinner

options.name: Snowday Bingsu & Dessert Cafe
options.signature_dish: Tiramisu Bingsu
options.description: Church Street dessert cafe famous for tiramisu bingsu layered with cocoa and espresso.
options.address: 449 Church St, Toronto, ON M4Y 2C6
options.bullet_flavor: Milky snow ice with cocoa layers, condensed milk cream and a tiramisu wedge on top
options.bullet_highlight: A whole tiramisu wedge and a little pot of espresso to pour over the signature bowl

review_notes.summary: 收藏了很久的提拉米苏bingsu，上面有完整的提拉米苏切角，还有一小壶咖啡液，视觉效果💯。
review_notes.must_try:
☕️ 提拉米苏 Bingsu
🥛 牛奶味雪花冰配炼乳酱
review_notes.tips: 冰底奶香足、可可粉一层层铺，淋上咖啡液一点都不腻；咖啡本身中规中矩，bingsu才是重点。
review_notes.vibe: Church街上的韩式雪花冰店，适合两个人分一碗

highlights: Korean bingsu cafe in the Church-Wellesley village
Tiramisu bingsu with cocoa layers and a shot of espresso to pour over
options.description_zh: Church街的韩式甜品店，招牌提拉米苏雪花冰铺满可可粉，配一小壶浓缩咖啡液。
highlights_zh: Church-Wellesley社区的韩式雪花冰甜品店
提拉米苏雪花冰层层撒可可粉，配一小壶浓缩咖啡自己淋
options.signature_dish_zh: 提拉米苏雪花冰
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The tiramisu bingsu arrives with a whole slice of tiramisu on top and a small pot of espresso to pour over it.
review_notes_en.must_try: ☕️ Tiramisu bingsu
review_notes_en.tips: The milk-snow base is layered with cocoa and condensed milk; pour the espresso over just before eating. The regular coffee is average, so come for the bowl.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small Church Street dessert counter built for sharing

options.name: Jule Bistro
options.signature_dish: 24oz Bone-In Steak with Frites
options.description: Queen West French bistro serving a 24oz bone-in steak with salad and frites, half price Tuesdays.
options.address: 924 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1G6
options.bullet_flavor: Charred bone-in steak cooked medium rare with crisp frites and dressed greens
options.bullet_highlight: Half-price steak every Tuesday makes this one of Toronto's cheapest real steak dinners

review_notes.summary: 已被这家法式牛排馆香晕。带骨牛排24oz配沙拉和薯条，薯条特别好吃，medium rare两个人吃感觉刚刚好。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 24oz 带骨牛排（medium rare）
🍟 现炸薯条
review_notes.tips: 每周二牛排半价，超值羊毛必须薅一下。
review_notes.vibe: Queen West上低调的法式bistro，适合两个人慢慢吃一顿

highlights: Casual Queen West French bistro with a loyal neighbourhood crowd
24oz bone-in steak for two, half price on Tuesdays
options.description_zh: Queen West法式牛排馆，24盎司带骨牛排配沙拉薯条，每周二牛排半价。
highlights_zh: Queen West街坊最爱的法式小馆
24盎司带骨牛排两人分享刚刚好，每周二牛排半价
options.signature_dish_zh: 24盎司带骨牛排配薯条
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A casual French bistro on Queen West built around a 24oz bone-in steak with salad and frites, cooked medium rare for two.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 24oz bone-in steak, medium rare
🍟 Frites
review_notes_en.tips: Steak is half price every Tuesday, so plan the visit around it.
review_notes_en.vibe: An unfussy Queen West room that works well for a two-person dinner

options.name: Sunlit Town Breakfast & Lunch
options.signature_dish: Matcha Strawberry Toast
options.description: Richmond Hill brunch spot whose seasonal matcha-strawberry toast tastes clean, never cloying.
options.address: 13075 Yonge St Unit 8, Richmond Hill, ON L4E 2T0
options.bullet_flavor: Matcha and strawberry toast with bright, tart fruit instead of sugar overload
options.bullet_highlight: A seasonal matcha-strawberry series covering toast, desserts and drinks

review_notes.summary: 这家Brunch唯一的缺点就是有一点点远。抹茶草莓这个组合本来就很难不喜欢，做成吐司甜品和饮品以后整体很清爽。
review_notes.must_try:
🍓 抹茶草莓吐司
🍵 抹茶草莓饮品
review_notes.tips: 甜度控制得好，抹茶香加草莓的酸，吃到最后也不会腻；从市区过来要预留车程。
review_notes.vibe: 北边阳光小镇风的早午餐店，适合周末慢慢吃

highlights: Seasonal matcha and strawberry toast, dessert and drinks
Homemade-style breakfast and lunch a short drive north of the city
options.description_zh: Richmond Hill的早午餐店，新出的抹茶草莓系列酸甜清爽，吐司和饮品都不腻。
highlights_zh: 当季抹茶草莓系列：吐司、甜品、饮品都有
北边的手作风早午餐，酸甜清爽不腻
options.signature_dish_zh: 抹茶草莓吐司
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The only complaint is the drive; Sunlit Town's seasonal matcha-strawberry toast and drinks are clean, tart and never cloying.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍓 Matcha strawberry toast
🍵 Matcha strawberry drink
review_notes_en.tips: Sweetness stays restrained and the strawberry acidity keeps it fresh, but allow time for the trip from downtown.
review_notes_en.vibe: A sunny, unhurried breakfast-and-lunch room in Richmond Hill

options.name: Gladiator Burger
options.signature_dish: Entertain Me Chicken Burger
options.description: Etobicoke's Google 4.8-rated burger shop that wins on delivery, with beef and chicken burgers.
options.address: 1020 Islington Ave, Etobicoke, ON M8Z 0E5
options.bullet_flavor: Juicy beef and chicken burgers with crisp-fried mozzarella on a soft bun
options.bullet_highlight: A Google 4.8-rated burger shop whose packaging survives the delivery ride

review_notes.summary: 谷歌评分4.8的汉堡果然名不虚传。在多伦多汉堡市场寻寻觅觅、踩雷无数之后，终于在一份外卖里发现了汉堡之星。
review_notes.must_try:
🍔 牛肉汉堡
🐔 Entertain Me 鸡肉堡
review_notes.tips: Entertain Me里的脆皮芝士吃到最后偏油，去掉就完美；没有堂食验证过，外卖最稳。
review_notes.vibe: 朴实的西城汉堡外卖店，晚上叫一份很满足

highlights: Google 4.8-rated burger shop in Etobicoke
Delivery holds up: beef burger praised, chicken burger with fried mozzarella
options.description_zh: Etobicoke谷歌4.8分的汉堡店，外卖也很能打，牛肉堡和脆皮芝士鸡肉堡都受好评。
highlights_zh: Etobicoke谷歌评分4.8的汉堡之星
外卖也能打：牛肉堡好评，脆皮芝士鸡肉堡看个人口味
options.signature_dish_zh: Entertain Me 脆皮芝士鸡肉堡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: After a long string of Toronto burger disappointments, a Google 4.8-rated Etobicoke shop finally delivered.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍔 Beef burger
🐔 Entertain Me crispy chicken burger
review_notes_en.tips: The crisp-fried mozzarella in the Entertain Me gets heavy by the end; ask for it without. Delivery is the proven way to order.
review_notes_en.vibe: A no-frills west-end burger counter that travels well

options.name: The Wren
options.signature_dish: Bangkok for Your Buck Beef Burger
options.description: Danforth gastropub known for Toronto's best burgers, now serving a Sichuan-chili mayo beef burger.
options.address: 1382 Danforth Ave, Toronto, ON M4J 1M9
options.bullet_flavor: Flame-grilled patty with Sichuan chili mayo, sesame satay sauce, onion ring and mozzarella
options.bullet_highlight: The Bangkok for Your Buck burger layers Sichuan, Southeast Asian and smoky BBQ flavours

review_notes.summary: 回到我心中多伦多最好吃的汉堡屋，因为常驻菜单更新了牛肉汉堡。黄油面包油亮登场，咬下是爆炒中餐加东南亚的混合风味。
review_notes.must_try:
🍔 Bangkok for Your Buck 牛肉堡
🍺 搭配店内啤酒
review_notes.tips: 老款 Dwayne & Josh Burger 2 已经下架，直接点新款；汉堡里有流心马苏里拉和一颗很脆的洋葱圈。
review_notes.vibe: Danforth上的天才汉堡屋，热闹，适合朋友聚

highlights: Called Toronto's best burger house, now with a new Asian-fusion beef burger
Sichuan chili mayo, sesame satay sauce, crispy onion ring and runny mozzarella
options.description_zh: 被称作多伦多最好吃的汉堡屋，新款牛肉堡加了四川辣子奶黄酱、沙爹酱和脆洋葱圈。
highlights_zh: 被封为多伦多最好吃的汉堡屋，常驻菜单新上亚洲融合牛肉堡
四川辣子奶黄酱+芝麻沙爹酱+脆洋葱圈+流心芝士，层次分明
options.signature_dish_zh: Bangkok for Your Buck 亚洲融合牛肉堡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The Danforth favourite swapped in a new house beef burger: butter bun, flame-grilled patty and a mix of Sichuan and Southeast Asian sauces.
review_notes_en.must_try: 🍔 Bangkok for Your Buck beef burger
review_notes_en.tips: The old Dwayne & Josh Burger 2 is off the menu, so go straight for the new one. Expect a runny mozzarella center and a very crisp onion ring.
review_notes_en.vibe: A buzzy Danforth pub that friends pack out for burgers

options.name: Vū Cafe | Studio
options.signature_dish: Croissant Cold Brew
options.description: Dundas West art cafe hung with local paintings, serving Middle Eastern plates from breakfast.
options.address: 844 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M6J 1V5
options.bullet_flavor: Hummus, labneh and salad bowls with flatbread, plus croissant cold brew and blueberry matcha
options.bullet_highlight: Handmade ceramic cups and art in every corner, including a basement painting studio

review_notes.summary: Dundas West新开一周的绝美艺术咖啡馆，在它还没有大火之前先去惬意喝了一杯早餐咖啡。从入门到地下室到厕所全是艺术细节。
review_notes.must_try:
🥐 可颂冷萃
🧊 冰蓝莓抹茶
review_notes.tips: 食物主打中东：hummus、labneh、沙拉碗和flatbread（中东式披萨），所以早午餐、午餐甚至晚餐都合适。
review_notes.vibe: 被本地艺术家雕刻与画作包围，可以待一整天的治愈空间

highlights: Dundas West art cafe filled with local paintings and handmade ceramic cups
Middle Eastern menu runs from hummus and labneh breakfast through to dinner
options.description_zh: Dundas West新开的艺术咖啡馆，挂满本地艺术家作品，主打中东菜，可从早餐待到晚餐。
highlights_zh: Dundas West新开的艺术咖啡馆，老板与陶艺师合作的手作陶杯
中东风味从早午餐的hummus、labneh一路供应到晚餐
options.signature_dish_zh: 可颂冷萃咖啡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A brand-new Dundas West gallery-cafe where local paintings and sculpture run from the entrance down to the basement bathroom.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥐 Croissant cold brew
🧊 Iced blueberry matcha
review_notes_en.tips: The kitchen is Middle Eastern, so hummus, labneh, salad bowls and flatbread make it work for breakfast, lunch or dinner.
review_notes_en.vibe: An art-filled, quietly healing room with seats for a whole afternoon

options.name: Forno Cultura x East Room Rooftop
options.signature_dish: Rooftop Coffee with CN Tower View
options.description: King East rooftop cafe with CN Tower views, quiet desks, good coffee and bakery pastries.
options.address: 507 King St E, Toronto, ON M5A 3E1
options.bullet_flavor: Filter coffee and bakery pastries with an uninterrupted CN Tower skyline
options.bullet_highlight: Sun-soaked rooftop terrace seating plus quiet desks indoors and out

review_notes.summary: 如果周末citywalk后只去一个地方，就去这家顶楼咖啡。露台景色美到失语，小风一吹，一杯咖啡可以呆一下午。
review_notes.must_try:
☕️ 顶楼手冲咖啡
🥯 面包与甜点
review_notes.tips: 天气好时室外落座区会被阳光晒透；街边就有停车位，周日去是免费的。
review_notes.vibe: 安静chill的顶楼露台，适合办公、冥想和浪费一个下午

highlights: Rooftop terrace with CN Tower and downtown skyline views
Quiet indoor and outdoor work desks; coffee, bread and pastries all good
options.name_zh: Forno Cultura x East Room 顶楼咖啡
options.description_zh: King East顶楼露台咖啡，看得见CN Tower与天际线，室内外都有办公位，咖啡面包甜点都在线。
highlights_zh: 顶楼露台看得见CN Tower与多伦多天际线
室内外都有办公位，咖啡、面包、甜点都在线
options.signature_dish_zh: 可望CN Tower的顶楼手冲咖啡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: If you only stop at one place after a weekend citywalk, make it this rooftop cafe where one coffee can stretch across an afternoon.
review_notes_en.must_try:
☕️ Filter coffee
🥯 Bakery bread and pastries
review_notes_en.tips: The outdoor terrace gets full sun; street parking is free on Sundays and spaces sit right out front.
review_notes_en.vibe: Quiet and genuinely chill, with indoor and outdoor desks for working

options.name: Uncle Wing's Kitchen

review_notes.vibe: 没有网红装修的老式粤菜馆，低调但功夫扎实

highlights: A plain, old-school Cantonese tea house hidden inside a food plaza

review_notes_en.must_try:
🥢 Uncle Wing's signature stir-fry: fried tofu, pork jowl and dried salted fish
🔥 Sizzling clay-pot chicken
review_notes_en.tips: The okra, cashew and beef cubes are quietly excellent; the sizzling clay-pot chicken arrives still crackling and is the kitchen's baseline test.
review_notes_en.vibe: No influencer decor, just an old-style Cantonese room that cooks properly

options.name: Hinoya Curry
options.signature_dish: Tonkatsu Curry with Extra Cheese

options.address: 20 Carlton St, Toronto, ON M5B 2H5

🍛 炸猪排咖喱（Tonkatsu Curry）
🧀 加一份芝士（芝士脑袋必加）

review_notes.vibe: Yonge-Dundas旁的快捷日式咖喱店，一人食很方便

highlights: Toronto branch of Japan's award-winning Hinoya Curry brand
Quick, reliable curry lunch a few steps from Yonge-Dundas

Yonge-Dundas旁的快捷午餐，甜辣口日式咖喱
