options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The downtown outpost of a Japanese curry brand with awards back home; the sauce leans sweet-spicy.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍛 Tonkatsu curry
🧀 Add extra cheese
review_notes_en.tips: Large versus regular only changes the rice portion. The original verdict was measured: good if you are nearby, not worth a special trip from the north.
review_notes_en.vibe: A quick one-person curry counter steps from Yonge-Dundas

options.name: Xiao Jiang Hu Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Crispy Peking Duck
options.description: Richmond Hill Jianghu kitchen that also roasts a crisp, juicy whole Peking duck.
options.address: 550 Hwy 7 Bldg A Unit 6-9, Richmond Hill, ON L4B 3Z4
options.bullet_flavor: Shatteringly crisp duck skin with sweet bean sauce, scallion, cucumber, raisins and chili powder
options.bullet_highlight: A whole duck with raisins and chili powder served alongside the classic trimmings

review_notes.summary: 之前一直以为RH的笑江湖主要是江湖菜，没想到新出的北京烤鸭也这么好吃。整份烤鸭量很大，皮烤得非常酥脆，一点也不油腻，咬下去会爆汁。

🦆 北京烤鸭（整份）
🌶️ 江湖菜系列
review_notes.tips: 配料除常规甜面酱、葱丝、黄瓜外还配了葡萄干和辣酱粉，片皮鸭蘸辣椒粉是咸甜口的新吃法。
review_notes.vibe: Hwy 7上的江湖菜馆，人多点一桌最划算

highlights: Jianghu-style Sichuan-Hunan cooking with a newly added whole Peking duck
Crisp, non-greasy skin that bursts with juice; raisins and chili powder for dipping
options.description_zh: Richmond Hill的江湖菜馆，新出的北京烤鸭皮酥爆汁，配料还给了葡萄干和辣椒粉。
highlights_zh: 主打江湖川湘菜，新出了整只北京烤鸭
鸭皮酥脆不油腻、咬下会爆汁，还配了葡萄干和辣椒粉
options.signature_dish_zh: 北京烤鸭
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Most people come for the Jianghu-style cooking, but the whole Peking duck turns out to be the surprise: crisp skin, juicy meat and a very generous portion.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🦆 Whole Peking duck
🌶️ Jianghu-style dishes
review_notes_en.tips: Alongside the usual hoisin, scallion and cucumber they serve raisins and chili powder; dipping the skin in chili is savoury-sweet and worth trying.
review_notes_en.vibe: A loud, generous Hwy 7 family-style room best booked for a group

options.name: 7 Enoteca
options.signature_dish: Palermo Pizza with Prosciutto, Figs and Pistachio
options.description: Michelin Bib Gourmand Italian in downtown Oakville where the Palermo pizza draws raves.
options.address: 216 Lakeshore Rd E, Oakville, ON L6J 1H8

options.bullet_highlight: Michelin Bib Gourmand pick that opens only a handful of weekday hours

review_notes.summary: 是我吃过最惊艳的米其林推荐餐厅，全垒打型选手，怪不得有周中一天只开五小时的底气。人均$55。
review_notes.must_try:
🍕 Palermo 火腿无花果开心果披萨
🍝 Gnocchetti Il Fungo 野蘑菇短意面
review_notes.tips: 周中营业时间很短，去之前务必先确认当天是否开门；Beef Carpaccio新鲜、黑松露曼彻格芝士提味。
review_notes.vibe: 像洞穴一样的店内氛围，给人莫名的安全感，适合约会

highlights: Michelin Bib Gourmand recommendation in downtown Oakville

review_notes_en.summary: A Michelin Bib Gourmand Italian in downtown Oakville that the reviewer called the most impressive Bib pick they had eaten; around $55 a head.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍕 Palermo pizza: prosciutto, fig, honey, pistachio and mascarpone
🍝 Gnocchetti Il Fungo mushroom pasta
review_notes_en.tips: They open only a handful of weekday hours, so confirm they are open before driving over.
review_notes_en.vibe: A cave-like, enveloping room that feels oddly safe and works well for a date

options.name: The Spicy Ethiopian
options.signature_dish: Injera with Spiced Lentil and Meat Wats
options.description: Queen East Ethiopian favourite serving fragrant, great-value plates, often a first meal after landing.

options.bullet_highlight: Called a hidden treasure for aroma and value; the reviewer's first Toronto meal

One shared injera platter makes an easy first meal in Toronto

手撕injera卷着炖菜吃，很适合作为落地多伦多的第一餐

review_notes_en.summary: A long-saved Queen East Ethiopian favourite, fragrant and great value, and the reviewer's first meal after landing in Toronto.
review_notes_en.must_try: 🫓 Injera platter with spiced stews
review_notes_en.tips: Order one platter to share and eat it with your hands, tearing off pieces of injera. Ask for a mild lentil dish to cool the heat.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small, good-value Queen East room with real character

开酥层次清晰、薄脆漂亮，栗子蒙布朗和柑橘YoYo都值得点

review_notes_en.must_try:
🌰 Chestnut Mont Blanc
🍊 YoYo citrus entremet
🌽 Sweet Corn Tart
review_notes_en.tips: The shop is easy to miss at street level; arriving in the evening may mean a few favourites have sold out.

options.name: Sampaguita Village

options.description: Wilson Avenue family Filipino kitchen with generous, cheap plates and crackling-crisp pork belly.
options.address: 322 Wilson Ave, North York, ON M3H 1S8

options.bullet_highlight: A room full of local Filipino diners and portions built to share

🍖 Lechon Kawali Small（脆皮烧肉）
🍗 Crispy Chicken
review_notes.tips: 猪皮像小饼干一样酥，下面的肉不干、肥瘦比例刚好；一定要配他们家特色甜酱，不齁甜很解腻。

highlights: A hidden North York Filipino family restaurant packed with local diners
Lechon Kawali with shattering crackling skin and a sweet house sauce

Lechon Kawali脆皮烧肉皮像小饼干一样酥，配特色甜酱解腻
options.signature_dish_zh: Lechon Kawali 脆皮烧肉

review_notes_en.summary: The verdict from the original note: big portions, strong value and a good first stop for anyone trying Filipino food.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍖 Lechon Kawali Small, the crackling pork belly
🍗 Crispy chicken
review_notes_en.tips: The skin shatters like a cracker while the meat stays juicy; dip it in their sweet house sauce to cut the richness.
review_notes_en.vibe: A bustling, no-frills family room where everyone around you is a regular

options.description: Unionville Japanese bakery that went viral online for matcha tarts, seasonal pastries and shokupan.
options.address: 4441 Hwy 7 Unit 1 & 2, Unionville, ON L3R 1M1

options.bullet_highlight: The viral Unionville Japanese bakery also runs a downtown Carlton Street location

🍵 抹茶塔（招牌，常售罄）
🍠 秋日限定甜薯方包
review_notes.tips: 抹茶塔下午容易sold out；甜薯方包带浓浓甜薯香和麦香、完全不甜。建议自备餐具，店里只给木刀切塔。

highlights: Viral Unionville Japanese bakery with a second shop on Carlton Street
The matcha tart is the famous order; the seasonal sweet-potato loaf was the real surprise

review_notes_en.summary: The viral Unionville Japanese bakery mostly lives up to the hype: tarts are moderately sweet and the seasonal sweet-potato loaf was the standout.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍵 Matcha tart, the famous one, often sold out
🍠 Seasonal sweet-potato loaf
review_notes_en.tips: Order the matcha tart early. The loaf is unsweetened, chewy and strongly aromatic, and bring your own utensil because they only supply a wooden knife.
review_notes_en.vibe: A bright, modern Japanese bakery good for an after-exam treat

options.name: Lung Fung Hot Pot

options.bullet_highlight: House-made shacha and soy dips, and about $40 a head for a very full meal

highlights: Hong Kong-style hotpot on Hwy 7 that still draws lines two years after opening

🍲 Sea bird's nest and fish maw chicken pot, the house signature
🥩 AAA beef short plate
🍢 Dip of shacha, soy, fried garlic, scallion and a spoonful of chicken broth
review_notes_en.tips: Peak hours mean a two-hour walk-in line, so take a queue number on Google Maps first. The promotional set on their poster is take-out only and must be pre-ordered.

Built a following quickly and opened a second branch on Victoria Park

options.bullet_flavor: Rich Hakata tonkotsu broth with adjustable noodle firmness, plus crisp karaage and gyoza
options.bullet_highlight: A paper order sheet lets you pick noodle hardness — introvert-friendly ramen service

review_notes.summary: 跪求多伦多DT不腻的日式拉面店。配料很丰富的豚骨拉面，可以选面条硬度，点餐流程像在日本，给一张单子自己勾选。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 豚骨拉面（选面条硬度）
🍗 炸鸡 / 章鱼小丸子 / 饺子
review_notes.tips: 原笔记提醒汤头吃一半会觉得腻咸，建议小份或配菜分着吃，吃完记得多喝水。
review_notes.vibe: Yonge街上单人食友好的拉面店

highlights: Hakata-style tonkotsu ramen on Yonge Street with adjustable noodle firmness
The side menu is the hidden star: karaage, takoyaki and gyoza
options.description_zh: Yonge街的博多豚骨拉面，点单像在日本一样勾选单子，炸鸡、章鱼小丸子和饺子都很能打。
highlights_zh: Yonge街博多豚骨拉面，可自选面条硬度
配菜才是隐藏亮点：炸鸡、章鱼小丸子和饺子都好吃
options.signature_dish_zh: 豚骨拉面配日式炸鸡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Hakata-style tonkotsu on Yonge Street with a Japanese paper order sheet where you pick your own noodle firmness.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Tonkotsu ramen, choose your firmness
🍗 Karaage, takoyaki and gyoza from the side menu
review_notes_en.tips: The side menu is the secret weapon. One caution from the original note: the broth can feel heavy and salty by the half-bowl, so share it or order smaller.
review_notes_en.vibe: A classic single-diner ramen counter in the middle of Yonge Street

options.name: Anji Izakaya
options.signature_dish: Spicy Dried Radish and Charcoal Skewers
options.description: Yonge and Steeles izakaya open since 2016 that northern locals call their favourite corner bar.
options.address: 7059 Yonge St, Thornhill, ON L3T 2A6
options.bullet_flavor: Smoky charcoal grill plates with a free-flowing spicy dried radish that keeps the table going
options.bullet_highlight: The same room and the same recipes since 2016, before the shop had any social media

review_notes.summary: 这是我在北边最爱吃的居酒屋，如今也是Steels一带家喻户晓的店，为什么火…原因很简单：好吃。十年吃了几十顿。
review_notes.must_try:
🌶️ 辣萝卜干（可以续盘）
🍢 炭火烧物
review_notes.tips: 改名前叫Anzenchitai（安全地帯），店内一切都没变；从DT专程跑来北边也值得。
review_notes.vibe: 木造暖帘的老派日式酒屋，越晚越有味道

highlights: A 2016 izakaya that became a household name along Steeles without any social media
The spicy dried radish alone is worth several refills
options.name_zh: Anji Izakaya 安全地帯居酒屋
options.description_zh: Yonge与Steeles一带自2016年营业的居酒屋，北边家喻户晓的老酒屋，辣萝卜干可以续好几盘。
highlights_zh: 2016年开业、没有社媒宣传就火遍Steels一带的老酒屋
光是那碟辣萝卜干就可以续好几盘
options.signature_dish_zh: 辣萝卜干与炭火烧物
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The reviewer's most-visited izakaya in the north after a decade and dozens of meals: famous along Steeles, and it never needed social media.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌶️ Spicy dried radish, refilled endlessly
🍢 Charcoal-grilled skewers
review_notes_en.tips: It was called Anzenchitai Izakaya before the rename; the room and the recipes have not changed. Worth the trip from downtown.
review_notes_en.vibe: An old-school wooden izakaya that gets warmer as the night goes on

options.name: Don Don Izakaya
options.native_name: ドンドン いざかや
options.signature_dish: Yakitori Skewer Platter
options.description: Wooden minimalist izakaya beside Eaton Centre, with small plates, yakitori and sake flights.
options.address: 130 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON M5G 1C3
options.bullet_flavor: Yakitori platters and oddly playful appetisers, plus a three-glass sake tasting flight
options.bullet_highlight: Wooden, minimalist, Japanese-drama mood that only gets better as the night goes on

review_notes.summary: 我才发现EatonCenter旁边有一家这么有Vibe的居酒屋，木质极简装修，碰杯的声音、氛围感都很强，属于越晚越有感觉的店。
review_notes.must_try:
🍢 烧鸟串串拼盘
🍶 三杯一套的 sake tasting（$12-15）
review_notes.tips: 菜品选择不算多，基本都是小份菜，按个人喜好点就好；前菜拼盘做成三宫格、六宫格、九宫格，像开盲盒。
review_notes.vibe: 适合金融区下班走到Eaton附近小酌、吃串解压

highlights: Eaton Centre-adjacent izakaya with a Japanese-drama atmosphere
Yakitori platter, bento-style appetiser grids and a $12-15 three-glass sake flight
options.name_zh: Don Don Izakaya 东东居酒屋
options.description_zh: Eaton Centre旁木质极简的日剧感居酒屋，小份菜配烧鸟拼盘，还有三杯一套的sake tasting。
highlights_zh: Eaton Centre旁很有日剧氛围的木质极简居酒屋
烧鸟串串拼盘、开盲盒般的九宫格前菜，还有12-15刀的三杯sake tasting
options.signature_dish_zh: 烧鸟串串拼盘
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A wooden, minimalist izakaya right beside Eaton Centre that feels like a Japanese drama set and grows better as the evening goes on.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍢 Yakitori skewer platter
🍶 Three-glass sake tasting flight, $12-15
review_notes_en.tips: The menu is short and mostly small plates, so order for your own taste; the appetiser platters arrive as bento-style grids that feel like opening blind boxes.
review_notes_en.vibe: An easy after-work drink and skewers spot for the financial district

options.name: MUNI Robata
options.signature_dish: MUNI Sukiyaki Classic Set
options.description: Downtown robata bistro the reviewer calls their favourite izakaya in Toronto, with a $145 set.
options.address: 30 St Patrick St, Toronto, ON M5T 3A3
options.bullet_flavor: Open-flame robata grilling with house-made sauces, sushi rolls and shareable plates
options.bullet_highlight: A $145 Sukiyaki Classic Set that converted a self-declared sashimi and unagi skeptic

review_notes.summary: MUNI Robata真的改变了作者对日料的很多偏见：以前不爱刺身和鳗鱼，总觉得有腥味，这顿吃完才明白只是以前没吃到喜欢的做法。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 $145 MUNI Sukiyaki Classic Set
🍢 炉端烧烤拼盘
review_notes.tips: 套餐分量足，适合两到三人再加点小食；周五周六另有烤肉小菜。
review_notes.vibe: Downtown的明火炉端烧小馆，热闹但不吵，适合朋友小聚

highlights: Called the reviewer's favourite izakaya in Toronto right now
Open-flame robata grilling; the Sukiyaki Classic Set feeds a small table
options.description_zh: 被原笔记称为多伦多目前最喜欢的izakaya，明火炉端焼き，145刀的Sukiyaki经典套餐很出彩。
highlights_zh: 被原笔记评为“在多伦多吃到目前最喜欢的izakaya”
主打明火炉端烧烤，145刀的Sukiyaki经典套餐适合两三个人
options.signature_dish_zh: MUNI Sukiyaki 经典套餐
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The reviewer calls this their favourite izakaya in Toronto right now — it converted someone who thought they disliked sashimi and unagi.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 $145 MUNI Sukiyaki Classic Set
🍢 Robata grilled platter
review_notes_en.tips: The set is generous for two or three; add a couple of small plates rather than ordering a second main.
review_notes_en.vibe: A lively, fire-lit downtown room that works well for a small group

options.name: Pocha 1989
options.signature_dish: Spicy Creamy Udon and Budae Jjigae
options.description: Church Street pocha serving spicy creamy udon, army-stew budae jjigae and fish-cake hotpot till late.
options.address: 542 Church St, Toronto, ON M4Y 2E1
options.hours_note: Mon-Thu 6:00 PM - 2:30 AM; Fri-Sun 12:00 PM - 2:30 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Creamy spicy udon loaded with egg, bacon, sausage, fish cake and wide noodles in a spicy broth
options.bullet_highlight: Open until 2:30am daily, making it a genuine late-night Korean standby

review_notes.summary: 之前朋友来trt玩基本都会带他们去这家韩餐，自己住DT的时候还点过外卖，吃的次数完全数不清。辣奶油乌冬和部队锅都是必点。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 Spicy Creamy Udon 辣奶油乌冬
🍲 Budae Jjigae 部队锅
🍥 Spicy Fish Cake Hotpot 辣鱼饼汤
review_notes.tips: 辣鱼饼汤里有豆芽配辣汤很开胃；奶油乌冬里有鸡蛋、培拉、牛肉肠、鱼饼、包菜和宽粉。营业到凌晨两点半，适合宵夜。
review_notes.vibe: Church街的韩式小酒馆，适合朋友聚餐和深夜食堂

highlights: The reviewer's pick for the best Korean restaurant in downtown Toronto
Spicy creamy udon and budae jjigae, served until 2:30am
options.description_zh: Church街的韩式小酒馆，辣奶油乌冬和部队锅是必点，营业到凌晨两点半。
highlights_zh: 被原笔记评为多伦多DT心目中最夯的韩餐
辣奶油乌冬和部队锅必点，营业到凌晨两点半
options.signature_dish_zh: 辣奶油乌冬与部队锅

review_notes_en.summary: The reviewer brings visiting friends here and has ordered it home countless times; it is their pick for the best Korean food in downtown Toronto.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Spicy creamy udon
🍲 Budae jjigae army stew
🍥 Spicy fish-cake hotpot
review_notes_en.tips: The udon comes with egg, bacon, beef sausage, fish cake, cabbage and wide noodles in a spicy cream broth. Open until 2:30am every day.
review_notes_en.vibe: A Church Street pocha built for groups and late-night eating

options.name: Hwaro Korean BBQ
options.signature_dish: Staff-Grilled Beef and Berkshire Pork Set
options.description: New Yonge Street Korean grill where staff cook every piece for you and the banchan spread is huge.
options.address: 332 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5B 1R8
options.bullet_flavor: Beef and Berkshire pork grilled to your preference over charcoal, with a generous banchan spread
options.bullet_highlight: Servers grill the meat for you and adjust doneness to your taste — no DIY required

review_notes.summary: DT新开的韩国烤肉店，就在Jollibee旁边。环境装修得真不错，服务也很好，全程帮忙烤肉、介绍菜品，还会按你的喜好帮你烤。
review_notes.must_try:
🍖 牛肉与黑毛猪肉拼盘
🍚 鸡蛋羹、大酱汤等小菜
review_notes.tips: 不是all you can eat，每人必须点一份肉，一份肉最低50刀起；肉的品质很好但分量不大，小菜倒是真的很丰盛。
review_notes.vibe: Yonge街中心的高档韩烤，适合约会和小聚

highlights: Brand-new Yonge Street Korean barbecue next to Jollibee
Staff grill the meat for you; quality cuts and a very generous banchan spread
options.description_zh: Yonge街新开的韩式烤肉，店员全程帮忙烤，肉质好、小菜丰盛，人均肉类最低50刀起。
highlights_zh: Yonge街Jollibee旁边新开的韩式烤肉
全程店员帮忙烤、按你的喜好控制火候，小菜丰盛但肉量不算大
options.signature_dish_zh: 店员代烤的牛肉与黑毛猪肉套餐
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A new Korean barbecue on Yonge Street beside Jollibee, with smart interiors and servers who grill every piece for you.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍖 Beef and Berkshire pork set
🍚 Steamed egg, soybean paste soup and the banchan spread
review_notes_en.tips: Not all-you-can-eat: each person must order at least one meat platter starting around $50. The meat quality is high but the portions are modest, while the side dishes are very generous.
review_notes_en.vibe: A polished Yonge Street grill that suits a date or a small group

options.name: Bueokae Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Homestyle Korean Stews and Rice Plates
options.description: Yonge and Major Mac Korean home kitchen in Richmond Hill that locals rate as a safe bet.
options.address: 10737 Yonge St Unit 2&3, Richmond Hill, ON L4C 9M9
options.bullet_flavor: Comforting Korean home cooking: stews, rice plates and banchan made the everyday way
options.bullet_highlight: Mon-Sat lunch-to-late hours with Friday and Saturday running an extra half hour

review_notes.summary: 周末去Richmond Hill办事，意外挖到了这家宝藏韩餐小店Bueokae，就在Yonge和Major Mac附近，不踩雷推荐。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 韩式炖锅系列
🍚 家常盖饭
review_notes.tips: 周一到周六11:30am-10pm，周五周六延长到10:30pm；周日休息，别扑空。
review_notes.vibe: 北边Yonge街上的温馨韩式家常小店

highlights: A Richmond Hill Korean home kitchen the reviewer calls a no-regret find
Right at Yonge and Major Mackenzie, open from late morning most days
options.description_zh: Yonge与Major Mac附近的韩式家常小店，原笔记评价是“不踩雷”的宝藏韩餐。
highlights_zh: 位于Yonge与Major Mac附近的韩式家常小店，原笔记评价“不踩雷”
周一至周六从上午11点半营业到晚上，周末前两天延长半小时
options.signature_dish_zh: 韩式家常炖锅与盖饭

review_notes_en.summary: A happy accident on a Richmond Hill errand run: a small Korean home kitchen near Yonge and Major Mackenzie that the reviewer called a no-regret find.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Korean stews
🍚 Homestyle rice plates
review_notes_en.tips: Open Mon-Sat 11:30am to 10pm, with Friday and Saturday running to 10:30pm; closed on Sundays.
review_notes_en.vibe: A warm, small Korean comfort-food room on Yonge in the north

options.name: L'Avenue
options.signature_dish: Spicy Chicken Benny
options.description: Wellington Street brunch spot that reads Korean and Chinese rather than traditional, and delivers.
options.address: 433 Wellington St W, Toronto, ON M5V 1E3
options.bullet_flavor: Eggs Benedict with saucy spicy chicken and soft potatoes, plus sweet-savoury steak bennies
options.bullet_highlight: A Kowloon-cuisine brunch that scores by ordering straight off the recommendations

review_notes.summary: 按惯例先上结论：按推荐点基本都好吃、不踩雷。但不要坐户外，会被成群胡蜂打扰攻击。整个吃下来菜系非常韩式+中式，并不是传统Brunch。
review_notes.must_try:
👑 Spicy Chicken Benny 辣鸡班尼迪克蛋
🍳 Bobby Does Dallas 甜口牛排片盖蛋
🥞 Blueberry Pancake
review_notes.tips: 土豆绵软入味是全场亮点；蓝莓pancake口感偏实、不算空气感，可点可不点。户外座位有胡蜂，建议坐室内。
review_notes.vibe: 金融区里的热闹早午餐店，适合朋友一起点一桌

highlights: Unconventional brunch that leans Korean and Chinese instead of classic Western
Order by the ranking: Spicy Chicken Benny first, Bobby Does Dallas second
options.description_zh: Wellington街的早午餐店，风格偏韩式中式而非传统Brunch，按推荐点基本不踩雷。
highlights_zh: 风格并不传统，整体更偏韩式+中式的Brunch
照着推荐点基本都好吃：辣鸡班尼迪克蛋第一，Bobby Does Dallas第二
options.signature_dish_zh: 辣鸡班尼迪克蛋
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The verdict: order off the recommendations and you will not be disappointed, but do not sit outside where wasps will bother you.
review_notes_en.must_try:
👑 Spicy chicken benny
🍳 Bobby Does Dallas steak benny
🥞 Blueberry pancakes
review_notes_en.tips: The soft, well-seasoned potatoes are the quiet standout. The blueberry pancakes are denser than fluffy, so they are optional. Sit indoors.
review_notes_en.vibe: A lively financial-district brunch room best used for sharing a table full of plates

options.name: Auntie Dessert
options.signature_dish: Super Mango Mini Rice Balls
options.description: Thornhill Cantonese dessert shop where the mango bingsu-style bowls sell out by the evening.
options.address: 505 Hwy 7 #8, Thornhill, ON L3T 7T1
options.hours_note: Mon-Fri 5:00 PM - 11:30 PM; Sat 3:00 PM - 11:30 PM; Sun 3:00 PM - 12:00 AM
options.bullet_flavor: Fresh mango chunks and chewy rice balls over mango shaved ice, plus tofu pudding and sago
options.bullet_highlight: A short, focused menu that regularly sells out its most popular bowl

review_notes.summary: 去吃北边新开的糖水啦！排队等了大概20分钟还算比较快。menu选择种类不多，但当季水果系列确实清爽。
review_notes.must_try:
🥭 超多芒小丸子（Top1）
🍮 鲜芒双皮奶（去晚了会售罄）
🍠 木薯芋圆大满贯
review_notes.tips: 芒果新鲜且块大，丸子也很饱满；营业到深夜，周日休店前去最合适。
review_notes.vibe: Hwy 7社区里的港式糖水铺，适合当饭后甜点或宵夜

highlights: New Thornhill Cantonese sweet-soup shop with a short, focused menu
Super Mango Mini Rice Balls is the top pick; the mango double-skin milk sells out
options.description_zh: Thornhill新开的粤式糖水铺，超多芒小丸子是Top1，鲜芒双皮奶晚点就售罄。
highlights_zh: 北边新开的粤式糖水铺，menu种类不多但款款到位
超多芒小丸子是Top1，鲜芒双皮奶去晚了经常sold out
options.signature_dish_zh: 超多芒小丸子

review_notes_en.summary: A new Cantonese sweet-soup shop in Thornhill where the queue moves faster than it looks and the menu stays short on purpose.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥭 Super mango mini rice balls, the top seller
🍮 Mango double-skin milk, often sold out
🍠 Tapioca and taro ball grand slam
review_notes_en.tips: Mango is fresh and generously cut; expect about twenty minutes at peak. Closes late, so it works as a dessert stop after dinner.
review_notes_en.vibe: A neighbourhood Cantonese dessert counter on Hwy 7

options.name: Big Way Hot Pot
options.signature_dish: Self-Serve Weighted Malatang
options.description: Scarborough malatang weighed at $3.89 per 100g, open until 2am with eleven broths and free ice cream.
options.address: 1571 Sandhurst Cir #105b, Scarborough, ON M1V 1V2
options.hours_note: Open daily until 2:00 AM (check Google Maps for opening time)
options.bullet_flavor: Pick your own ingredients at a flat rate per 100g, then choose from eleven soup bases
options.bullet_highlight: Open until 2am, still packed at 9pm, and the meal comes with free ice cream

review_notes.summary: 开车路过晚上9点去的，居然还是人声鼎沸，快10点吃完还有人进来。Bigway开到凌晨两点，15刀以下就能吃到深夜麻辣烫。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 招牌中辣大味麻辣汤底
🐔 养生虫草鸡汤底（不吃辣首选）
review_notes.tips: 一站式自助称重结账，菜品一律100g 3.89，肉菜丸子海鲜主食应有尽有；原笔记提醒中辣其实不够辣。
review_notes.vibe: 北边的深夜麻辣烫食堂，一个人吃也不尴尬

highlights: Late-night malatang weighed at a flat $3.89 per 100g
Eleven broth bases, a topping bar and a free ice cream at the end
options.description_zh: Scarborough自助称重麻辣烫，100克3.89加元，11种汤底，开到凌晨两点还送冰淇淋。
highlights_zh: 深夜麻辣烫，自助称重一律100克3.89加元
11种汤底+自助小料台，吃完还送一份冰淇淋
options.signature_dish_zh: 自助称重麻辣烫
options.hours_note_zh: 营业至凌晨 02:00（开店时间请以 Google Maps 为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Drive-by at 9pm and the room was still roaring, with more people arriving as we finished. Under $15 for a late-night malatang that runs until 2am.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Signature medium-spicy malatang broth
🐔 Cordyceps chicken broth if you do not want heat
review_notes_en.tips: Everything is weighed at a flat $3.89 per 100g at one self-serve counter. One caution from the original note: the medium spice level is not actually very spicy.
review_notes_en.vibe: A north-end late-night malatang counter that works fine on your own

options.name: Matcha Yuzu Bakery
options.signature_dish: Mentaiko Baguette
options.description: Scarborough bakery that softens French-style hard bread with Japanese high-hydration technique.
options.address: 390 Silver Star Blvd Unit 166, Scarborough, ON M1V 0E3
options.bullet_flavor: French doughs reworked with Japanese high hydration: airy ciabatta, salt rolls, focaccia and thin-crust sourdough
options.bullet_highlight: Roughly 35 breads a day from a dozen doughs, with the mentaiko baguette as the cult order

review_notes.summary: 抹柚每年闭店去日本学习，把「硬包软吃」带回多伦多：法式面包底加上日式高加水，皮薄、内部湿润、柔软有嚼劲。
review_notes.must_try:
🥖 明太子法棍
🥐 三款盐卷
🍞 有馅恰巴塔 / 佛卡夏
review_notes.tips: 每日约35款产品、十几种面团；酸种、法棍、恰巴塔都走「皮薄柔软」路线，不爱硬包的人也吃得惯。
review_notes.vibe: 北边社区里认真做面包的先锋小店

highlights: Scarborough bakery that brings Japanese-style soft eating back to French hard bread
About 35 daily breads from a dozen doughs; the mentaiko baguette is the one to queue for
options.description_zh: 北边面包店抹柚，用日式高加水把法式硬包做软，每天约35款面包，明太子法棍是招牌。
highlights_zh: 北边面包店，用日式高加水把法式硬包做软
每天约35款面包、十几种面团，明太子法棍必买
options.signature_dish_zh: 明太子法棍
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The shop closes each year to study in Japan and returns with high-hydration French doughs that stay soft instead of hard and dry.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥖 Mentaiko baguette
🥐 The three salt rolls
🍞 Stuffed ciabatta and focaccia
review_notes_en.tips: Around 35 products a day from more than ten doughs; everything leans thin-crust and soft inside, so even people who dislike hard European bread get on with it.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small north-end bakery treating bread as craft rather than as a trend

options.name: Harbin BBQ
options.signature_dish: Foil-Baked Enoki, Vermicelli and Clams
options.description: Relocated northeast Chinese barbecue house open from 4pm to 2am, grilling skewers to order.
options.address: 668 Silver Star Blvd Unit 201, Toronto, ON M1V 5N1
options.bullet_flavor: Live-cooked skewers that keep their juices, plus foil-baked enoki and vermicelli that beg for a bowl of rice
options.bullet_highlight: Old shop at a new address with the same chef still on the grill, running 4pm to 2am daily

review_notes.summary: 老店新搬的哈尔滨烧烤王，大厨还是那个味儿。两个人点了一桌，锡纸金针菇粉丝花蛤拌饭能连干两碗。
review_notes.must_try:
🐚 锡纸金针菇粉丝花蛤
🌶️ 山城辣子鸡
🍢 生烤羊肉串 / 鸡胗
🥒 烤东北豆皮
review_notes.tips: 烧烤是生烤的，肉串烤完还带汁水；葱爆牛肉锅气足。锅包肉、冷面和朝族菜也是招牌，试营业期间有九折。
review_notes.vibe: 北边的深夜东北烧烤，营业到凌晨两点

highlights: Northeast barbecue relocated to Silver Star with the original chef still cooking
Skewers are grilled raw to order and stay juicy; the foil clams are rice's best friend
options.name_zh: 哈尔滨烧烤王 Harbin BBQ
options.description_zh: 老店新搬的东北烧烤，下午4点营业到凌晨2点，生烤肉串烤完还带汁水，锅包肉和冷面也是招牌。
highlights_zh: 老店搬到Silver Star，大厨还是原来的味儿
生烤肉串烤完带汁水，锡纸金针菇粉丝花蛤拌饭一绝
options.signature_dish_zh: 锡纸金针菇粉丝花蛤

review_notes_en.summary: The old Harbin barbecue house moved rather than changed: same chef, same cooking, and a table full of dishes for two.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐚 Foil-baked enoki, vermicelli and clams
🌶️ Chongqing-style spicy chicken
🍢 Raw-grilled lamb and gizzard skewers
🥒 Grilled northeast tofu skin
review_notes_en.tips: Skewers are grilled from raw so they finish juicy. Guobaorou, cold noodles and Korean-Chinese dishes are also signatures; the soft-opening discount was running when the reviewer visited.
review_notes_en.vibe: A north-end late-night barbecue room that stays open until 2am

options.name: Qianjinfu Northeast Kitchen
options.signature_dish: Pork and Blood Sausage Stew with Sauerkraut
options.description: Steeles Avenue northeast-Chinese kitchen rated just above the pass mark, about thirty dollars a head.
options.address: 4771 Steeles Ave E Unit A03 & A04, Scarborough, ON M1V 5N1
options.bullet_flavor: Sauerkraut and pork stews, house-made skin jelly and hand-folded dumplings in an honest northern kitchen
options.bullet_highlight: An unusually frank review: four dishes worth ordering, plus the three the reviewer tells you to skip

review_notes.summary: 朋友带路来吃东北菜，整体在及格线以上，没有太踩雷，可以试试；人均30左右。
review_notes.must_try:
🍲 年猪烩菜（血肠嫩、酸菜配猪肚）
🥟 手工酸菜水饺
🥒 自制皮冻 / 干豆角烧肉
review_notes.tips: 原笔记的避雷清单：锅包肉偏甜酸味不够、地三鲜太油、烤酱油筋偏柴；蘸酱菜种类也偏少。
review_notes.vibe: 北边街坊式的东北菜馆，份量扎实

highlights: Northeastern Chinese cooking around thirty dollars a person on Steeles Avenue
Order the pork stew and sour cabbage dumplings; the reviewer says skip the guobaorou
options.description_zh: Steeles上的东北菜馆，原笔记评价「及格线以上、没太踩雷」，人均30左右，年猪烩菜和酸菜水饺值得点。
highlights_zh: Steeles上的东北菜，人均30左右
年猪烩菜和酸菜水饺值得点，锅包肉偏甜、地三鲜太油
options.signature_dish_zh: 年猪烩菜
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Brought here by a friend for northeastern Chinese food: honestly scored above the pass mark, with nothing major let down, at about $30 a head.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍲 Pork and blood sausage stew with sauerkraut
🥟 Hand-made sour cabbage dumplings
🥒 House-made skin jelly and dried-bean-vine pork
review_notes_en.tips: The reviewer's skip list: the guobaorou is too sweet with not enough sourness, the di san xian is too oily, and the grilled tendon is dry. The dipping-vegetable plate is on the small side.
review_notes_en.vibe: A straightforward northern Chinese neighbourhood room with generous plates

options.name: The Pot House
options.signature_dish: Wok-Fired Pork Kidney
options.description: Markham northeast-Chinese kitchen that specialises in pressure-pot dishes, with wok-fired pork kidney as the star.
options.address: 3636 Steeles Ave E Unit 112-113, Markham, ON L3R 1K9
options.bullet_flavor: Pressure-pot pig trotter and braised pork, thin-skinned hand-folded dumplings and one outstanding stir-fried kidney
options.bullet_highlight: Four dishes and two orders of dumplings fed four people for about $115 before tip

review_notes.summary: 马记牛羊馆隔壁新开的东北菜，主打压锅菜，总体味道还可以。四个人4个菜2个蒸饺加税加服务一共115，吃得很饱。
review_notes.must_try:
🔥 火爆腰花（全场最佳，最嫩）
🥟 酸菜 / 三鲜饺子（现擀现包）
🫕 压锅猪蹄 / 红烧肉
review_notes.tips: 原笔记提醒：上菜偏慢，第一道菜可能要等半小时，别空腹去；锅包肉调味不够酸、肉不酥，不如隔壁马记。
review_notes.vibe: 北边压锅菜专门店，重口味很下饭

highlights: New northeast-Chinese place next to Ma Ji built around pressure-pot cooking
The wok-fired pork kidney is the order, and the kitchen folds its dumplings to order
options.name_zh: 福满锅·压锅江湖 The Pot House
options.description_zh: 马记牛羊馆隔壁的东北菜，主打压锅菜，全场最佳是火爆腰花，饺子现擀现包，菜码巨大。
highlights_zh: 马记牛羊馆隔壁新开的东北菜，主打压锅菜
火爆腰花是全场最佳，饺子现擀现包、皮很薄
options.signature_dish_zh: 火爆腰花
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A new northeast-Chinese spot beside Ma Ji built around pressure-pot cooking. Four people ordered four dishes and two dumpling sets for about $115 and left full.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🔥 Wok-fired pork kidney, the best plate on the table
🥟 Sour cabbage and three-filling dumplings, folded to order
🫕 Pressure-pot pig trotter and braised pork
review_notes_en.tips: Service is slow: allow half an hour for the first dish, so do not arrive starving. The guobaorou was under-seasoned and not crisp, and the reviewer preferred the neighbour's version.
review_notes_en.vibe: A heavy-flavoured northern pressure-pot room that goes well with rice

options.name: Oji Seichi
options.signature_dish: Oji Classic Shio Ramen
options.description: Broadview ramen shop where three broths and a chilli-sesame bowl all come in without a miss.
options.address: 354 Broadview Ave, Toronto, ON M4M 2H2
options.bullet_flavor: Chicken, pork and seafood shio broth, a deep shoyu, and a sesame chilli bowl that finishes gently hot
options.bullet_highlight: Pork teriyaki meatballs with a hidden dab of mustard give the menu its twist

review_notes.summary: 试了三款拉面都实名推荐，闭眼点不踩雷：面条劲道，汤底有日式拉面的灵魂但又不会过咸。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 Oji Classic Shio 盐味拉面（鸡猪海鲜复合高汤）
🍜 Oji Classic Shoyu 酱油拉面
🍢 Pork Teriyaki Meatballs 猪肉照烧肉丸
review_notes.tips: 肉丸咬开里面带一点芥末的微辣，挺有层次；辣芝麻担担面是微辣浓汤配叉烧，喜欢重口可以点。
review_notes.vibe: 简约现代风的拉面店，适合朋友小聚或一个人吃面

highlights: Broadview ramen room whose shio, shoyu and spicy sesame bowls all land
Order the pork teriyaki meatballs, mustard inside the meatball is the surprise
options.description_zh: Broadview街很火的日式拉面店，盐味、酱油和辣芝麻三款都不踩雷，肉丸照烧汁里还带芥末微辣。
highlights_zh: Broadview街的宝藏拉面，盐味/酱油/辣芝麻三款都不踩雷
肉丸照烧汁里藏了一点芥末微辣，很有层次
options.signature_dish_zh: 盐味拉面
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Three ramen bowls, three recommendations: firm noodles and broths that keep the soul of Japanese ramen without tipping into salt.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Oji classic shio, a chicken, pork and seafood stock
🍜 Oji classic shoyu
🍢 Pork teriyaki meatballs
review_notes_en.tips: The meatballs hide a little mustard heat inside, which gives them depth. The spicy sesame ramen is only mildly hot and comes with char siu.
review_notes_en.vibe: A clean, modern ramen room that works for a small group or a solo bowl

options.name: Cafe Oro di Napoli
options.signature_dish: Anatra Duck and Red-Wine Pear Pizza
options.description: Neapolitan pizzeria the reviewer wants given a gold medal for its confit duck and burrata pizzas.
options.address: 75 Jarvis St, Toronto, ON M5C 2H2
options.bullet_flavor: Thin Neapolitan crusts carrying confit duck with red-wine pear, and prosciutto laid over burrata
options.bullet_highlight: The reviewer asks the Toronto pizza association for a gold medal, and still means it on every return visit

review_notes.summary: 多伦多有些店无论回访多少次都一直很好吃，Cafe Oro di Napoli 就是这种。作者的四件套是固定点法。
review_notes.must_try:
🦆 Anatra 油封鸭红酒炖梨白披萨
🍕 Prosciutto e burrata 火腿布拉塔披萨
🥘 $33 藏红花番茄海鲜饭
🍌 自家Gelato（香蕉面包味）
review_notes.tips: 薄皮披萨承载很多料，炖梨甜而多汁；烤鱿鱼底下铺白葡萄酒炒番茄也很出彩。夏天到店更忙，建议错峰。
review_notes.vibe: Jarvis街上的拿坡里火炉小馆，回访型选手的快乐老家

highlights: Neapolitan oven pizza the reviewer still ranks among Toronto's best after repeat visits
Anatra duck and pear pizza, prosciutto and burrata, saffron seafood rice and house gelato
options.name_zh: Cafe Oro di Napoli 拿坡里披萨
options.description_zh: Jarvis街拿坡里披萨店，油封鸭红酒炖梨白披萨和火腿布拉塔披萨是必点，临走人均带走一杯自家Gelato。
highlights_zh: 拿坡里火炉披萨，回访多次依然赞不绝口的店
油封鸭红酒炖梨白披萨、火腿布拉塔披萨必点，临走带一杯自家Gelato
options.signature_dish_zh: 油封鸭红酒炖梨白披萨
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The kind of place that tastes just as good on the fifth visit as on the first, which is exactly what the reviewer says about it.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🦆 Anatra confit duck and red-wine pear pizza
🍕 Prosciutto and burrata pizza
🥘 $33 saffron tomato seafood rice
🍌 House gelato, banana bread flavour
review_notes_en.tips: The thin crust carries a lot of weight and the pears are very juicy. The grilled calamari sits on white-wine tomatoes. Summer makes the room busier, so go off-peak.
review_notes_en.vibe: A Neapolitan oven room on Jarvis that rewards repeat visits

options.name: Famiglia Baldassarre
options.signature_dish: Daily Fresh Handmade Pasta
options.description: Geary Avenue pasta factory that only serves lunch Tuesday to Friday and changes its menu daily.
options.address: 122 Geary Ave, Toronto, ON M6H 4H1
options.hours_note: Tue-Fri 12:00 PM - 2:00 PM (retail shop until 5:00 PM)
options.bullet_flavor: Fresh pasta made in an open kitchen where texture, egg and chew matter more than heavy sauce
options.bullet_highlight: Tuesday to Friday, noon to 2pm only, with a menu rewritten daily around whatever arrived fresh

review_notes.summary: 多伦多人均20的「传说级」手工意面工厂，只开午餐、不做传统晚餐，很多人专门翘班来吃，建议12点前到排队。
review_notes.must_try:
🍝 每日现做的鲜制手工面
🥖 门口零售店的面包与意面（可买回家煮）
📋 IG上每天更新的菜单
review_notes.tips: 周二到周五12:00-14:00，商店12:00-17:00；菜单每天根据当天食材调整，排队久就对了，越早到越省时间。
review_notes.vibe: 欧洲家庭小餐馆式的开放厨房，边做面边和客人聊天

highlights: Lunch-only pasta counter, open Tuesday to Friday from noon until 2pm
The menu changes daily; the noodles themselves are the point, not the sauce
options.description_zh: Geary Ave的手工意面工厂，只开周二至周五午餐12点到2点，菜单每天现做现变，人均约20刀。
highlights_zh: 只开午餐的手工意面工厂，周二到周五12点到2点
菜单每天现变，主角是面本身的口感、蛋香和筋道
options.signature_dish_zh: 每日鲜制手工意面

review_notes_en.summary: A legendary Toronto pasta factory at about $20 a head, lunch only with no dinner service, which people happily skip work to attend.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍝 Fresh pasta made that morning
🥖 Bread and pasta from the retail shop to cook at home
📋 The daily menu posted on Instagram each day
review_notes_en.tips: Tuesday to Friday noon to 2pm, shop open noon to 5pm. The menu shifts with whatever arrived fresh, so arrive before noon if you want to avoid the longest wait.
review_notes_en.vibe: An open kitchen that feels like a European family trattoria

options.name: Occhiolino
options.signature_dish: Pappardelle with Beef Rib in Barolo
options.description: Hidden two-storey Italian house near Bathurst and College, long rumoured to be a rapper's private kitchen.
options.address: 499 Bathurst St, Toronto, ON M5S 2P8
options.bullet_flavor: Beef rib pappardelle slow enough to taste like home-style braised beef, plus a clean tuna crudo
options.bullet_highlight: Two floors of ins-style rooms hidden in a corner house, with fresh pasta you can also buy to take home

review_notes.summary: 藏在闹市区小洋房里的手工意面店，传闻是Drake私厨开的，ins风装修上下两层，也卖意面可以买回家煮，人均60左右。
review_notes.must_try:
🍝 Pappardelle al Barolo 红酒牛肋宽面
🐟 Carpaccio di Tuna 生鱼薄片配西柚
🧀 Burrata
review_notes.tips: 原笔记直说：整体属于无功无过或功稍大于过，顺路再去就好；甜点巴斯克粉感重、不太流心，建议不要点。
review_notes.vibe: 街角独栋的私房感小馆，适合约会和姐妹聚会

highlights: A concealed corner house near Bathurst and College with pasta worth the detour
Pappardelle al Barolo with fall-apart beef rib is the dish; skip the basque cheesecake
options.description_zh: Bathurst街角独栋小洋房意大利馆，人均约60刀；红酒炖牛肋宽面很稳，巴斯克蛋糕不建议点。
highlights_zh: Bathurst街角独栋小洋房，私房感十足的意大利馆
红酒炖牛肋宽面是招牌，巴斯克蛋糕就不必点了
options.signature_dish_zh: 巴罗洛红酒牛肋宽面
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A handmade-pasta house hidden in a corner building, long rumoured to be a certain rapper's kitchen, with two floors of ins-style rooms and pasta for sale.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍝 Pappardelle al Barolo with beef rib
🐟 Tuna carpaccio with grapefruit
🧀 Burrata
review_notes_en.tips: The reviewer's honest verdict: fine, a little better than average, but not worth a special trip. The basque cheesecake was dense and not runny, so skip dessert.
review_notes_en.vibe: A private-feeling corner house suited to a date or a small group

options.name: Porzia's
options.signature_dish: Lasagna Bolognese
options.description: Oakwood neighbourhood Italian where every table orders the lasagna under a blanket of parmesan.
options.address: 319A Oakwood Ave, York, ON M6E 2V8
options.bullet_flavor: Lasagna bolognese under thick parmesan, plus kampachi crudo and octopus with nduja and chickpeas
options.bullet_highlight: Walk into an unremarkable block and find every table full, which tells you what to order

review_notes.summary: 大名鼎鼎的Porzia's，藏在St Clair一个不起眼的街区，进门却满桌了。
review_notes.must_try:
🧀 Lasagna Bolognese 肉酱芝士千层面（每桌必点）
🐟 Kampachi Crudo 生鱼薄片
🐙 Octopus 烤章鱼配nduja与鹰嘴豆
review_notes.tips: 千层面铺满厚厚帕玛森、上千层快要融化的肉酱，十分钟就吃完；烤章鱼是中海南义风格，喜欢辣的记得安排nduja。
review_notes.vibe: 街区里的local意大利小馆，热闹但不喧哗

highlights: A local favourite on a quiet block that fills up regardless of the night
Lasagna bolognese is the universal order; the octopus with nduja and chickpeas brings heat
options.description_zh: St Clair附近不起眼街区的意大利小馆，肉酱芝士千层是每桌必点，铺满帕玛森与慢炖肉酱。
highlights_zh: 不起眼街区里的local宝藏意大利小馆，进门就满桌
肉酱芝士千层面每桌必点，烤章鱼配nduja辣香肠酱和鹰嘴豆
options.signature_dish_zh: 肉酱芝士千层面
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The famous Porzia's sits on an unremarkable St Clair block and still fills every table the moment you walk in.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🧀 Lasagna bolognese, the universal order
🐟 Kampachi crudo
🐙 Grilled octopus with nduja and chickpeas
review_notes_en.tips: The lasagna arrives under thick parmesan with layers of bolognese nearly melted, and disappears in minutes. The octopus leans southern Italian and mediterranean, so add the nduja if you want heat.
review_notes_en.vibe: A neighbourhood Italian room that is busy without being loud

options.name: Nuna Kitchen & Bar
options.signature_dish: Octopus Anticuchero
options.description: Queen West Peruvian room the reviewer calls their favourite, with twenty-eight dollar octopus and tasting menus.
options.address: 1265 Queen St W, Toronto, ON M6K 1L7
options.bullet_flavor: Charred anticucho skewers, twenty-eight dollar grilled octopus with cauliflower purée, and a seafood-upgraded shrimp risotto
options.bullet_highlight: Summerlicious runs forty-one dollars at lunch and fifty-five at dinner, plus a hundred-and-thirty dollar tasting menu for two

review_notes.summary: 这是我在多伦多最心爱的秘鲁食堂，即使吃过El Inka，还是更喜欢Nuna，把秘鲁菜呈现得更精致且不断创新（唯一的缺点就是远）。
review_notes.must_try:
🐙 Octopus Anticuchero 秘鲁辣烤章鱼（$28）
🍢 Beef anticuchos 烤西冷串
🥘 Shrimp risotto 升级秘鲁海鲜烩饭
review_notes.tips: 烤西冷串是半熟，怕生要备注全熟；章鱼很嫩、花菜奶酱清甜。每周四秘鲁牛排薯条$35，每周三全日1-2刀生蚝。
review_notes.vibe: 暖黄灯光、复古砖墙的南美小馆，适合慢慢吃一顿浪漫晚餐

highlights: The reviewer's favourite Peruvian kitchen in Toronto, years after first recommending it
Grilled octopus at twenty-eight dollars, half-price steaks on Thursday and a dollar oysters Wednesday
options.description_zh: Queen West上的秘鲁菜，暖黄灯光加复古砖墙；炭烤章鱼28刀很惊艳，周四牛排薯条35刀、周三1刀生蚝。
highlights_zh: 被原笔记称为多伦多最心爱的秘鲁食堂
炭烤章鱼28刀很惊艳，周四秘鲁牛排薯条35刀、周三1-2刀生蚝
options.signature_dish_zh: 秘鲁辣烤章鱼
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The reviewer's most loved Peruvian canteen in Toronto: more refined and more inventive than the alternatives, with the walk from downtown its only flaw.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐙 Octopus anticuchero for $28
🍢 Beef anticuchos upgraded to striploin
🥘 Shrimp risotto, upgraded to the seafood version
review_notes_en.tips: The anticuchos come medium-rare, so ask for well done if you do not eat pink meat. Thursday is $35 Peruvian steak and frites; Wednesday runs all-day oysters at one or two dollars.
review_notes_en.vibe: Warm lighting and retro brick in a South American room built for a slow dinner

options.name: Pho Bone
options.signature_dish: Beef Rib Bone Pho
options.description: Richmond Hill pho shop stacking two beef ribs or a marrow bone into bowls for twenty dollars.
options.address: 9206 Leslie St, Richmond Hill, ON L4B 2N8
options.bullet_flavor: A clear broth that still tastes of beef bone and spice, loaded with ribs, brisket or marrow
options.bullet_highlight: Two enormous bowls for a little over twenty dollars, with honey-glazed fried wings on the side

review_notes.summary: 牛骨pho在多伦多是可以申遗的存在。beef bone粉端上来两大碗，一碗两大根beef rib，另一碗是一整块牛窝骨，20刀出头。
review_notes.must_try:
🍖 Beef Bone Pho 牛骨粉（两大根肋排）
🦴 Marrow Bone Pho 牛窝骨粉
🍗 蜂蜜脆皮炸鸡翅
review_notes.tips: House special 和牛尾粉份量也很足；汤底看着清淡但喝起来是牛骨鲜甜加香料味。7月promo house special $9.99、大份$13.99。
review_notes.vibe: 北边份量惊人的越南粉店，一个人也能吃得豪横

highlights: Richmond Hill pho with two beef ribs or a giant marrow bone for about twenty dollars
The house special and tail pho are equally loaded; the fried wings are a second reason to come
options.description_zh: Richmond Hill的越南粉，20刀出头就有两大根牛肋排或一整块牛窝骨，汤底清甜、份量巨大。
highlights_zh: 20刀出头就有两大根牛肋排或一整块牛窝骨的越南粉
汤底看着清淡、喝起来是牛骨鲜甜，刷了蜂蜜水的炸鸡翅必点
options.signature_dish_zh: 牛大骨肋排粉
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Beef-bone pho in Toronto, in the reviewer's words, is worth protecting. Two bowls arrived with two ribs each and one with a marrow bone the size of a fist.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍖 Beef bone pho with two ribs
🦴 Marrow bone pho
🍗 Honey-glazed crispy chicken wings
review_notes_en.tips: House special and tail pho are equally generous. The broth looks pale but tastes of beef bone and spice. The reviewer caught a promo of $9.99 for house special and $13.99 for large.
review_notes_en.vibe: A Richmond Hill pho shop where even a solo bowl feels generous

options.name: Oguz Uyghur Restaurant
options.signature_dish: Lamb Pilaf
options.description: Finch Avenue Uyghur kitchen whose lamb pilaf the reviewer declares Toronto's single best.
options.address: 1110 Finch Ave W, North York, ON M3J 2T2
options.bullet_flavor: Separate grains of lamb pilaf, chewy stir-fried noodles with real wok heat, and a cumin-heavy grill platter
options.bullet_highlight: The reviewer awards this Toronto's number one pilaf, with crisp-crusted baked buns as the bonus

review_notes.summary: 本人封这家抓饭为多伦多的top1没有之一。点的都是喜欢的碳水和烤肉，端上来香味直接拉满。
review_notes.must_try:
🍚 手抓饭（米粒分明、吸满肉香）
🥟 烤包子（外皮酥脆）
🥩 烤肉拼盘（孜然香浓）
🍜 干煸炒面（锅气足、微辣）
review_notes.tips: 烤肉拼盘适合多人一起点，一次尝到不同口味；干煸炒面带一点微辣，面条筋道入味。
review_notes.vibe: 北边的维吾尔餐厅，孜然香和碳水快乐一次到位

highlights: Uyghur kitchen on Finch that the reviewer calls Toronto's best pilaf, full stop
Lamb pilaf, dry-fried noodles and a grill platter made for sharing, plus crisp samsa
options.description_zh: Finch上的维吾尔餐厅，手抓饭米粒分明吸满肉香，烤包子外皮酥脆，烤肉拼盘适合多人。
highlights_zh: 原笔记封这家的手抓饭为多伦多top1
手抓饭米粒分明、烤肉拼盘外焦里嫩，烤包子外皮酥脆
options.signature_dish_zh: 手抓饭
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The reviewer crowns this Toronto's number one pilaf, no exceptions: all carbs and grilled meat, arriving with the smell turned all the way up.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍚 Lamb pilaf with loose, separate grains
🥟 Crisp-crusted baked samsa
🥩 Cumin-heavy grill platter
🍜 Dry-fried noodles with real wok heat
review_notes_en.tips: The grill platter is the sharing order and lets you taste several meats at once; the dry-fried noodles come through mildly spicy and springy.
review_notes_en.vibe: A north-end Uyghur room that delivers cumin and carbohydrates in one sitting

options.name: Rudy
options.signature_dish: Rudy Cheeseburger
options.description: Reddit's favourite downtown burger with a thin, fresh patty seared hard at the edges and great poutine.
options.address: 69 Duncan St, Toronto, ON M5V 1V3
options.bullet_flavor: A thin fresh patty with crisp edges inside a soft brioche, plus hand-cut fries that make the poutine
options.bullet_highlight: Widely recommended on Reddit and rated better than Shake Shack by the reviewer who tried both

review_notes.summary: Reddit很多推荐的汉堡，还不错。肉饼边缘煎得很脆，是新鲜非冷冻的，饼皮挺薄不会噎，比Shake Shack好吃。
review_notes.must_try:
🍔 Rudy Cheeseburger 芝士汉堡
🍟 鲜切薯条做的 Poutine
🥗 配一份沙拉解腻
review_notes.tips: 原笔记评论区有分歧：有人说比汉堡王还淡、single cheese套餐吃不饱，可以多点一份；薯条是公认好吃的。
review_notes.vibe: Downtown小快餐店，一个人站着吃也自在

highlights: The burger Reddit keeps recommending, and the one the reviewer prefers to Shake Shack
Fresh, never-frozen patty with crisped edges; the poutine is quietly excellent
options.description_zh: Duncan街网红汉堡，肉饼新鲜非冷冻、边缘煎得脆，薯条鲜切现炸，poutine意外好吃。
highlights_zh: Reddit上很多人推荐的汉堡，原笔记觉得比Shake Shack好吃
肉饼新鲜非冷冻、边缘煎脆，鲜切薯条做的poutine意外好吃
options.signature_dish_zh: 芝士汉堡
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The burger Reddit keeps pushing, and the reviewer agrees: fresh never-frozen patty with crisp edges, a thin bun that never feels heavy, and better than Shake Shack.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍔 Rudy cheeseburger
🍟 Poutine made from hand-cut fries
🥗 A salad to cut through it
review_notes_en.tips: Commenters disagreed: one found the patty under-seasoned and the single-cheese combo too small, so consider ordering a second. The fries were the least controversial part.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small downtown counter where eating alone feels normal

options.name: Blooming Spice Fish House
options.signature_dish: Sichuan Boiled Fish
options.description: Scarborough Sichuan shop where an eighty-eight dollar set feeds four for about twenty dollars each.
options.address: 325 Bamburgh Cir Unit A106, Scarborough, ON M1V 5L6
options.bullet_flavor: Stir-fried to order with real wok breath: boiled fish, cumin dry pot, garlic vermicelli prawns and taro cakes
options.bullet_highlight: An eighty-eight dollar set covers four people with six dishes, four teas and four bowls of rice

review_notes.summary: 多伦多现在还有这种物价？四个人点了满满一桌，结账盯着小票看了三遍，人均20一度以为老板算错了。四川朋友带路，说这家辣得比较正。
review_notes.must_try:
🐟 沸腾鱼（鱼肉很嫩，麻辣香但不抢鲜）
🦐 蒜蓉粉丝扇贝虾
🌶️ 火爆双脆（隔壁桌推荐）
🧆 手工芋头饼
review_notes.tips: 88刀套餐含沸腾鱼、孜然干锅王、蒜蓉粉丝扇贝虾、筋头巴脑烧豆腐、手工芋头饼、4杯苦瓜茶和4碗米饭；基本每天都排队。
review_notes.vibe: Scarborough的平价川菜小馆，人多是真的有道理

highlights: Sichuan cooking at about twenty dollars a head from a set built for four
The boiled fish is the sleeper hit; queues form nightly, even at nine o'clock
options.description_zh: Scarborough川菜馆，88刀套餐四个人吃到撑，人均20；沸腾鱼嫩而不抢鲜，火爆双脆值得加单。
highlights_zh: 人均20的川菜，88刀套餐四个人吃得很饱
沸腾鱼嫩而不辣抢，火爆双脆值得一试，晚上9点门口还在排队
options.signature_dish_zh: 沸腾鱼
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: An $88 set for four that the reviewer double-checked on the bill: about twenty dollars a head, with a Sichuan friend vouching for the heat.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐟 Boiled fish, tender and fragrant without losing its sweetness
🦐 Garlic vermicelli prawns
🌶️ The double-crisp stir-fry a neighbouring table recommended
🧆 Hand-made taro cakes
review_notes_en.tips: The set includes boiled fish, cumin dry pot, garlic vermicelli prawns, braised tofu, taro cakes, four bitter-melon teas and four bowls of rice. Expect a queue most days.
review_notes_en.vibe: A cheap, busy Scarborough Sichuan room where the crowd is the point

options.name: Bar Filo
options.signature_dish: 24oz Bistecca di Manzo
options.description: Yonge Street Italian steak house cutting a twenty-four ounce bistecca for sixty-six dollars Mondays to Wednesdays.
options.address: 146 Yonge St, Toronto, ON M5C 1X6
options.bullet_flavor: A twenty-four ounce bone-in bistecca cooked on the rare side and finished with salt flakes, plus grilled octopus
options.bullet_highlight: The Monday to Wednesday offer takes a twenty-four ounce cut to about sixty-six dollars before tip

review_notes.summary: 为了这六十多的24oz牛排下班就赶DT。正巧朋友过生日，24oz bistecca 66刀，含小费差不多80左右，有这个活动来吃很值。
review_notes.must_try:
🥩 Bistecca di Manzo 24oz（约$66）
🐙 Polpo alla Griglia 烤章鱼（$45）
🥗 Insalata di Lattura e Erbe（$20）
review_notes.tips: 他们家牛排做得偏生，点medium well中间仍可能偏rare，怕生要提前说；沙拉每片裹满酱汁很解腻。记得opentable提前约。
review_notes.vibe: Yonge街上的开放式厨房牛排馆，适合下班后吃一顿好的

highlights: Downtown steak dinner for around eighty dollars all-in thanks to the Monday-Wednesday offer
Twenty-four ounce bistecca, grilled octopus and an open kitchen right on Yonge Street
options.description_zh: Yonge街牛排馆，周一二三牛排有优惠，24盎司bistecca约66刀，开放式厨房，记得先在OpenTable订位。
highlights_zh: 周一二三牛排有优惠，24盎司bistecca约66刀
开放式厨房、含小费约80刀吃下来，记得先在OpenTable订位
options.signature_dish_zh: 24盎司牛排
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: Worth crossing downtown for a sixty-six dollar twenty-four ounce bistecca: about eighty dollars with tip, and the reviewer would go again for it.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥩 24oz bistecca di manzo for about $66
🐙 Grilled octopus for $45
🥗 The dressed lettuce and herb salad for $20
review_notes_en.tips: Steak comes on the rare side: even medium well can still show pink, so say so if you do not eat that. Book through OpenTable in advance.
review_notes_en.vibe: An open-kitchen steak room on Yonge Street for an after-work splurge

options.name: Mexico Lindo
options.signature_dish: Birria Tacos with Beef Consommé
options.description: Leaside taqueria selling five tacos a plate, mixable flavours, and a birria broth worth dipping for.
options.address: 1618 Bayview Ave, Toronto, ON M4G 3B7
options.bullet_flavor: Slow-braised beef, steak, pork and chicken-pineapple tacos, each plate of five mixable between flavours
options.bullet_highlight: Wednesday and Friday second-plate deals put ten tacos, chips and two sodas at forty dollars

review_notes.summary: 先说结论：夯爆了！所有人请吃下这份平价大碗的安利。每份五个，可以两个味道mix，还可以告诉他们哪个多哪个少。
review_notes.must_try:
🌮 Birria 炖牛肉Taco（蘸牛肉汤）
🌮 牛排 / 鸡肉菠萝 / 炖猪肉Taco
🍲 随餐的炖牛肉汤
review_notes.tips: 周三周五第二份半价，十个taco一份chip两瓶汽水共40。原笔记提醒：taco端上来会附一碗炖牛肉汤，皮裤套棉裤必有缘故，蘸着吃才对。
review_notes.vibe: Bayview街边的小份量墨西哥馆，适合两三个人分着吃

highlights: Cheap, generous tacos with five to a plate and flavours you can mix
Dip the birria taco in the beef broth it arrives with, that is the whole point
options.description_zh: Leaside墨西哥小馆，一份五个taco可混味，周三周五第二份半价；炖牛肉taco蘸牛肉汤是灵魂。
highlights_zh: 一份五个taco、可以混口味，周三周五第二份半价
炖牛肉taco一定要蘸随餐的牛肉汤，神仙吃法
options.signature_dish_zh: 炖牛肉Taco配牛肉汤
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: The verdict: outstanding, and cheap enough that everyone should take the recommendation. Five tacos a plate, mixable flavours, and you can split the counts.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🌮 Birria beef tacos, dipped in the consommé
🌮 Steak, chicken-and-pineapple or pork tacos
🍲 The beef broth that arrives with them
review_notes_en.tips: Wednesday and Friday second plates are half price: ten tacos, chips and two sodas for forty dollars. The broth that comes with the birria is not an accident, so use it.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small Bayview taqueria made for two or three people sharing plates

options.name: Chon Modern Thai
options.signature_dish: Signature Mango Salad
options.description: Chef Chat's Bayview Thai room where mango salad and crispy rice lead a menu that rarely misses.
options.address: 1677 Bayview Ave, Toronto, ON M4G 3C1
options.bullet_flavor: Mango salad with sweet potato threads, crisp rice with herbs, charred pork jowl and seafood that tastes fresh
options.bullet_highlight: Opened under Chef Chat to early queues, and the reviewer says the menu barely puts a foot wrong

review_notes.summary: 关注很久的Chef Chat新开泰餐终于soft opening，立刻马不停蹄打卡。基本上都不太会踩雷，非常符合期待。
review_notes.must_try:
🥭 Signature Mango Salad 招牌芒果沙拉
🍚 Crispy Rice 颗粒脆米（配树叶一起吃）
🍤 辣炒海鲜（青口、大虾、鱿鱼）
🍮 Beachy Mango Sticky Rice 芒果糯米饭
review_notes.tips: Pork Jowl Salad猪颈肉烤得微焦有烟熏香；Pad Gra Pow Beef用的是strack很有巧思；有vegan的Garden Curry可选。原笔记提醒grand opening会很火爆，趁早去。
review_notes.vibe: Bayview街上的现代泰餐，好看又好拍，适合朋友聚餐

highlights: Chef Chat's modern Thai kitchen on Bayview, opened to strong early reviews
Signature mango salad and crispy rice lead a menu the reviewer says rarely missteps
options.name_zh: Chon Modern Thai 现代泰餐
options.description_zh: Chef Chat新开的现代泰餐，招牌芒果沙拉和颗粒脆米很出彩，甜点芒果糯米饭像一幅画。
highlights_zh: Chef Chat新开的现代泰餐，就在Bayview街
招牌芒果沙拉和颗粒脆米必点，芒果糯米饭好看又好吃
options.signature_dish_zh: 招牌芒果沙拉

review_notes_en.summary: Chef Chat's long-awaited Thai opening, visited straight away: the reviewer says the menu barely puts a foot wrong and lived up to expectations.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🥭 Signature mango salad
🍚 Crispy rice with herbs, eaten wrapped in the leaf
🍤 Chilli stir-fried seafood
🍮 Beachy mango sticky rice
review_notes_en.tips: The pork jowl salad comes charred and smoky; the pad gra pow uses striploin, which is a nice touch. There is also a vegan garden curry. Expect a rush when it opens properly.
review_notes_en.vibe: A good-looking modern Thai room on Bayview for a group dinner

options.name: EAT BKK
options.signature_dish: Northern Thai Curry Noodles with Beef
options.description: Yonge and Bloor Thai kitchen rated 4.8, where the northern curry noodle soup is the order.
options.address: 513 Bloor St W, Toronto, ON M5S 1Y4
options.bullet_flavor: Rich northern curry noodles, pineapple fried rice with pork floss and crisp onion, papaya salad to taste
options.bullet_highlight: A 4.8-rated Bangkok-street-style room whose full menu the reviewer worked through item by item

review_notes.summary: 在DT发现一家小众宝藏泰餐，评分竟然还是4.8分。作为爱吃泰餐星人，品鉴过多家多伦多泰餐后依然给到这家一个顶级。
review_notes.must_try:
🍜 牛肉 咖喱面（泰北风味浓汤面，五星）
🍚 菠萝炒饭（肉松+脆洋葱是灵魂）
🥗 青木瓜沙拉（酸辣可选）
🦀 软壳蟹拼盘（配三种蘸酱）
review_notes.tips: 可以选辣度，不吃辣记得提前说；周末饭点人多建议错峰。装修是曼谷街头风，拍照很出片。
review_notes.vibe: 曼谷街头风的小泰餐店，适合朋友一起点一桌

highlights: Small Bangkok-street-style Thai room near Yonge and Bloor rated 4.8
Beef curry noodles are the five-star dish; pineapple fried rice and soft-shell crab follow
options.description_zh: Yonge与Bloor路口的泰餐小店，评分4.8，牛肉咖喱浓汤面是必点，菠萝炒饭和软壳蟹拼盘也很稳。
highlights_zh: Yonge与Bloor路口的泰餐小店，评分4.8
牛肉咖喱浓汤面五星必点，菠萝炒饭和软壳蟹拼盘也稳
options.signature_dish_zh: 牛肉咖喱浓汤面
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A low-key downtown Thai find rated 4.8, which the reviewer still calls top tier after working through most of Toronto's Thai options.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🍜 Northern-style beef curry noodles, the five-star order
🍚 Pineapple fried rice with pork floss and crisp onion
🥗 Green papaya salad with adjustable heat
🦀 Soft-shell crab platter with three dips
review_notes_en.tips: Spice level is adjustable, so say so up front. The room is done up Bangkok-street style and photographs well; weekends get busy, so go off-peak.
review_notes_en.vibe: A small street-styled Thai room for sharing a table full of plates

options.name: Litsea Cuisine
options.signature_dish: Yunnan Hand-Grabbed Rice Platter for Two
options.description: North York Yunnan room where a two-person rice platter with grilled fish feeds more than two.
options.address: 3550 Victoria Park Ave Unit 100, North York, ON M2H 2E1
options.bullet_flavor: Crisp fried river fish, crinkle-cut potatoes and glutinous rice rolls alongside a hand-grabbed rice platter
options.bullet_highlight: Two people ordered a set plus extras and still could not finish it, in a clean, well-kept room

review_notes.summary: 云南菜，装修布置得很用心，服务员小哥很热情一直问饭菜如何，店里和洗手间都打扫得很干净。两个人吃点了一个手抓饭2人套餐，加了烤鱼和烤糯米藕，量很大都没吃完。
review_notes.must_try:
🐟 烤鱼（炸得酥脆，除了大刺都吃光）
🥔 狼牙土豆
🍠 烤糯米藕
🍚 糯米饭沾糖
review_notes.tips: 其他无功无过：鸡肉稍微有点柴，糯米饭好吃但凉了会硬。原笔记说还是会再去尝尝其他菜，有推荐的菜写在评论区。
review_notes.vibe: 北约克的云南私房菜，环境干净、服务热情

highlights: North York Yunnan kitchen built around a two-person hand-grabbed rice platter
The fried fish is crisp through, the crinkle-cut potatoes land, and the portions run large
options.description_zh: Victoria Park上的云南菜，手抓饭双人套餐加烤鱼、烤糯米藕量很大，烤鱼酥脆、狼牙土豆好吃。
highlights_zh: 北约克云南菜，手抓饭双人套餐加烤鱼吃不完
烤鱼炸得酥脆、狼牙土豆和烤糯米藕好吃，服务热情、店里干净
options.signature_dish_zh: 云南手抓饭双人套餐
options.hours_note_zh: 每日（营业时间请以Google Maps为准）

review_notes_en.summary: A Yunnan room where the decor was clearly considered, the staff keep checking in, and two people could not finish a set plus grilled fish and sticky-rice lotus.
review_notes_en.must_try:
🐟 Fried river fish, crisp all the way through
🥔 Crinkle-cut potatoes
🍠 Grilled glutinous rice lotus
🍚 Sticky rice with sugar
review_notes_en.tips: Everything else was neutral: the chicken was a little dry, and the sticky rice is good but hardens as it cools. The reviewer plans to return to work through the rest of the menu.
review_notes_en.vibe: A tidy North York Yunnan room with genuinely warm service
